<script>
/* ArthaSaar — live-data wiring for the new UI. Fills the hardcoded placeholders with the repo's EOD data. */
(function () {
  "use strict";
  var BASE = "data/";
  function nf(x, d) { return (x == null || isNaN(x)) ? "—" : Number(x).toLocaleString("en-IN", { maximumFractionDigits: d == null ? 2 : d }); }
  function sign(x, d) { return (x == null || isNaN(x)) ? "—" : (x > 0 ? "+" : "") + nf(x, d == null ? 2 : d) + "%"; }
  function J(n) { return fetch(BASE + n, { cache: "no-store" }).then(function (r) { if (!r.ok) throw new Error(n); return r.json(); }); }
  function kpi(lbl) {
    var out = null;
    document.querySelectorAll(".card.kpi").forEach(function (c) {
      var l = c.querySelector(".lbl");
      if (l && l.textContent.trim().toUpperCase() === lbl) out = c;
    });
    return out;
  }
  function setKpi(lbl, price, chg) {
    var c = kpi(lbl); if (!c) return;
    var num = c.querySelector(".num"), ch = c.querySelector(".chg");
    if (num) num.textContent = nf(price, 2);
    if (ch) { ch.textContent = (chg > 0 ? "▲ " : "▼ ") + sign(chg); ch.className = "chg " + (chg > 0 ? "up" : chg < 0 ? "dn" : ""); }
  }
  function probe() {
    return fetch("data/fii-dii.json", { cache: "no-store" }).then(function (r) {
      if (!r.ok) throw 0; return true;
    }).catch(function () {
      return fetch("../data/fii-dii.json", { cache: "no-store" }).then(function (r) { if (r.ok) { BASE = "../data/"; return true; } return false; }).catch(function () { return false; });
    });
  }
  probe().then(function () {
    // --- indices: hero KPIs + indices table ---
    J("indices-all.json").then(function (ia) {
      var idx = ia.indices || [];
      function find(n) { return idx.filter(function (i) { return i.index.toUpperCase() === n; })[0] || idx.filter(function (i) { return i.index.toUpperCase().indexOf(n) > -1; })[0]; }
      var n = find("NIFTY 50"), b = find("NIFTY BANK"), v = find("INDIA VIX");
      if (n) setKpi("NIFTY 50", n.price, n.change_pct);
      if (b) setKpi("BANK NIFTY", b.price, b.change_pct);
      if (v) setKpi("INDIA VIX", v.price, v.change_pct);
      var tb = document.getElementById("idxBody");
      if (tb) tb.innerHTML = idx.slice(0, 80).map(function (i) {
        var u = i.change_pct >= 0;
        return "<tr><td>" + i.index + "</td><td>" + nf(i.price, 2) + "</td><td><span class='" + (u ? "up" : "dn") + "'>" + sign(i.change_pct) + "</span></td><td>—</td><td>" + (i.pe || "—") + "</td><td>" + (i.pb || "—") + "</td></tr>";
      }).join("");
    }).catch(function () {});
    // --- global + SENSEX ---
    J("global.json").then(function (g) {
      var items = g.items || [];
      var s = items.filter(function (i) { return i.name === "SENSEX"; })[0];
      if (s) setKpi("SENSEX", s.price, s.chg_pct);
      var t = document.querySelector("#v-global tbody");
      if (t) t.innerHTML = items.map(function (i) { var u = i.chg_pct >= 0; return "<tr><td>" + i.name + "</td><td>" + nf(i.price, 2) + "</td><td><span class='" + (u ? "up" : "dn") + "'>" + sign(i.chg_pct) + "</span></td></tr>"; }).join("");
    }).catch(function () {});
    // --- crypto ---
    J("crypto.json").then(function (c) {
      var t = document.querySelector("#v-crypto tbody");
      if (t) t.innerHTML = (c.top || []).slice(0, 30).map(function (x) {
        var u = x.chg_24h_pct >= 0, u7 = x.chg_7d_pct >= 0;
        return "<tr><td>" + x.symbol + "</td><td>$" + nf(x.price_usd, x.price_usd < 1 ? 4 : 2) + "</td><td><span class='" + (u ? "up" : "dn") + "'>" + sign(x.chg_24h_pct) + "</span></td><td><span class='" + (u7 ? "up" : "dn") + "'>" + sign(x.chg_7d_pct) + "</span></td><td>$" + nf(x.market_cap / 1e9, 1) + "B</td></tr>";
      }).join("");
    }).catch(function () {});
    // --- mutual funds ---
    J("mf-top.json").then(function (m) {
      var t = document.querySelector("#v-mf tbody");
      if (t) t.innerHTML = (m.funds || []).slice(0, 24).map(function (f) {
        return "<tr><td>" + f.n.split("·")[0].trim() + "</td><td>—</td><td><span class='up'>" + sign(f.r1, 1) + "</span></td><td><span class='up'>" + sign(f.r3, 1) + "</span></td><td>—</td></tr>";
      }).join("");
    }).catch(function () {});
    // --- FII / DII 5-day rows on home ---
    J("fii-history.json").then(function (fh) {
      var card = [].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll("#v-home .card")).filter(function (c) { return /FII \/ DII/.test(c.textContent); })[0];
      if (!card || !fh.length) return;
      var rows = fh.slice(-6).reverse().map(function (d) {
        return '<div class="zrow"><span>' + d.date.slice(0, 6) + '</span><span><b class="' + (d.fii >= 0 ? "up" : "dn") + '">' + nf(d.fii, 0) + '</b> <small class="mono">FII</small> · <b class="' + (d.dii >= 0 ? "up" : "dn") + '">' + nf(d.dii, 0) + '</b> <small class="mono">DII</small></span></div>';
      }).join("");
      var box = card.querySelector("div[style]");
      if (box) box.innerHTML = rows;
    }).catch(function () {});
    // --- news (fill the home News cards' first card) ---
    J("news.json").then(function (nw) {
      var card = document.querySelector("#v-news .grid3 .card .ni");
      if (!card) return;
      var host = card.parentNode;
      host.innerHTML = '<div class="sh2">Market News</div>' + (nw.items || []).slice(0, 4).map(function (i) {
        return '<div class="ni"><b>' + String(i.title).replace(/[<>]/g, "") + '</b><small>' + (i.publisher || i.topic || "") + '</small></div>';
      }).join("");
    }).catch(function () {});
  });
})();
</script>

<script>
/* ArthaSaar — second live-data pass: screener, futures, internals, GTI zones, home modules. */
(function () {
  "use strict";
  var BASE = "data/";
  function nf(x, d) { return (x == null || isNaN(x)) ? "—" : Number(x).toLocaleString("en-IN", { maximumFractionDigits: d == null ? 2 : d }); }
  function sign(x, d) { return (x == null || isNaN(x)) ? "—" : (x > 0 ? "+" : "") + nf(x, d == null ? 2 : d) + "%"; }
  function J(n) { return fetch(BASE + n, { cache: "no-store" }).then(function (r) { if (!r.ok) throw new Error(n); return r.json(); }); }
  function kpi(lbl) { var o = null; document.querySelectorAll(".card.kpi").forEach(function (c) { var l = c.querySelector(".lbl"); if (l && l.textContent.trim().toUpperCase() === lbl) o = c; }); return o; }
  function setKpi(lbl, val, chg, cls) { var c = kpi(lbl); if (!c) return; var n = c.querySelector(".num"), ch = c.querySelector(".chg"); if (n) n.textContent = val; if (ch) { ch.textContent = chg || ""; ch.className = "chg " + (cls || ""); } }
  fetch("data/fii-dii.json", { cache: "no-store" }).catch(function () { BASE = "../data/"; }).then(run);

  function run() {
    // ---- brain-screener: home modules + screener table + internals ----
    J("brain-screener.json").then(function (b) {
      var st = (b.stocks || []).slice();
      if (!st.length) return;
      var byChg = st.slice().sort(function (a, c) { return (c.change_pct || 0) - (a.change_pct || 0); });
      var g = byChg[0], l = byChg[byChg.length - 1];
      var vol = st.slice().sort(function (a, c) { return (c.vol_vs_avg20 || 0) - (a.vol_vs_avg20 || 0); })[0];
      var nearHi = st.filter(function (s) { return (s.from_52w_high_pct || -100) > -3; }).length;
      setKpi("TOP GAINER", g.symbol, sign(g.change_pct, 1), "up");
      setKpi("TOP LOSER", l.symbol, sign(l.change_pct, 1), "dn");
      setKpi("VOLUME SHOCKER", nf(vol.vol_vs_avg20, 1) + "×", "above normal", "");
      setKpi("52W MOVERS", nf(nearHi, 0), "near high", "");
      // screener table
      var tb = document.getElementById("scrBody");
      if (tb) tb.innerHTML = byChg.slice(0, 40).map(function (s) {
        var u = (s.change_pct || 0) >= 0, sig = s.above_ema200 && u ? "BUY" : (s.rsi14 < 30 ? "WATCH" : "HOLD"), sigc = sig === "BUY" ? "buy" : sig === "WATCH" ? "hold" : "hold";
        return "<tr><td>" + s.symbol + "</td><td>" + nf(s.price, 2) + "</td><td><span class='" + (u ? "up" : "dn") + "'>" + sign(s.change_pct, 1) + "</span></td><td>—</td><td>—</td><td>" + (s.rsi14 != null ? nf(s.rsi14, 0) : "—") + "</td><td><span class='b " + sigc + "'>" + sig + "</span></td></tr>";
      }).join("");
      // internals: advances / declines
      var adv = st.filter(function (s) { return (s.change_pct || 0) > 0; }).length;
      var dec = st.filter(function (s) { return (s.change_pct || 0) < 0; }).length;
      setKpi("ADVANCES", nf(adv, 0), "aaj ke winner", "up");
      setKpi("DECLINES", nf(dec, 0), "aaj ke loser", "dn");
      var trin = dec ? (adv / dec) : 0;
      setKpi("TRIN (ARMS)", nf(trin, 2), trin > 1 ? "bullish breadth" : "weak breadth", trin > 1 ? "up" : "dn");
    }).catch(function () {});

    // ---- breadth: 52w highs/lows ----
    J("breadth.json").then(function (br) {
      var c = document.querySelector("#v-internals");
      if (!c) return;
      // New highs / lows row inside "52w Highs vs Lows" card
      var cards = c.querySelectorAll(".card");
      cards.forEach(function (cd) {
        if (/52w Highs vs Lows/.test(cd.textContent)) {
          var rows = cd.querySelectorAll(".zrow");
          if (rows[0]) rows[0].innerHTML = "<span>New highs</span><b class='up'>" + nf(br.near_52w_high, 0) + "</b>";
          if (rows[1]) rows[1].innerHTML = "<span>New lows</span><b class='dn'>" + nf(br.rsi_below_40, 0) + "</b>";
        }
      });
    }).catch(function () {});

    // ---- futures table ----
    J("futures.json").then(function (f) {
      var t = document.querySelector("#v-futures tbody");
      if (!t) return;
      var rows = [];
      (f.indices || []).forEach(function (i) { var c0 = (i.contracts || [])[0] || {}; rows.push({ n: i.symbol + " FUT", ltp: c0.close, chg: i.underlying ? (c0.close - i.underlying) / i.underlying * 100 : null, oi: c0.oi, oich: c0.oi_chg, basis: i.underlying ? (c0.close - i.underlying) : null }); });
      (f.stocks || []).slice(0, 6).forEach(function (s) { rows.push({ n: s.symbol + " FUT", ltp: s.close, chg: s.basis_pct, oi: s.oi, oich: s.oi_chg, basis: (s.close - s.underlying) }); });
      t.innerHTML = rows.map(function (r) {
        return "<tr><td>" + r.n + "</td><td>" + nf(r.ltp, 2) + "</td><td><span class='" + ((r.chg || 0) >= 0 ? "up" : "dn") + "'>" + sign(r.chg, 2) + "</span></td><td>" + nf(r.oi, 0) + "</td><td><span class='" + ((r.oich || 0) >= 0 ? "up" : "dn") + "'>" + nf(r.oich, 0) + "</span></td><td>" + nf(r.basis, 2) + "</td></tr>";
      }).join("");
    }).catch(function () {});

    // ---- GTI zones ----
    J("gti.json").then(function (g) {
      var s = (g.symbols || {})["NIFTY 50"]; if (!s) return;
      var host = document.querySelector("#v-gtizones");
      if (!host) return;
      var dz = s.day_zones || {}, wz = s.week_zones || {};
      var cards = host.querySelectorAll(".card");
      if (cards[0]) cards[0].innerHTML = "<div class='sh2'>NIFTY 50 — Zones</div><div style='padding:6px 14px 10px'><div class='zrow'><span>Day demand</span><b class='up'>" + nf((dz.SD || [])[0], 0) + " – " + nf((dz.SD || [])[1], 0) + "</b></div><div class='zrow'><span>Day supply</span><b class='dn'>" + nf((dz.SS || [])[0], 0) + " – " + nf((dz.SS || [])[1], 0) + "</b></div><div class='zrow'><span>POC day</span><b>" + nf(s.day_poc, 0) + "</b></div></div>";
    }).catch(function () {});
  }
})();
</script>

<script>
/* ArthaSaar — round 2: lockscreen, live charts, learn modules, forex/commodities/bonds, events, mood. */
(function () {
  "use strict";
  var BASE = "data/";
  function nf(x, d) { return (x == null || isNaN(x)) ? "—" : Number(x).toLocaleString("en-IN", { maximumFractionDigits: d == null ? 2 : d }); }
  function sign(x, d) { return (x == null || isNaN(x)) ? "—" : (x > 0 ? "+" : "") + nf(x, d == null ? 2 : d) + "%"; }
  function J(n) { return fetch(BASE + n, { cache: "no-store" }).then(function (r) { if (!r.ok) throw new Error(n); return r.json(); }); }

  /* ---------- 1. LOCKSCREEN ---------- */
  /* Password is stored ONLY as a SHA-256 hash - the plaintext is not in this file. */
  var PASS_HASH = "c09f57e0b728dc5b1638e5022da243db3d8e0e7cefeab62bc8f1d40b99677880";
  function pwOk(v){ return crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", new TextEncoder().encode(v)).then(function(b){ return Array.from(new Uint8Array(b)).map(function(x){ return x.toString(16).padStart(2,"0"); }).join("") === PASS_HASH; }).catch(function(){ return false; }); }
  var lock = document.getElementById("lock"), pw = document.getElementById("pw"), err = document.getElementById("lockErr");
  function unlocked() { try { return localStorage.getItem("as-unlock") === "1"; } catch (e) { return false; } }
  function hideLock() { if (lock) lock.classList.add("hide"); }
  if (unlocked()) hideLock();
  var lf = document.getElementById("lockForm");
  if (lf) lf.addEventListener("submit", function (e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    pwOk(pw.value).then(function (ok) {
      if (ok) { try { localStorage.setItem("as-unlock", "1"); } catch (x) {} hideLock(); }
      else { err.textContent = "✕ Incorrect password. Try again."; pw.value = ""; pw.focus(); }
    });
  });
  if (pw) pw.addEventListener("input", function () { err.textContent = ""; });

  /* ---------- 2. CANDLE / LINE renderer (from candles.json) ---------- */
  function ema(v, p) { var k = 2 / (p + 1), e = v[0], o = []; for (var i = 0; i < v.length; i++) { e = i ? v[i] * k + e * (1 - k) : v[i]; o.push(e); } return o; }
  function candleSVG(d) {
    var O = d.o, H = d.h, L = d.l, C = d.c, V = d.v || [], n = C.length; if (n < 4) return "<div class='mut'>no data</div>";
    var w = 760, ph = 210, vh = 42, pad = 6, cw = (w - pad * 2) / n;
    var hi = Math.max.apply(null, H), lo = Math.min.apply(null, L), rg = (hi - lo) || 1;
    var X = function (i) { return pad + i * cw + cw / 2; }, Y = function (v) { return 6 + (hi - v) / rg * (ph - 12); };
    var s = "<svg viewBox='0 0 " + w + " " + (ph + vh + 8) + "' preserveAspectRatio='none' style='width:100%;height:230px'>";
    for (var gy = 0; gy <= 4; gy++) { var yy = 6 + gy * (ph - 12) / 4; s += "<line x1='0' y1='" + yy + "' x2='" + w + "' y2='" + yy + "' stroke='rgba(140,180,230,.14)'/>"; }
    for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) { var up = C[i] >= O[i], col = up ? "#2bd477" : "#ef5b61";
      s += "<line x1='" + X(i) + "' y1='" + Y(H[i]) + "' x2='" + X(i) + "' y2='" + Y(L[i]) + "' stroke='" + col + "'/>";
      var y1 = Y(Math.max(O[i], C[i])), y2 = Y(Math.min(O[i], C[i]));
      s += "<rect x='" + (X(i) - cw * .3) + "' y='" + y1 + "' width='" + (cw * .6) + "' height='" + Math.max(1, y2 - y1) + "' fill='" + col + "' rx='1'/>"; }
    var e20 = ema(C, 20), e50 = ema(C, 50);
    s += "<polyline points='" + e20.map(function (v, i) { return X(i) + "," + Y(v); }).join(" ") + "' fill='none' stroke='#4aa8ff' stroke-width='1.6'/>";
    s += "<polyline points='" + e50.map(function (v, i) { return X(i) + "," + Y(v); }).join(" ") + "' fill='none' stroke='#ffb457' stroke-width='1.6'/>";
    if (V.length) { var vmax = Math.max.apply(null, V) || 1, vy = ph + 6; for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) { var up = C[i] >= O[i], bh = V[i] / vmax * (vh - 6); s += "<rect x='" + (X(i) - cw * .3) + "' y='" + (vy + vh - bh) + "' width='" + (cw * .6) + "' height='" + bh + "' fill='" + (up ? "rgba(43,212,119,.5)" : "rgba(239,91,97,.5)") + "' rx='1'/>"; } }
    return s + "</svg><div class='mut' style='font-size:11px'>candles · EMA20 (blue) · EMA50 (orange) · volume</div>";
  }
  function lineSVG(C) {
    var n = C.length; if (n < 2) return "<div class='mut'>no data</div>";
    var w = 760, h = 230, pad = 8, hi = Math.max.apply(null, C), lo = Math.min.apply(null, C), rg = (hi - lo) || 1;
    var pts = C.map(function (v, i) { return (pad + i * (w - pad * 2) / (n - 1)).toFixed(1) + "," + (h - 20 - (v - lo) / rg * (h - 40)).toFixed(1); }).join(" ");
    var id = "g" + (n % 97) + Math.floor(Math.random() * 1e4);
    return "<svg viewBox='0 0 " + w + " " + h + "' preserveAspectRatio='none' style='width:100%;height:230px'><defs><linearGradient id='" + id + "' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'><stop offset='0' stop-color='#4aa8ff' stop-opacity='.35'/><stop offset='1' stop-color='#4aa8ff' stop-opacity='0'/></linearGradient></defs><polygon points='" + pad + "," + (h - 20) + " " + pts + " " + (w - pad) + "," + (h - 20) + "' fill='url(#" + id + ")'/><polyline points='" + pts + "' fill='none' stroke='#4aa8ff' stroke-width='2.2'/></svg><div class='mut' style='font-size:11px'>line · close</div>";
  }

  /* ---------- 3. HOME timeframe chart ---------- */
  var tf = { sym: "NIFTY", mode: "candle" };
  function renderTF() {
    J("candles.json").then(function (c) {
      var s = (c.syms || {})[tf.sym]; var el = document.getElementById("tfChart"); if (!el) return;
      if (!s) { el.innerHTML = "<div class='mut'>no data</div>"; return; }
      var d = s["1h"] || s["15m"] || s["5m"];
      el.innerHTML = tf.mode === "line" ? lineSVG(d.c) : candleSVG(d);
      var lab = document.getElementById("tfSym"); if (lab) lab.textContent = tf.sym;
    }).catch(function () {});
  }
  document.querySelectorAll("#v-home [data-tf]").forEach(function (b) {
    b.onclick = function () { tf.sym = b.getAttribute("data-tf"); document.querySelectorAll("#v-home [data-tf]").forEach(function (x) { x.classList.remove("on"); }); b.classList.add("on"); renderTF(); };
  });
  document.querySelectorAll("#v-home [data-mode]").forEach(function (b) {
    b.onclick = function () { tf.mode = b.getAttribute("data-mode"); document.querySelectorAll("#v-home [data-mode]").forEach(function (x) { x.classList.remove("on"); }); b.classList.add("on"); renderTF(); };
  });

  /* ---------- 4. CHARTS section ---------- */

  });

  function panel(title, html) {

    ov.addEventListener("click", function (e) { if (e.target === ov) ov.remove(); });
  }

  /* ---------- boot ---------- */
  fetch("data/fii-dii.json", { cache: "no-store" }).catch(function () { BASE = "../data/"; }).then(function () { renderTF(); renderCS(); });

  function J(n) { return fetch(BASE + n, { cache: "no-store" }).then(function (r) { if (!r.ok) throw new Error(n); return r.json(); }); }
  function D(n) { return C[n] ? Promise.resolve(C[n]) : J(n).then(function (d) { C[n] = d; return d; }); }
  function esc(s) { return String(s == null ? "" : s).replace(/[&<>"]/g, function (c) { return { "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;" }[c]; }); }
  function up(x) { return (x || 0) >= 0; }
  function rowsTo(arr, cols) { return arr.map(function (r) { return "<tr>" + cols.map(function (c) { return "<td>" + c(r) + "</td>"; }).join("") + "</tr>"; }).join(""); }

  try { var t0 = +localStorage.getItem("as-unlock-t") || 0; if (localStorage.getItem("as-unlock") === "1" && (Date.now() - t0) > 4 * 3600 * 1000) { localStorage.removeItem("as-unlock"); } } catch (e) {}
  var lf = document.getElementById("lockForm"); if (lf) lf.addEventListener("submit", function () { try { localStorage.setItem("as-unlock-t", String(Date.now())); } catch (e) {} });

  ["v-gticharts", "v-gtizones", "v-gtiai", "v-aibrain", "v-internals", "v-futures"].forEach(function (id) { var v = document.getElementById(id); if (!v) return; var x = v.querySelector(".xbtn"); if (x) x.setAttribute("data-go", "gti"); var btk = v.querySelector(".btk"); if (btk) btk.setAttribute("data-go", "gti"); });

"color-mix(in srgb,#2bd477 " + mix + "%,var(--surface))" : "color-mix(in srgb,#ef5b61 " + mix + "%,var(--surface))"; return "<div style='flex:" + x.mcap + " 1 auto;min-width:74px;background:" + col + ";border-radius:8px;padding:8px 9px;font:600 11px var(--font)'><b>" + x.s + "</b><br><span class='" + (x.chg >= 0 ?   var scrFilter = "all";
  function renderScreener() {
    if (!B) return; var st = (B.stocks || []).slice();

<script>
/* ArthaSaar — round 5: radar -> small round toggle button; sector map -> clickable sector cards with per-sector stock lists (% + ₹ move). */
(function () {
  "use strict";
  var BASE = "data/", C = {};
  function nf(x, d) { return (x == null || isNaN(x)) ? "—" : Number(x).toLocaleString("en-IN", { maximumFractionDigits: d == null ? 2 : d }); }
  function sign(x, d) { return (x == null || isNaN(x)) ? "—" : (x > 0 ? "+" : "") + nf(x, d == null ? 2 : d) + "%"; }
  function J(n) { return fetch(BASE + n, { cache: "no-store" }).then(function (r) { if (!r.ok) throw new Error(n); return r.json(); }); }
  function D(n) { return C[n] ? Promise.resolve(C[n]) : J(n).then(function (d) { C[n] = d; return d; }); }
  function esc(s) { return String(s == null ? "" : s).replace(/[&<>"]/g, function (c) { return { "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;" }[c]; }); }
  function up(x) { return (x || 0) >= 0; }

  /* ---------- 1. every radar card -> small round button in the header line + toggle card ---------- */
  function convertRadars() {
    document.querySelectorAll(".view > .radar").forEach(function (r) {
      if (r._conv) return; r._conv = 1;
      var v = r.closest(".view"); if (!v) return;
      var fh = v.querySelector(".fshead"); if (!fh) return;
      var html = r.outerHTML; r.remove();
      var btn = document.createElement("button"); btn.className = "rbtn"; btn.type = "button"; btn.innerHTML = "◉ RADAR";
      var x = fh.querySelector(".xbtn"); fh.insertBefore(btn, x);
      var holder = document.createElement("div"); holder.style.display = "none"; holder.innerHTML = html;
      fh.parentNode.insertBefore(holder, fh.nextSibling);
      btn.addEventListener("click", function () {
        var open = holder.style.display !== "none";
        holder.style.display = open ? "none" : "block";
        btn.classList.toggle("on", !open);
      });
    });
  }
  convertRadars();
  try { new MutationObserver(function () { convertRadars(); }).observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true }); } catch (e) {}
  var _n = 0, _iv = setInterval(function () { convertRadars(); if (++_n > 20) clearInterval(_iv); }, 700);

  /* ---------- 2. SECTOR MAP: sector cards -> per-sector stock list ---------- */
  function openSector(name, secs, map) {
    var list = secs[name] || [];
    var rows = list.map(function (x) { var s = map[x.symbol] || {}; return { sym: x.symbol, co: x.company, chg: s.change_pct, price: s.price }; })
      .sort(function (a, b) { return (b.chg || 0) - (a.chg || 0); });
    var html = "<div class='radar'><div class='rt'>" + esc(name) + " SECTOR</div><div class='rs'>" + rows.length + " stocks · % and ₹ move</div><div style='max-height:52vh;overflow:auto'>" +
      rows.map(function (r) { var rs = (r.price != null && r.chg != null) ? (r.price * r.chg / 100) : null; return "<div class='zrow'><span><b>" + r.sym + "</b> <small class='mono'>" + esc((r.co || "").slice(0, 24)) + "</small></span><b class='" + (up(r.chg) ? "up" : "dn") + "'>" + sign(r.chg, 1) + " · ₹" + (rs == null ? "—" : nf(rs, 2)) + "</b></div>"; }).join("") +
      "</div></div>";
    var host = document.querySelector("#v-heatmap"); if (!host) return;
    var old = host.querySelector(".secopen"); if (old) old.remove();
    var div = document.createElement("div"); div.className = "secopen"; div.innerHTML = html;
    var fh = host.querySelector(".fshead"); host.insertBefore(div, fh ? fh.nextSibling : host.firstChild);
  }

  fetch("data/fii-dii.json", { cache: "no-store" }).catch(function () { BASE = "../data/"; }).then(function () {
    Promise.all([D("constituents.json"), D("brain-screener.json"), D("indices-all.json")]).then(function (r) {
      var ct = r[0], b = r[1], ia = r[2];
      var host = document.querySelector("#v-heatmap"); if (!host) return;
      var map = {}; (b.stocks || []).forEach(function (s) { map[s.symbol] = s; });
      var secs = ct.sectors || {};
      var idx = ia.indices || [];
      var grid = document.createElement("div"); grid.className = "card secgrid";
      var html = "<div class='sh2'>SECTORS — today · tap to open</div><div class='secgrid-in'>";
      Object.keys(secs).forEach(function (name) {
        var key = name.toUpperCase().replace(/[^A-Z]/g, "");
        var ind = idx.filter(function (i) { return i.index.toUpperCase().indexOf(key) > -1; })[0];
        var chg = ind ? ind.change_pct : null;
        html += "<button class='seccard' data-sec='" + esc(name) + "'><b>" + esc(name) + "</b><span class='" + (up(chg) ? "up" : "dn") + "'>" + (chg == null ? "—" : sign(chg, 1)) + "</span></button>";
      });
      html += "</div>";
      grid.innerHTML = html;
      var fh = host.querySelector(".fshead"); host.insertBefore(grid, fh ? fh.nextSibling : host.firstChild);
      grid.querySelectorAll(".seccard").forEach(function (btn) {
        btn.addEventListener("click", function () {
          grid.querySelectorAll(".seccard").forEach(function (x) { x.classList.remove("on"); });
          btn.classList.add("on");
          openSector(btn.getAttribute("data-sec"), secs, map);
        });
      });
    }).catch(function () {});
  });
})();
</script>

<script>
/* ArthaSaar — round 6: remove old static sector blocks, robust radar toggle, closable sector card. */
(function () {
  "use strict";

  /* ---------- 1. remove the OLD static sector blocks in the heat map ---------- */
  function rmHeat() {
    document.querySelectorAll("#v-heatmap .heat").forEach(function (h) {
      var w = h.parentNode;
      h.remove();
      if (w && w.parentNode && w.classList && !w.classList.contains("view") && w.children.length === 0) w.remove();
    });
  }
  rmHeat();

  /* ---------- 2. robust radar -> small round toggle button ---------- */
  function convertRadars() {
    document.querySelectorAll(".view > .radar").forEach(function (r) {
      if (r._conv) return; r._conv = 1;
      var v = r.closest(".view"); if (!v) return;
      var fh = v.querySelector(".fshead"); if (!fh) return;
      var html = r.outerHTML; r.remove();
      var btn = document.createElement("button"); btn.className = "rbtn"; btn.type = "button"; btn.innerHTML = "◉ RADAR";
      var x = fh.querySelector(".xbtn"); fh.insertBefore(btn, x);
      var holder = document.createElement("div"); holder.style.display = "none"; holder.innerHTML = html;

<script>
/* ArthaSaar — round 9: Sector Map = ALL SECTORS of the Indian market (sector-grouped heat map) */
(function(){ "use strict";
  function probeBase(){ return location.pathname.indexOf("/app/")>=0 ? "../data/" : "data/"; }
  function J(f){ return fetch(probeBase()+f,{cache:"no-store"}).then(function(r){ if(!r.ok) throw 0; return r.json(); }); }
  function esc(s){ return String(s==null?"":s).replace(/[&<>"]/g,function(c){return {"&":"&amp;","<":"&lt;",">":"&gt;",'"':"&quot;"}[c];}); }
  function col(c){ if(c==null||isNaN(c)) return {bg:"#e6e6ea",fg:"#3a3a3a"}; if(c>0) return {bg:"#bfe9c8",fg:"#0a5c1e"}; if(c<0) return {bg:"#f6c3c3",fg:"#7a1010"}; return {bg:"#e6e6ea",fg:"#3a3a3a"}; }
  var C=null,SF=null,B=null;
  function build(){
    if(!C||!SF||!B) return;
    var host=document.getElementById("v-heatmap"); if(!host) return;
    /* drop the old flat (large-cap-only) treemap card */
    [].slice.call(host.querySelectorAll(".card")).forEach(function(el){
      if(el.id!=="sectreemap-card" && /BLOOMBERG STYLE|MCAP TREEMAP/.test(el.textContent||"")) el.remove();
    });
    if(document.getElementById("sectreemap-card")) return;
    var bmap={}; (B.stocks||[]).forEach(function(s){ bmap[s.symbol]=s; });
    var src=C.sectors||{}, secs=[];
    Object.keys(src).forEach(function(name){
      var list=src[name].map(function(it){
        var st=SF[it.symbol]||{}, mc=+st["Market Cap"]||0, bb=bmap[it.symbol]||{};
        return {sym:it.symbol,name:it.company,mcap:mc,chg:(bb.change_pct!=null?+bb.change_pct:null)};
      }).filter(function(x){ return x.mcap>0; });
      if(!list.length) return;
      var tot=list.reduce(function(a,x){return a+x.mcap;},0);
      var wavg=list.reduce(function(a,x){return a+(x.chg||0)*x.mcap;},0)/tot;
      secs.push({name:name,list:list,tot:tot,avg:wavg});
    });
    secs.sort(function(a,b){ return b.tot-a.tot; });
    var nstk=secs.reduce(function(a,s){return a+s.list.length;},0);
    var card=document.createElement("div"); card.id="sectreemap-card"; card.className="card";
    var html='<div class="trow" style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center"><b>SECTOR MAP</b><span class="muted" style="font-size:10.5px">ALL SECTORS · INDIA · SIZE = MCAP</span></div>';
    html+='<div style="font-size:11px;color:#777;margin:2px 0 9px">'+secs.length+' sectors · '+nstk+' stocks · tap a stock for its chart</div>';
    secs.forEach(function(s){
      var cc=col(s.avg);
      html+='<div class="secpanel"><div class="sechead"><span>'+esc(s.name)+'</span><span style="color:'+cc.fg+'">'+(s.avg>=0?"+":"")+s.avg.toFixed(1)+'%</span></div><div class="secblocks">';
      s.list.sort(function(a,b){return b.mcap-a.mcap;}).forEach(function(x){
        var c=col(x.chg);
        html+='<div class="blk" data-sym="'+esc(x.sym)+'" title="'+esc(x.name)+'" style="flex-grow:'+Math.max(x.mcap,1)+';background:'+c.bg+';color:'+c.fg+'"><b>'+esc(x.sym)+'</b><span>'+(x.chg==null?"":((x.chg>=0?"+":"")+x.chg.toFixed(1)+"%"))+'</span></div>';
      });
      html+='</div></div>';
    });
    card.innerHTML=html;
    card.addEventListener("click",function(e){
      var b=e.target.closest(".blk"); if(!b) return;
      var sym=b.getAttribute("data-sym"); if(!sym) return;

      location.hash="#company";

<script>
/* ArthaSaar — round 10: RADAR button opens/closes its data card right under the header; smaller text */
(function(){ "use strict";
  function findHolder(fh){
    var s=fh.nextElementSibling, i=0;
    while(s && i<6){
      if(s.classList && (s.classList.contains("radar") || (s.querySelector && s.querySelector(".radar")))) return s;
      s=s.nextElementSibling; i++;
    }
    return null;
  }
  function fix(){
    document.querySelectorAll(".view").forEach(function(v){
      var fh=v.querySelector(".fshead"); if(!fh) return;
      var btn=fh.querySelector(".rbtn"); if(!btn) return;
      var holder=findHolder(fh);
      if(holder){
        if(holder.previousElementSibling!==fh){ fh.parentNode.insertBefore(holder, fh.nextSibling); }
        holder.classList.add("as-holder");
        if(!holder._init){ holder._init=1; holder.style.display="none"; }
        if(!holder.querySelector(".rclose")){
          var c=document.createElement("button"); c.className="xbtn rclose"; c.type="button"; c.textContent="✕ CLOSE";
          c.addEventListener("click",function(e){ e.stopPropagation(); holder.style.display="none"; var bb=fh.querySelector(".rbtn"); if(bb) bb.classList.remove("on"); });
          holder.insertBefore(c, holder.firstChild);
        }
      }
      if(!btn._bound){
        var nb=btn.cloneNode(true); nb._bound=1; btn.parentNode.replaceChild(nb, btn);
        nb.addEventListener("click", function(e){
          e.stopPropagation();
          var h=findHolder(fh); if(!h) return;
          var open=h.style.display!=="none";
          h.style.display=open?"none":"block";
          nb.classList.toggle("on", !open);
          if(!open){ try{ h.scrollIntoView({behavior:"smooth",block:"nearest"}); }catch(_){} }
        });
      }
    });
  }
  fix();
  var n=0,iv=setInterval(function(){ fix(); if(++n>30) clearInterval(iv); },600);
  window.addEventListener("hashchange",function(){ setTimeout(fix,300); });
  document.addEventListener("click",function(){ setTimeout(fix,250); },true);
})();
</script>

  function esc(s){ return String(s==null?"":s).replace(/[&<>"]/g,function(c){return {"&":"&amp;","<":"&lt;",">":"&gt;",'"':"&quot;"}[c];}); }
  function num(x,d){ return (x==null||isNaN(x)) ? "—" : Number(x).toLocaleString("en-IN",{minimumFractionDigits:d||0,maximumFractionDigits:d==null?2:d}); }
  function pct(x){ return (x==null||isNaN(x)) ? "—" : (x>=0?"+":"")+Number(x).toFixed(2)+"%"; }
  function pts(level,p){ if(level==null||p==null||isNaN(level)||isNaN(p)) return null; return level - level/(1+p/100); }
  function sgn(x){ return (x==null||isNaN(x))?"—":(x>=0?"+":"")+Number(x).toLocaleString("en-IN",{maximumFractionDigits:2}); }
  var FL={"S&P 500":"\uD83C\uDDFA\uD83C\uDDF8","S&P500":"\uD83C\uDDFA\uD83C\uDDF8","Nasdaq":"\uD83C\uDDFA\uD83C\uDDF8","Dow Jones":"\uD83C\uDDFA\uD83C\uDDF8","Nikkei 225":"\uD83C\uDDEF\uD83C\uDDF5","Nikkei":"\uD83C\uDDEF\uD83C\uDDF5","Hang Seng":"\uD83C\uDDED\uD83C\uDDF0","Shanghai":"\uD83C\uDDE8\uD83C\uDDF3","DAX":"\uD83C\uDDE9\uD83C\uDDEA","FTSE 100":"\uD83C\uDDEC\uD83C\uDDE7","SENSEX":"\uD83C\uDDEE\uD83C\uDDF3","NIFTY 50":"\uD83C\uDDEE\uD83C\uDDF3"};
  var CTRY={"S&P 500":"USA","Nasdaq":"USA","Dow Jones":"USA","Nikkei 225":"Japan","Nikkei":"Japan","Hang Seng":"Hong Kong","Shanghai":"China","DAX":"Germany","FTSE 100":"UK","SENSEX":"India"};
  var W=null,G=null;
  function build(){
    var host=document.getElementById("v-global"); if(!host||!W||!G) return;
    [].slice.call(host.querySelectorAll(".card")).forEach(function(el){ if(el.id!=="as-global-card") el.remove(); });
    if(document.getElementById("as-global-card")) return;
    var m={};
    (W.idx||[]).forEach(function(x){ if(/VIX/i.test(x.n)) return; m[x.n]={n:x.n,level:x.c,p:x.d1,m1:x.m1}; });
    (G.items||[]).forEach(function(i){ if(/S&P 500|Nasdaq|Dow Jones|SENSEX|Nikkei|Hang Seng|FTSE|DAX|Shanghai/i.test(i.name) && !m[i.name]) m[i.name]={n:i.name,level:i.price,p:i.chg_pct,m1:null}; });
    var list=Object.keys(m).map(function(k){return m[k];});
    list.sort(function(a,b){ return Math.abs(b.p||0)-Math.abs(a.p||0); });
    var h='<div class="gsec" style="margin-top:0">\uD83C\uDF0D World Main Indices ('+list.length+')</div>';
    list.forEach(function(x){ var c=(x.p||0)>=0?"up":"dn"; var d=pts(x.level,x.p);
      h+='<div class="grow"><span class="gflag">'+(FL[x.n]||"\uD83C\uDFF3\uFE0F")+'</span><span class="gname">'+esc(x.n)+'<small>'+esc(CTRY[x.n]||"")+(x.m1!=null?" \u00b7 1M "+pct(x.m1):"")+'</small></span><span class="glvl">'+num(x.level,2)+'</span><span class="gchg '+c+'">'+sgn(d)+'<br><small>'+pct(x.p)+'</small></span></div>';
    });
    h+='<div class="gsec">\uD83D\uDCB0 Commodities &amp; FX</div>';
    (G.items||[]).filter(function(i){ return !/S&P 500|Nasdaq|Dow Jones|SENSEX|Nikkei|Hang Seng|FTSE|DAX|Shanghai/i.test(i.name); }).forEach(function(i){
      var c=(i.chg_pct||0)>=0?"up":"dn";
      h+='<div class="grow"><span class="gflag">'+(/Gold/i.test(i.name)?"\uD83E\uDD47":/Silver/i.test(i.name)?"\uD83E\uDE9E":/Crude|Gas/i.test(i.name)?"\uD83D\uDEE2\uFE0F":/USD-INR/i.test(i.name)?"\uD83D\uDCB1":/Dollar/i.test(i.name)?"\uD83D\uDCB5":/Yield/i.test(i.name)?"\uD83C\uDFE6":/Copper/i.test(i.name)?"\uD83D\uDD36":"\uD83D\uDCCA")+'</span><span class="gname">'+esc(i.name)+'</span><span class="glvl">'+num(i.price,2)+'</span><span class="gchg '+c+'">'+pct(i.chg_pct)+'</span></div>';
    });
    var card=document.createElement("div"); card.id="as-global-card"; card.className="card"; card.innerHTML=h;
    var fh=host.querySelector(".fshead");

  }
  Promise.all([J("world.json"),J("global.json")]).then(function(r){ W=r[0]||{}; G=r[1]||{}; build(); });

<script>
/* ArthaSaar — round 13: Fundamentals search -> merged company card (summary + fundamental + technical) */
(function(){ "use strict";
  function base(){ return location.pathname.indexOf("/app/")>=0 ? "../data/" : "data/"; }
  function J(f){ return fetch(base()+f,{cache:"no-store"}).then(function(r){ return r.ok?r.json():null; }).catch(function(){ return null; }); }
  function esc(s){ return String(s==null?"":s).replace(/[&<>"]/g,function(c){return {"&":"&amp;","<":"&lt;",">":"&gt;",'"':"&quot;"}[c];}); }
  function nf(x,d){ return (x==null||isNaN(x))?"—":Number(x).toLocaleString("en-IN",{maximumFractionDigits:d==null?2:d}); }
  function pc(x,d){ return (x==null||isNaN(x))?"—":(x>=0?"+":"")+Number(x).toFixed(d==null?1:d)+"%"; }
  var SF=null,FUND=null,B=null,CI=null,BM={};
  function detail(sym){
    if(window.openCompanyFS){ window.openCompanyFS(sym); return; }
    var host=document.getElementById("v-fundamentals"); if(!host) return;
    var f=(FUND||{})[sym]||{}, sf=(SF||{})[sym]||{}, sc=BM[sym]||{}, ci=(CI||{})[sym]||{};
    var old=host.querySelector(".funddetail"); if(old) old.remove();
    var h='<div class="fdhead"><div><div class="fdname">'+esc(ci.name||sym)+'</div><div class="fdsub">'+esc(sym)+' \u00b7 '+esc(ci.sector||"")+(ci.industry?" \u00b7 "+esc(ci.industry):"")+'</div></div><button class="xbtn fdx" type="button">\u2715</button></div>';
    h+='<div class="fdgrid">';
    h+='<div class="fdcell"><div class="k">price</div><div class="v">'+nf(sc.price,2)+'</div></div>';
    h+='<div class="fdcell"><div class="k">day</div><div class="v '+(sc.change_pct>=0?"up":"dn")+'">'+pc(sc.change_pct)+'</div></div>';
    h+='<div class="fdcell"><div class="k">mcap \u20b9Cr</div><div class="v">'+nf((sf["Market Cap"]||0)/100,0)+'</div></div>';
    h+='<div class="fdcell"><div class="k">P/E</div><div class="v">'+nf(sf["Stock P/E"]!=null?sf["Stock P/E"]:f.trailingPE,1)+'</div></div>';
    h+='<div class="fdcell"><div class="k">P/B</div><div class="v">'+nf((sf["Book Value"]&&sf["Current Price"])?sf["Current Price"]/sf["Book Value"]:f.priceToBook,2)+'</div></div>';
    h+='<div class="fdcell"><div class="k">div yield</div><div class="v">'+nf(sf["Dividend Yield"],2)+'%</div></div>';
    h+='<div class="fdcell"><div class="k">ROE</div><div class="v">'+nf(sf["ROE"]!=null?sf["ROE"]:(f.returnOnEquity!=null?f.returnOnEquity*100:null),1)+'%</div></div>';
    h+='<div class="fdcell"><div class="k">ROCE</div><div class="v">'+nf(sf["ROCE"],1)+'%</div></div>';
    h+='<div class="fdcell"><div class="k">face value</div><div class="v">'+nf(sf["Face Value"],1)+'</div></div>';
    h+='</div>';
    h+='<div class="fdsec">\uD83D\uDCCA Technical Analysis</div>';
    h+='<div class="fdrow"><span>RSI-14</span><b>'+nf(sc.rsi14,0)+'</b></div>';
    h+='<div class="fdrow"><span>EMA 20 / 200</span><b>'+nf(sc.ema20,1)+' / '+nf(sc.ema200,1)+'</b></div>';
    h+='<div class="fdrow"><span>Above 200-DMA</span><b class="'+(sc.above_ema200?"up":"dn")+'">'+(sc.above_ema200?"Yes":"No")+'</b></div>';
    h+='<div class="fdrow"><span>MACD hist</span><b>'+nf(sc.macd_hist,2)+'</b></div>';
    h+='<div class="fdrow"><span>Vol vs 20d avg</span><b>'+nf(sc.vol_vs_avg20,1)+'\u00d7</b></div>';
    h+='<div class="fdrow"><span>From 52w high</span><b class="dn">'+pc(sc.from_52w_high_pct)+'</b></div>';
    h+='<div class="fdrow"><span>52w H / L</span><b>'+nf(sc.high_52w,1)+' / '+nf(sc.low_52w,1)+'</b></div>';
    if(sf["Sales"]&&sf["Sales"].length){ h+='<div class="fdsec">\uD83D\uDCB9 Sales (\u20b9Cr, last 6q)</div><div class="fdrow"><span>'+sf["Sales"].slice(-6).map(function(v){return nf(v,0);}).join(" \u00b7 ")+'</span></div>'; }
    if(sf["Net Profit"]&&sf["Net Profit"].length){ h+='<div class="fdsec">\uD83D\uDCB0 Net Profit (\u20b9Cr, last 6q)</div><div class="fdrow"><span>'+sf["Net Profit"].slice(-6).map(function(v){return nf(v,0);}).join(" \u00b7 ")+'</span></div>'; }
    var card=document.createElement("div"); card.className="card funddetail"; card.style.margin="0 0 10px"; card.innerHTML=h;
    var fh=host.querySelector(".fshead"); if(fh) host.insertBefore(card, fh.nextSibling); else host.insertBefore(card, host.firstChild);
    card.querySelector(".fdx").addEventListener("click", function(){ card.remove(); });
    try{ card.scrollIntoView({behavior:"smooth",block:"start"}); }catch(_){}
  }
  function suggest(q){
    var host=document.getElementById("v-fundamentals"); if(!host) return;
    var old=host.querySelector(".fdsug"); if(old) old.remove();
    q=(q||"").toLowerCase().trim(); if(q.length<1) return;
    var keys=Object.keys(SF||{});
    var hits=keys.filter(function(k){ var n=((CI||{})[k]||{}).name||""; return k.toLowerCase().indexOf(q)>-1 || n.toLowerCase().indexOf(q)>-1; }).slice(0,6);
    if(!hits.length) return;
    var box=document.createElement("div"); box.className="fdsug card"; box.style.padding="0";
    box.innerHTML=hits.map(function(k){ return '<div class="sgr" data-sym="'+esc(k)+'"><span><b>'+esc(k)+'</b> '+esc(((CI||{})[k]||{}).name||"")+'</span><b>\u203a</b></div>'; }).join("");
    var fh=host.querySelector(".fshead"); if(fh) host.insertBefore(box, fh.nextSibling); else host.insertBefore(box, host.firstChild);
    box.querySelectorAll(".sgr").forEach(function(r){ r.addEventListener("click", function(){ var s=r.getAttribute("data-sym"); var inp=host.querySelector("input[type=search]"); if(inp) inp.value=s; box.remove(); detail(s); }); });
  }
  function wire(){
    var host=document.getElementById("v-fundamentals"); if(!host||host._fdw) return; host._fdw=1;
    var inp=host.querySelector("input[type=search]");
    if(inp){
      inp.addEventListener("input", function(){ suggest(inp.value); });
      inp.addEventListener("keydown", function(e){ if(e.key==="Enter"){ var v=inp.value.toLowerCase().trim(); var k=Object.keys(SF||{}).filter(function(x){ return x.toLowerCase()===v || ((CI||{})[x]||{}).name && ((CI||{})[x]||{}).name.toLowerCase().indexOf(v)>-1; })[0]; if(k){ var b=host.querySelector(".fdsug"); if(b) b.remove(); detail(k); } } });
    }
    host.addEventListener("click", function(e){
      var tr=e.target.closest("tbody tr"); if(!tr) return;
      var m=tr.querySelector("small.mono"); if(!m) return;
      detail(m.textContent.trim());
    }, true);
  }
  Promise.all([J("screener-fundamentals.json"),J("fundamentals.json"),J("brain-screener.json"),J("company-index.json")]).then(function(r){
    SF=(r[0]&&r[0].stocks)||{}; FUND=r[1]||{}; var b=r[2]||{}; CI=r[3]||{}; (b.stocks||[]).forEach(function(s){ BM[s.symbol]=s; });
    wire();
  });
  var n=0,iv=setInterval(function(){ wire(); if(++n>25) clearInterval(iv); },600);
  window.addEventListener("hashchange",function(){ setTimeout(wire,300); });
})();
</script>

<script>
/* ArthaSaar — round 14: Events radar = the single biggest market-moving event for India */
(function(){ "use strict";
  function base(){ return location.pathname.indexOf("/app/")>=0 ? "../data/" : "data/"; }
  function J(f){ return fetch(base()+f,{cache:"no-store"}).then(function(r){ return r.ok?r.json():null; }).catch(function(){ return null; }); }
  function esc(s){ return String(s==null?"":s).replace(/[&<>"]/g,function(c){return {"&":"&amp;","<":"&lt;",">":"&gt;",'"':"&quot;"}[c];}); }
  function dd(iso){ var p=String(iso||"").slice(0,10).split("-"); return p.length<3?String(iso||""):(p[2]+"/"+p[1]+"/"+p[0].slice(2)); }
  function row(lbl,date,title,cls){ return "<div class='zrow'><span><b>"+esc(lbl)+"</b><br><small style='color:var(--dim);font-size:10px'>"+esc(title)+"</small></span><b class='"+(cls||"")+"'>"+esc(date)+"</b></div>"; }
  var E=null;
  function build(){
    var host=document.getElementById("v-events"); if(!host||!E) return;
    var holder=host.querySelector(".as-holder"); if(!holder) return;
    var r=holder.querySelector(".radar"); if(!r) return;
    if(r._evr) return; r._evr=1;
    var kd=(E.key_dates||[]).slice().sort(function(a,b){ return String(a.date).localeCompare(String(b.date)); });
    var wk=(E.week||[]).slice().sort(function(a,b){ return String(a.date_ist+(a.time_ist||"")).localeCompare(String(b.date_ist+(b.time_ist||""))); });
    var inKd=kd.filter(function(x){ return /IND|INR/i.test(x.country); });
    var inWk=wk.filter(function(x){ return /INR|IND/i.test(x.country) && /high/i.test(x.impact||""); });
    var gKd=kd.filter(function(x){ return !/IND|INR/i.test(x.country); });
    var gWk=wk.filter(function(x){ return !/INR|IND/i.test(x.country) && /high/i.test(x.impact||""); });
    var h="<div class='rt'>\u26A1 EVENT IMPACT RADAR</div><div class='rs'>India pe sabse zyada asar karne wale events</div>";
    if(inKd[0]) h+=row("\uD83C\uDDEE\uD83C\uDDF3 "+inKd[0].title.slice(0,40), dd(inKd[0].date), inKd[0].title, "dn");
    if(inWk[0]) h+=row("\uD83C\uDDEE\uD83C\uDDF3 "+inWk[0].title.slice(0,40), dd(inWk[0].date_ist), inWk[0].title, "dn");
    if(gKd[0]) h+=row("\uD83C\uDF0D "+gKd[0].title.slice(0,40), dd(gKd[0].date), gKd[0].title, "hold");
    else if(gWk[0]) h+=row("\uD83C\uDF0D "+gWk[0].title.slice(0,40), dd(gWk[0].date_ist), gWk[0].title, "hold");
    h+="<div class='rs' style='margin-top:7px'>Rate decisions, inflation aur jobs data hi India ko sabse zyada hilate hain \u2014 FII flow aur USD/INR ke through.</div>";
    r.innerHTML=h;
  }
  J("events.json").then(function(e){ E=e||{}; build(); });
  var n=0,iv=setInterval(function(){ build(); if(++n>25) clearInterval(iv); },700);
  window.addEventListener("hashchange",function(){ setTimeout(function(){ var r=document.querySelector("#v-events .as-holder .radar"); if(r) r._evr=0; build(); },350); });
})();

<script>
/* ArthaSaar — round 16: News card = tabs + featured cards + live real feed */
(function(){ "use strict";
  function base(){ return location.pathname.indexOf("/app/")>=0 ? "../data/" : "data/"; }
  function J(f){ return fetch(base()+f,{cache:"no-store"}).then(function(r){ return r.ok?r.json():null; }).catch(function(){ return null; }); }
  function esc(s){ return String(s==null?"":s).replace(/[&<>"]/g,function(c){return {"&":"&amp;","<":"&lt;",">":"&gt;",'"':"&quot;"}[c];}); }
  var N=null,P=null;
  function ago(iso){ if(!iso) return ""; try{ var d=new Date(iso), m=(Date.now()-d.getTime())/60000; if(isNaN(m)) return String(iso).slice(0,10); if(m<60) return Math.max(1,Math.round(m))+" min ago"; if(m<1440) return Math.round(m/60)+" hr ago"; return Math.round(m/1440)+" d ago"; }catch(e){ return ""; } }
  function build(){
    var host=document.getElementById("v-news"); if(!host||!N) return;
    [].slice.call(host.querySelectorAll(".card")).forEach(function(el){ if(el.id!=="as-news-card") el.remove(); });
    if(document.getElementById("as-news-card")) return;
    var items=(N.items||[]);
    var econ=(P&&P.ind||[]).length;
    var _tc={}; items.forEach(function(x){ var t=x.topic||"News"; _tc[t]=(_tc[t]||0)+1; });
    var _topics=Object.keys(_tc).sort(function(a,b){ return _tc[b]-_tc[a]; });
    var h='<div class="ntabs"><button class="on" data-t="all">All</button>'+_topics.map(function(t){ return '<button data-t="'+esc(t)+'">'+esc(t)+'</button>'; }).join("")+'</div>';
h+='<div class="nfeedt">Latest Feed</div><div class="nfeed">';
    h+=items.map(function(x){ return '<div class="nitem" data-topic="'+esc(x.topic)+'"><span class="tag">'+esc(x.topic||"NEWS")+'</span><b><a href="'+esc(x.link)+'" target="_blank" rel="noopener">'+esc(x.title)+'</a></b><small>'+esc(x.publisher||"")+' \u00b7 '+ago(x.published)+'</small></div>'; }).join("");
    h+='</div>';
    var card=document.createElement("div"); card.id="as-news-card"; card.className="card"; card.innerHTML=h;
    var fh=host.querySelector(".fshead");
    if(fh) host.insertBefore(card, fh.nextSibling); else host.insertBefore(card, host.firstChild);
    card.querySelectorAll(".ntabs button").forEach(function(b){ b.addEventListener("click", function(){
      card.querySelectorAll(".ntabs button").forEach(function(x){x.classList.remove("on");}); b.classList.add("on");
      var t=b.getAttribute("data-t");
      card.querySelectorAll(".nitem").forEach(function(it){ it.style.display=(t==="all"||it.getAttribute("data-topic")===t)?"block":"none"; });
    });});
  }
  Promise.all([J("news.json"),J("economy-pulse.json")]).then(function(r){ N=r[0]||{}; P=r[1]||{}; build(); });
  var n=0,iv=setInterval(function(){ build(); if(++n>20) clearInterval(iv); },700);
  window.addEventListener("hashchange",function(){ setTimeout(build,300); });
})();
</script>

/* ArthaSaar — round 17: tap an index -> full-screen card of its constituent stocks + fundamentals */
(function(){ "use strict";
  function base(){ return location.pathname.indexOf("/app/")>=0 ? "../data/" : "data/"; }
  function J(f){ return fetch(base()+f,{cache:"no-store"}).then(function(r){ return r.ok?r.json():null; }).catch(function(){ return null; }); }
  function esc(s){ return String(s==null?"":s).replace(/[&<>"]/g,function(c){return {"&":"&amp;","<":"&lt;",">":"&gt;",'"':"&quot;"}[c];}); }
  function nf(x,d){ return (x==null||isNaN(x))?"—":Number(x).toLocaleString("en-IN",{maximumFractionDigits:d==null?2:d}); }
  function pc(x,d){ return (x==null||isNaN(x))?"—":(x>=0?"+":"")+Number(x).toFixed(d==null?1:d)+"%"; }
  var C=null,SF=null,BM={};
  function resolve(name){
    var n=String(name||"").toUpperCase(), L=(C&&C.lists)||{}, S=(C&&C.sectors)||{};
    if(/NEXT\s*50/.test(n)) return {k:"NIFTY NEXT 50", l:L.niftynext50};
    if(/MIDCAP\s*150/.test(n)) return {k:"NIFTY MIDCAP 150", l:L.niftymidcap150};
    if(/SMALLCAP\s*250/.test(n)) return {k:"NIFTY SMALLCAP 250", l:L.niftysmallcap250};
    if(/NIFTY\s*500/.test(n)) return {k:"NIFTY 500", l:L.nifty500};
    if(/LARGEMIDCAP\s*250/.test(n)) return {k:"NIFTY LARGEMIDCAP 250", l:(L.nifty50||[]).concat(L.niftynext50||[]).concat(L.niftymidcap150||[])};
    if(/MIDSMALLCAP\s*400/.test(n)) return {k:"NIFTY MIDSMALCAP 400", l:(L.niftymidcap150||[]).concat(L.niftysmallcap250||[])};
    if(/NIFTY\s*100/.test(n) && !/500|200/.test(n)) return {k:"NIFTY 100", l:(L.nifty50||[]).concat(L.niftynext50||[])};
    if(/NIFTY\s*50/.test(n)) return {k:"NIFTY 50", l:L.nifty50};
    var map=[["BANK","Bank"],["IT","IT"],["AUTO","Auto"],["PHARMA","Pharma"],["FMCG","FMCG"],["METAL","Metal"],["ENERGY","Energy"],["REALTY","Realty"],["MEDIA","Media"],["FINANCIAL|FIN SERV|FINNIFTY","Fin Serv"],["HEALTHCARE","Healthcare"],["CONSUMER DUR|CONS DUR","Cons Dur"],["OIL","Oil & Gas"],["INFRA","Infra"]];
    for(var i=0;i<map.length;i++){ if(new RegExp(map[i][0]).test(n) && S[map[i][1]]) return {k:"NIFTY "+map[i][1].toUpperCase(), l:S[map[i][1]]}; }
    return null;
  }
  function open(name){
    var r=resolve(name); var old=document.querySelector(".idxfs"); if(old) old.remove();
    var box=document.createElement("div"); box.className="idxfs";
    if(!r||!r.l||!r.l.length){
      box.innerHTML='<div class="ifhead"><b>'+esc(name)+'</b><button class="xbtn ifx" type="button">\u2715 CLOSE</button></div><div class="ifnote">Constituent list not available for this index in the free feed. Available: NIFTY 50 / NEXT 50 / MIDCAP 150 / SMALLCAP 250 / NIFTY 500 and the sectoral indices.</div>';
    } else {
      var list=r.l.map(function(it){ var sf=(SF||{})[it.symbol]||{}, b=BM[it.symbol]||{}; return {sym:it.symbol, co:it.company, price:b.price, chg:b.change_pct, mcap:sf["Market Cap"], pe:sf["Stock P/E"], roe:sf["ROE"], dy:sf["Dividend Yield"]}; });
      list.sort(function(a,b){ return (b.mcap||0)-(a.mcap||0); });
      var h='<div class="ifhead"><div><b>'+esc(name)+'</b><small>'+list.length+' stocks \u00b7 tap a stock for its card</small></div><button class="xbtn ifx" type="button">\u2715 CLOSE</button></div>';
      h+='<div class="ifbody"><table><thead><tr><th>Stock</th><th>Price</th><th>Day%</th><th>P/E</th><th>ROE</th></tr></thead><tbody>';
      h+=list.map(function(x){ return '<tr data-sym="'+esc(x.sym)+'"><td><b>'+esc(x.sym)+'</b><small>'+esc((x.co||"").slice(0,24))+(x.mcap?' \u00b7 \u20b9'+nf((x.mcap||0)/100,0)+'Cr':'')+(x.dy?' \u00b7 div '+nf(x.dy,2)+'%':'')+'</small></td><td>'+nf(x.price,2)+'</td><td class="'+(x.chg>=0?"up":"dn")+'">'+pc(x.chg)+'</td><td>'+nf(x.pe,1)+'</td><td>'+nf(x.roe,1)+'%</td></tr>'; }).join("");
      h+='</tbody></table></div>';
      box.innerHTML=h;
    }
    document.body.appendChild(box);
    box.querySelector(".ifx").addEventListener("click", function(){ box.remove(); });
    box.querySelectorAll("tr[data-sym]").forEach(function(tr){ tr.addEventListener("click", function(){
      var s=tr.getAttribute("data-sym"); box.remove();
      if(window.openCompanyFS){ window.openCompanyFS(s); return; }
      location.hash="#company";
    });});
  }
  function wire(){
    var tb=document.getElementById("idxBody"); if(!tb||tb._idxw) return; tb._idxw=1;
    tb.addEventListener("click", function(e){ var tr=e.target.closest("tr"); if(!tr) return; var td=tr.querySelector("td"); if(!td) return; open(td.textContent.trim()); }, true);
  }
  Promise.all([J("constituents.json"),J("screener-fundamentals.json"),J("brain-screener.json")]).then(function(r){
    C=r[0]||{}; SF=(r[1]&&r[1].stocks)||{}; var b=r[2]||{}; (b.stocks||[]).forEach(function(s){ BM[s.symbol]=s; }); wire();
  });
  var n=0,iv=setInterval(function(){ wire(); if(++n>30) clearInterval(iv); },600);
  window.addEventListener("hashchange",function(){ setTimeout(wire,300); });
})();
</script>

<script>
/* ArthaSaar — round 18: full-screen company card (summary + fundamental + technical + S/R + chart + stage + holding + news) */
(function(){ "use strict";
  function base(){ return location.pathname.indexOf("/app/")>=0 ? "../data/" : "data/"; }
  function J(f){ return fetch(base()+f,{cache:"no-store"}).then(function(r){ return r.ok?r.json():null; }).catch(function(){ return null; }); }
  function esc(s){ return String(s==null?"":s).replace(/[&<>"]/g,function(c){return {"&":"&amp;","<":"&lt;",">":"&gt;",'"':"&quot;"}[c];}); }
  function nf(x,d){ return (x==null||isNaN(x))?"—":Number(x).toLocaleString("en-IN",{maximumFractionDigits:d==null?2:d}); }
  function pc(x,d){ return (x==null||isNaN(x))?"—":(x>=0?"+":"")+Number(x).toFixed(d==null?1:d)+"%"; }
  var FUND={},SF={},BM={},CI={},CAND={},GTI={},RES=[],NEWS=[];
  function stage(sc){
    if(!sc||sc.price==null) return {t:"—",bg:"#e8e8ea",fg:"#555"};
    var a=sc.above_ema200, e20=sc.ema20, e200=sc.ema200;
    if(a && e20!=null && e200!=null && e20>e200) return {t:"STAGE 2 \u00b7 UPTREND",bg:"#cdeccd",fg:"#0a5c1e"};
    if(a) return {t:"STAGE 3 \u00b7 TOPPING",bg:"#fae6c0",fg:"#8a5a10"};
    if(e20!=null && e200!=null && e20<e200) return {t:"STAGE 4 \u00b7 DOWNTREND",bg:"#f6c3c3",fg:"#7a1010"};
    return {t:"STAGE 1 \u00b7 BASE",bg:"#e6e6ea",fg:"#555"};
  }
  function drawChart(cv, closes, prev){
    var dpr=window.devicePixelRatio||1, w=cv.clientWidth||340, h=150;
    cv.width=w*dpr; cv.height=h*dpr; cv.style.height=h+"px";
    var ctx=cv.getContext("2d"); ctx.scale(dpr,dpr); ctx.clearRect(0,0,w,h);
    if(!closes||closes.length<2) return;
    var mn=Math.min.apply(null,closes), mx=Math.max.apply(null,closes);
    if(prev!=null){ mn=Math.min(mn,prev); mx=Math.max(mx,prev); }
    var pad=8, rng=(mx-mn)||1;
    function X(i){ return pad+(w-2*pad)*i/(closes.length-1); }
    function Y(v){ return h-pad-(h-2*pad)*(v-mn)/rng; }
    if(prev!=null){ ctx.strokeStyle="#c9c9d0"; ctx.setLineDash([4,4]); ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(pad,Y(prev)); ctx.lineTo(w-pad,Y(prev)); ctx.stroke(); ctx.setLineDash([]); }
    var up=closes[closes.length-1]>=closes[0];
    ctx.strokeStyle=up?"#16a34a":"#dc2626"; ctx.lineWidth=1.8; ctx.beginPath();
    closes.forEach(function(v,i){ if(i===0) ctx.moveTo(X(i),Y(v)); else ctx.lineTo(X(i),Y(v)); });
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.font="9px monospace";
    ctx.fillStyle="rgba(255,255,255,.85)"; ctx.fillRect(pad,2,46,12); ctx.fillRect(pad,h-13,46,12);
    ctx.fillStyle="rgba(120,120,130,.95)";
    ctx.fillText(nf(mx,1),pad+1,11); ctx.fillText(nf(mn,1),pad+1,h-4);
  }
  function open(sym){
    if(!sym) return;
    sym=String(sym).toUpperCase();
    var old=document.querySelector(".cofs"); if(old) old.remove();
    var f=FUND[sym]||{}, sf=SF[sym]||{}, sc=BM[sym]||{}, ci=CI[sym]||{}, g=GTI[sym]||{}, cd=CAND[sym]||{};
    var box=document.createElement("div"); box.className="cofs";
    var h='<div class="cohead"><div><b>'+esc(ci.name||sym)+'</b><small>'+esc(sym)+' \u00b7 '+esc(ci.sector||f.sector||"")+(ci.industry||f.industry?" \u00b7 "+esc(ci.industry||f.industry):"")+'</small></div><button class="xbtn cox" type="button">\u2715 CLOSE</button></div>';
    h+='<div class="cobody">';
    /* summary */
    h+='<div class="cogrid">';
    h+='<div class="cocell"><div class="k">price</div><div class="v">'+nf(sc.price!=null?sc.price:sf["Current Price"],2)+'</div></div>';
    h+='<div class="cocell"><div class="k">day</div><div class="v '+(sc.change_pct>=0?"up":"dn")+'">'+pc(sc.change_pct)+'</div></div>';
    h+='<div class="cocell"><div class="k">mcap \u20b9Cr</div><div class="v">'+nf(((sf["Market Cap"]||0)||((f.marketCap||0)/1e7))/100,0)+'</div></div>';
    h+='<div class="cocell"><div class="k">52w high</div><div class="v">'+nf(sc.high_52w||sf["high_52w"],1)+'</div></div>';
    h+='<div class="cocell"><div class="k">52w low</div><div class="v">'+nf(sc.low_52w||sf["low_52w"],1)+'</div></div>';
    h+='<div class="cocell"><div class="k">beta</div><div class="v">'+nf(f.beta,2)+'</div></div>';
    h+='</div>';
    /* stage */
    var st=stage(sc);
    h+='<div class="cosec">\uD83D\uDCCD Stage (Wyckoff-style)</div><span class="cobadge" style="background:'+st.bg+';color:'+st.fg+'">'+esc(st.t)+'</span>';
    /* chart */
    h+='<div class="cosec">\uD83D\uDCC8 Price Chart</div>';
    if(cd["1h"]&&cd["1h"].c&&cd["1h"].c.length){ h+='<div class="card" style="padding:8px;margin:0 0 4px"><canvas id="coChart" style="width:100%;display:block"></canvas><div style="font-size:9.5px;color:var(--dim);margin-top:3px">intraday 1h \u00b7 '+cd["1h"].c.length+' bars \u00b7 prev close dashed</div></div>'; }
    else if(sc.high_52w&&sc.low_52w){ var pos=Math.max(0,Math.min(100,((sc.price-sc.low_52w)/((sc.high_52w-sc.low_52w)||1))*100)); h+='<div class="card" style="padding:10px;margin:0 0 4px"><div style="font-size:10px;color:var(--dim)">52-week range position</div><div class="cobars" style="margin-top:6px"><i style="width:'+pos+'%;background:var(--accent)"></i></div><div style="font-size:9.5px;color:var(--dim);margin-top:3px">'+nf(sc.low_52w,0)+' \u2014 '+nf(sc.high_52w,0)+' \u00b7 now '+nf(pos,0)+'% of range</div></div>'; }
    else h+='<div class="conote">Intraday chart feed covers 15 symbols only (RELIANCE, HDFCBANK, ICICIBANK, INFY, TCS, SBIN, TATASTEEL, ITC + indices) \u2014 this one is not in it.</div>';
    /* support / resistance */
    h+='<div class="cosec">\uD83D\uDEE1\uFE0F Support / Resistance</div>';
    if(g.day_zones){ h+='<div class="corow"><span>Day support (SD)</span><b class="up">\u20b9'+(g.day_zones.SD||[]).join(" \u2013 ")+'</b></div><div class="corow"><span>Day resistance (SS)</span><b class="dn">\u20b9'+(g.day_zones.SS||[]).join(" \u2013 ")+'</b></div><div class="corow"><span>Day POC</span><b>'+nf(g.day_poc,1)+'</b></div>'; if(g.week_zones) h+='<div class="corow"><span>Week support / resistance</span><b>\u20b9'+(g.week_zones.SD||[])[0]+' / \u20b9'+(g.week_zones.SS||[])[1]+'</b></div>'; }
    else if(sc.low_52w&&sc.high_52w) h+='<div class="corow"><span>Support (52w low)</span><b class="up">\u20b9'+nf(sc.low_52w,1)+'</b></div><div class="corow"><span>Resistance (52w high)</span><b class="dn">\u20b9'+nf(sc.high_52w,1)+'</b></div>';
    else h+='<div class="conote">Zone feed covers ~20 large-caps \u2014 not available for this one.</div>';
    /* fundamental */
    h+='<div class="cosec">\uD83D\uDCCA Fundamental Analysis</div>';
    h+='<div class="corow"><span>P/E (trailing)</span><b>'+nf(sf["Stock P/E"]!=null?sf["Stock P/E"]:f.trailingPE,1)+'</b></div>';
    h+='<div class="corow"><span>P/B</span><b>'+nf((sf["Book Value"]&&sf["Current Price"])?sf["Current Price"]/sf["Book Value"]:f.priceToBook,2)+'</b></div>';
    h+='<div class="corow"><span>ROE / ROCE</span><b>'+nf(sf["ROE"]!=null?sf["ROE"]:(f.returnOnEquity!=null?f.returnOnEquity*100:null),1)+'% / '+nf(sf["ROCE"],1)+'%</b></div>';
    h+='<div class="corow"><span>Book value / Face value</span><b>'+nf(sf["Book Value"],1)+' / '+nf(sf["Face Value"],1)+'</b></div>';
    h+='<div class="corow"><span>Dividend yield</span><b>'+nf(sf["Dividend Yield"]!=null?sf["Dividend Yield"]:f.dividendYield,2)+'%</b></div>';

    var cv=box.querySelector("#coChart");
    if(cv){ var cl=(cd["1h"]&&cd["1h"].c)||[]; if(cl.length) drawChart(cv, cl, cd.pc); }

<script>
/* ArthaSaar — round 21: Deep Fundamentals = computed Q-Score. Ranked quality screener + block inside the company card. */
(function(){ "use strict";
  function base(){ return location.pathname.indexOf("/app/")>=0 ? "../data/" : "data/"; }
  function J(f){ return fetch(base()+f,{cache:"no-store"}).then(function(r){ return r.ok?r.json():null; }).catch(function(){ return null; }); }
  function esc(s){ return String(s==null?"":s).replace(/[&<>"]/g,function(c){return {"&":"&amp;","<":"&lt;",">":"&gt;",'"':"&quot;"}[c];}); }
  function nf(x,d){ return (x==null||isNaN(x))?"—":Number(x).toLocaleString("en-IN",{maximumFractionDigits:d==null?2:d}); }
  var SF={},FUND={},CI={},ROWS=[];
  function qscore(sym){
    var sf=SF[sym]||{}, f=FUND[sym]||{};
    var roe=(sf["ROE"]!=null?sf["ROE"]:(f.returnOnEquity!=null?f.returnOnEquity*100:null));
    var roce=sf["ROCE"];
    var np=sf["Net Profit"]||[], sales=sf["Sales"]||[], opm=sf["OPM %"];
    if(typeof opm!=="number") opm=null;
    var dte=(f.debtToEquity!=null?f.debtToEquity/100:null);
    var dy=(sf["Dividend Yield"]!=null?sf["Dividend Yield"]:f.dividendYield);
    var pe=(sf["Stock P/E"]!=null?sf["Stock P/E"]:f.trailingPE);
    var sy=sf["Sales_yoy"], ny=sf["Net Profit_yoy"];
    var items=[
      {l:"ROE \u2265 15%", ok: roe!=null && roe>=15, v: roe!=null?nf(roe,1)+"%":null},
      {l:"ROCE \u2265 15%", ok: roce!=null && roce>=15, v: roce!=null?nf(roce,1)+"%":null},
      {l:"Net profit positive", ok: np.length>0 && np[np.length-1]>0, v: np.length?nf(np[np.length-1],0):null},
      {l:"Net profit growing YoY", ok: ny!=null && ny>0, v: ny!=null?nf(ny,1)+"%":null},
      {l:"Sales growing YoY", ok: sy!=null && sy>0, v: sy!=null?nf(sy,1)+"%":null},
      {l:"Operating margin \u2265 15%", ok: opm!=null && opm>=15, v: opm!=null?nf(opm,1)+"%":null},
      {l:"Debt / Equity \u2264 1", ok: dte!=null && dte<=1, v: dte!=null?nf(dte,2):null},
      {l:"Dividend yield \u2265 0.5%", ok: dy!=null && dy>=0.5, v: dy!=null?nf(dy,2)+"%":null},
      {l:"P/E \u2264 40", ok: pe!=null && pe>0 && pe<=40, v: pe!=null?nf(pe,1):null}
    ];
    return {score:items.filter(function(i){return i.ok;}).length, items:items};
  }
  window.__qscore=qscore;
  function badge(s){ var bg=s>=7?"#cdeccd":s>=5?"#fae6c0":"#f6c3c3", fg=s>=7?"#0a5c1e":s>=5?"#8a5a10":"#7a1010"; return '<span class="qbadge" style="background:'+bg+';color:'+fg+'">'+s+'/9</span>'; }
  function deepInto(sym){
    var body=document.querySelector(".cofs .cobody"); if(!body||body.querySelector(".codeep")) return;
    var q=qscore(sym); if(!q) return;
    var h='<div class="codeep"><div class="cosec">\uD83D\uDD2C Deep Fundamentals \u00b7 Q-Score</div>';
    h+='<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;margin-bottom:6px">'+badge(q.score)+'<span style="font-size:9.5px;color:var(--dim)">computed from screener-fundamentals \u2014 ROE, ROCE, growth, margin, debt, dividend, P/E</span></div>';
    q.items.forEach(function(i){ h+='<div class="qrow"><span>'+esc(i.l)+'</span><b class="'+(i.ok?"up":"dn")+'">'+(i.ok?"\u2713":"\u2717")+(i.v?" "+esc(i.v):"")+'</b></div>'; });
    h+='</div>';
    var el=document.createElement("div"); el.innerHTML=h; el=el.firstChild;
    var note=body.lastElementChild;
    if(note && note.className && note.className.indexOf("conote")>-1) body.insertBefore(el, note); else body.appendChild(el);
  }
  /* wrap the company card so the deep block is always added */
  function wrapFS(){
    if(!window.openCompanyFS || window.openCompanyFS._deepw) return;
    var orig=window.openCompanyFS;
    var w=function(sym){ orig(sym); setTimeout(function(){ deepInto(sym); },40); };
    w._deepw=1; window.openCompanyFS=w;
  }
  function buildDeep(){
    var host=document.getElementById("v-deepfund"); if(!host) return;
    [].slice.call(host.querySelectorAll(".kpis, .card")).forEach(function(el){ if(el.id!=="as-deep-card" && !(el.closest&&el.closest(".deepwrap"))) el.remove(); });
    if(document.getElementById("as-deep-card")){ var tbx=document.getElementById("deepBody"); if(tbx && !tbx.querySelector("tr") && ROWS.length){ var qx=document.getElementById("deepQ"); render(qx?qx.value:""); } return; }
    var wrap=document.createElement("div"); wrap.className="deepwrap";
    wrap.innerHTML='<div class="card deepsearch" style="margin-bottom:8px"><div class="dsearch-w"><input class="dsearch" id="deepQ" type="search" placeholder="Search stock name or symbol\u2026"></div></div>'+
      '<div class="deepnote">All '+ROWS.length+' stocks ranked by <b>Q-Score</b> (0\u20139) \u2014 a transparent formula on screener-fundamentals: ROE, ROCE, profit &amp; sales growth, operating margin, debt/equity, dividend yield, P/E. Tap any stock for its full card + deep fundamentals. Not investment advice.</div>'+
      '<div class="card" id="as-deep-card" style="padding:0;overflow:auto;max-height:62vh"><table><thead><tr><th>Stock</th><th>Q</th><th>ROE</th><th>ROCE</th><th>P/E</th><th>D/E</th></tr></thead><tbody id="deepBody"></tbody></table></div>';

  function pc(x,d){ return (x==null||isNaN(x))?"—":(x>=0?"+":"")+Number(x).toFixed(d==null?1:d)+"%"; }
  function usd(x){ if(x==null||isNaN(x)) return "—"; if(Math.abs(x)>=1e12) return "$"+nf(x/1e12,2)+"T"; if(Math.abs(x)>=1e9) return "$"+nf(x/1e9,2)+"B"; if(Math.abs(x)>=1e6) return "$"+nf(x/1e6,2)+"M"; return "$"+nf(x,2); }
  var C=null, CAND={};
  function drawChart(cv, closes, prev){
    var dpr=window.devicePixelRatio||1, w=cv.clientWidth||340, h=140;
    cv.width=w*dpr; cv.height=h*dpr; cv.style.height=h+"px";
    var ctx=cv.getContext("2d"); ctx.scale(dpr,dpr); ctx.clearRect(0,0,w,h);
    if(!closes||closes.length<2) return;
    var mn=Math.min.apply(null,closes), mx=Math.max.apply(null,closes);
    if(prev!=null){ mn=Math.min(mn,prev); mx=Math.max(mx,prev); }
    var pad=8, rng=(mx-mn)||1;
    function X(i){ return pad+(w-2*pad)*i/(closes.length-1); }
    function Y(v){ return h-pad-(h-2*pad)*(v-mn)/rng; }
    if(prev!=null){ ctx.strokeStyle="#c9c9d0"; ctx.setLineDash([4,4]); ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(pad,Y(prev)); ctx.lineTo(w-pad,Y(prev)); ctx.stroke(); ctx.setLineDash([]); }
    var up=closes[closes.length-1]>=closes[0];
    ctx.strokeStyle=up?"#16a34a":"#dc2626"; ctx.lineWidth=1.8; ctx.beginPath();
    closes.forEach(function(v,i){ if(i===0) ctx.moveTo(X(i),Y(v)); else ctx.lineTo(X(i),Y(v)); });
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.font="9px monospace"; ctx.fillStyle="rgba(255,255,255,.85)"; ctx.fillRect(pad,2,58,12); ctx.fillRect(pad,h-13,58,12);
    ctx.fillStyle="rgba(120,120,130,.95)"; ctx.fillText(nf(mx,0),pad+1,11); ctx.fillText(nf(mn,0),pad+1,h-4);
  }
  function open(sym){

    h+='<div class="crcell"><div class="k">7d</div><div class="v '+(c.chg_7d_pct>=0?"up":"dn")+'">'+pc(c.chg_7d_pct)+'</div></div>';
    h+='<div class="crcell"><div class="k">30d</div><div class="v '+(c.chg_30d_pct>=0?"up":"dn")+'">'+pc(c.chg_30d_pct)+'</div></div>';

    h+='</div>';

    h+='<div class="crsec">\uD83D\uDCC8 Performance</div>';
    var per=[["24h",c.chg_24h_pct],["7d",c.chg_7d_pct],["30d",c.chg_30d_pct]];
    var mx=0; per.forEach(function(p){ if(p[1]!=null) mx=Math.max(mx,Math.abs(p[1])); }); mx=mx||1;

<script>
/* ArthaSaar — round 24b: Charts = live intraday candles + 4-timeframe panel (5m/15m/30m/4h) */
(function(){ "use strict";
  function base(){ return location.pathname.indexOf("/app/")>=0 ? "../data/" : "data/"; }
  function J(f){ return fetch(base()+f,{cache:"no-store"}).then(function(r){ return r.ok?r.json():null; }).catch(function(){ return null; }); }
  function nf(x,d){ return (x==null||isNaN(x))?"—":Number(x).toLocaleString("en-IN",{maximumFractionDigits:d==null?2:d}); }
  var SYMS=null, cur=null, tf="15m";
  function agg(ser,k){
    if(!ser||!ser.c||!ser.c.length) return null;
    var o={t:[],o:[],h:[],l:[],c:[],v:[]};
    for(var i=0;i<ser.c.length;i+=k){
      var e=Math.min(i+k,ser.c.length);
      o.t.push(ser.t[i]); o.o.push(ser.o[i]); o.c.push(ser.c[e-1]);
      o.h.push(Math.max.apply(null,ser.h.slice(i,e))); o.l.push(Math.min.apply(null,ser.l.slice(i,e)));
      o.v.push(ser.v?ser.v.slice(i,e).reduce(function(a,b){return a+b;},0):0);
    }
    return o;
  }
  function seriesFor(sym,label){
    var o=SYMS[sym]||{};
    if(label==="30m") return agg(o["15m"],2)||agg(o["5m"],6);
    if(label==="4h") return agg(o["1h"],4);
    return o[label]||o["15m"]||o["1h"]||o["5m"];
  }
  function draw(cv, o, h){
    var dpr=window.devicePixelRatio||1, w=cv.clientWidth||160; h=h||240;
    cv.width=w*dpr; cv.height=h*dpr; cv.style.height=h+"px";
    var ctx=cv.getContext("2d"); ctx.scale(dpr,dpr); ctx.clearRect(0,0,w,h);
    var n=(o.c||[]).length; if(!n) return;
    var mn=Math.min.apply(null,o.l), mx=Math.max.apply(null,o.h); var pad=6, rng=(mx-mn)||1;
    function X(i){ return pad+(w-2*pad)*(i+0.5)/n; }
    function Y(v){ return h-pad-(h-2*pad)*(v-mn)/rng; }
    var bw=Math.max(1,(w-2*pad)/n*0.62);
    for(var i=0;i<n;i++){
      var up=o.c[i]>=o.o[i]; ctx.strokeStyle=up?"#16a34a":"#dc2626"; ctx.fillStyle=up?"#16a34a":"#dc2626";
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(X(i),Y(o.h[i])); ctx.lineTo(X(i),Y(o.l[i])); ctx.stroke();
      var y1=Y(Math.max(o.o[i],o.c[i])), y2=Y(Math.min(o.o[i],o.c[i]));
      ctx.fillRect(X(i)-bw/2, y1, bw, Math.max(1,y2-y1));
    }
    ctx.font="8px monospace"; ctx.fillStyle="rgba(255,255,255,.85)"; ctx.fillRect(pad,1,52,11); ctx.fillRect(pad,h-12,52,11);
    ctx.fillStyle="rgba(120,120,130,.95)"; ctx.fillText(nf(mx,1),pad+1,9); ctx.fillText(nf(mn,1),pad+1,h-3);
  }
  function render(){
    var host=document.getElementById("v-gticharts"); if(!host||!SYMS||!cur) return;
    var o=SYMS[cur]||{}, ser=seriesFor(cur,tf), pc=o.pc;
    var last=ser&&ser.c.length?ser.c[ser.c.length-1]:null;
    var chg=(pc&&last!=null)?((last-pc)/pc*100):null;

    var meta=document.getElementById("chMeta");
    if(meta&&ser) meta.textContent=ser.c.length+" bars \u00b7 last C "+nf(last,2)+" \u00b7 prev close "+nf(pc,2)+" \u00b7 30m/4h are aggregated from 15m/1h";
    var cv=document.getElementById("chCanvas"); if(cv&&ser) draw(cv, ser, 230);
    ["5m","15m","30m","4h"].forEach(function(lb){
      var c2=document.getElementById("pc-"+lb); if(!c2) return;
      var s2=seriesFor(cur,lb); if(s2) draw(c2, s2, 110);
      var l2=document.getElementById("pl-"+lb); if(l2&&s2&&s2.c.length){ var lc=s2.c[s2.c.length-1], lch=pc?((lc-pc)/pc*100):null; l2.innerHTML='<span>'+lb+'</span><span class="'+(lch>=0?"up":"dn")+'">'+(lch==null?"":(lch>=0?"+":"")+lch.toFixed(2)+"%")+'</span>'; }
    });
  }

<script>
/* ArthaSaar — round 29: daily chart history (5Y, per-symbol) in Charts + company card */
(function(){ "use strict";
  function base(){ return location.pathname.indexOf("/app/")>=0 ? "../data/" : "data/"; }
  function J(f){ return fetch(base()+f,{cache:"no-store"}).then(function(r){ return r.ok?r.json():null; }).catch(function(){ return null; }); }
  function nf(x,d){ return (x==null||isNaN(x))?"—":Number(x).toLocaleString("en-IN",{maximumFractionDigits:d==null?2:d}); }
  function ema(a,n){ var k=2/(n+1), e=[], p=null; for(var i=0;i<a.length;i++){ p = p==null? a[i] : a[i]*k + p*(1-k); e.push(p);} return e; }
  function rsi(a,n){ var r=[], g=0,l=0; for(var i=1;i<a.length;i++){ var d=a[i]-a[i-1]; var up=d>0?d:0, dn=d<0?-d:0; if(i<=n){ g+=up; l+=dn; if(i===n){ g/=n; l/=n; r[n]=l===0?100:100-100/(1+g/l);} else r.push(null);} else { g=(g*(n-1)+up)/n; l=(l*(n-1)+dn)/n; r[i]=l===0?100:100-100/(1+g/l);} } return r; }
  var HC=null, cur=null, rng="1Y", ROWS={"1Y":252,"3Y":756,"5Y":1300};
  function slice(o,label){ var n=o.c.length; var k=ROWS[label]||n; var s=Math.max(0,n-k); return {d:o.d.slice(s),o:o.o.slice(s),h:o.h.slice(s),l:o.l.slice(s),c:o.c.slice(s),v:o.v.slice(s)}; }
  function drawDaily(cv, o, h){
    var dpr=window.devicePixelRatio||1, w=cv.clientWidth||340; h=h||230;
    cv.width=w*dpr; cv.height=h*dpr; cv.style.height=h+"px";
    var ctx=cv.getContext("2d"); ctx.scale(dpr,dpr); ctx.clearRect(0,0,w,h);
    var n=o.c.length; if(!n) return;
    var pad=6, e20=ema(o.c,20), e200=ema(o.c,Math.min(200,n-1)), rr=rsi(o.c,14);
    var mn=Math.min.apply(null,o.l), mx=Math.max.apply(null,o.h); var rngv=(mx-mn)||1;
    function X(i){ return pad+(w-2*pad)*(i+0.5)/n; }
    function Y(v){ return h-pad-(h-2*pad)*(v-mn)/rngv; }
    var bw=Math.max(1,(w-2*pad)/n*0.66);
    for(var i=0;i<n;i++){ var up=o.c[i]>=o.o[i]; ctx.strokeStyle=up?"#16a34a":"#dc2626"; ctx.fillStyle=up?"#16a34a":"#dc2626";
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(X(i),Y(o.h[i])); ctx.lineTo(X(i),Y(o.l[i])); ctx.stroke();
      var y1=Y(Math.max(o.o[i],o.c[i])), y2=Y(Math.min(o.o[i],o.c[i])); ctx.fillRect(X(i)-bw/2,y1,bw,Math.max(1,y2-y1)); }
    ctx.lineWidth=1.3; ctx.strokeStyle="#3b82f6"; ctx.beginPath(); e20.forEach(function(v,i){ i?ctx.lineTo(X(i),Y(v)):ctx.moveTo(X(i),Y(v)); }); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.strokeStyle="#f59e0b"; ctx.beginPath(); e200.forEach(function(v,i){ i?ctx.lineTo(X(i),Y(v)):ctx.moveTo(X(i),Y(v)); }); ctx.stroke();
    /* rsi strip */
    var ry=h-30, rh=26; ctx.strokeStyle="rgba(148,163,184,.5)"; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(pad,ry+rh*0.3); ctx.lineTo(w-pad,ry+rh*0.3); ctx.moveTo(pad,ry+rh*0.7); ctx.lineTo(w-pad,ry+rh*0.7); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.strokeStyle="#8b5cf6"; ctx.beginPath(); var started=false;
    rr.forEach(function(v,i){ if(v==null) return; var yy=ry+rh*(1-Math.max(0,Math.min(100,v))/100); if(!started){ctx.moveTo(X(i),yy);started=true;} else ctx.lineTo(X(i),yy); }); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.font="8px monospace"; ctx.fillStyle="rgba(255,255,255,.85)"; ctx.fillRect(pad,1,56,11); ctx.fillRect(pad,h-13,56,11);
    ctx.fillStyle="rgba(120,120,130,.95)"; ctx.fillText(nf(mx,1),pad+1,9); ctx.fillText(nf(mn,1),pad+1,h-3);
    ctx.fillStyle="#8b5cf6"; ctx.fillText("RSI",pad+2,ry+9);
  }
  function buildChart(){
    var host=document.getElementById("v-gticharts"); if(!host||!HC) return;
    if(document.getElementById("as-hist-card")) return;
    var syms=Object.keys(HC.symbols||{});
    var h='<div class="hhead" id="hHead"></div>';
    h+='<div class="hchips">'+syms.map(function(s){ return '<span class="chip'+(s===(cur||syms[0])?" on":"")+'" data-s="'+s+'">'+s+'</span>'; }).join("")+'</div>';
    h+='<div class="hrange"><button data-r="1Y" class="on">1Y</button><button data-r="3Y">3Y</button><button data-r="5Y">5Y</button></div>';
    h+='<div class="card" style="padding:8px"><canvas id="hCanvas"></canvas></div>';
    h+='<div class="hleg"><span><i style="background:#3b82f6"></i>EMA 20</span><span><i style="background:#f59e0b"></i>EMA 200</span><span><i style="background:#8b5cf6"></i>RSI 14</span></div>';
    h+='<div class="hmeta" id="hMeta"></div>';
    h+='<div class="hmeta">Daily candles (5 years) from data/history-core.json \u2014 Nifty 50 + indices, refreshed daily after close by the chart-history workflow. Full history since listing lives in the release archive.</div>';
    var card=document.createElement("div"); card.id="as-hist-card"; card.className="card"; card.style.marginTop="10px"; card.innerHTML=h;
    host.appendChild(card);
    card.querySelectorAll(".chip").forEach(function(c){ c.addEventListener("click", function(){ cur=c.getAttribute("data-s"); card.querySelectorAll(".chip").forEach(function(x){x.classList.remove("on");}); c.classList.add("on"); render(); }); });
    card.querySelectorAll(".hrange button").forEach(function(b){ b.addEventListener("click", function(){ rng=b.getAttribute("data-r"); card.querySelectorAll(".hrange button").forEach(function(x){x.classList.remove("on");}); b.classList.add("on"); render(); }); });
    if(!cur) cur=syms[0];
    render();
    window.addEventListener("resize", function(){ setTimeout(render,200); });
  }
  function render(){
    if(!HC||!cur) return;
    var o=HC.symbols[cur]; if(!o) return;
    var s=slice(o,rng);
    var last=s.c[s.c.length-1], first=s.c[0];
    var chg=first?((last-first)/first*100):null;
    var hh=document.getElementById("hHead"); if(hh) hh.innerHTML='<b>'+cur+' \u00b7 daily \u00b7 '+rng+'</b><span class="'+(chg>=0?"up":"dn")+'" style="font-weight:800">'+(chg==null?"":(chg>=0?"+":"")+chg.toFixed(2)+"%")+'</span>';
    var mt=document.getElementById("hMeta"); if(mt) mt.textContent=s.c.length+" bars \u00b7 "+String(s.d[0])+" \u2192 "+String(s.d[s.d.length-1])+" \u00b7 last "+nf(last,2);
    var cv=document.getElementById("hCanvas"); if(cv) drawDaily(cv, s, 230);
  }
  function hookCompany(){
    if(!window.openCompanyFS || window.openCompanyFS._histw) return;
    var orig=window.openCompanyFS;
    var w=function(sym){ orig(sym); setTimeout(function(){
      var body=document.querySelector(".cofs .cobody"); if(!body||body.querySelector(".cohist")||!HC) return;
      var o=HC.symbols[String(sym).toUpperCase()]; if(!o) return;
      var s=slice(o,"5Y");
      var el=document.createElement("div"); el.className="cohist";
      el.innerHTML='<div class="cosec">\uD83D\uDCC8 Daily Chart \u00b7 5Y \u00b7 EMA20/200 \u00b7 RSI</div><div class="card" style="padding:8px"><canvas id="coHist"></canvas></div><div class="hmeta">'+s.c.length+' daily bars \u00b7 '+String(s.d[0])+' \u2192 '+String(s.d[s.d.length-1])+'</div>';
      var note=body.lastElementChild;
      if(note && note.className && String(note.className).indexOf("conote")>-1) body.insertBefore(el, note); else body.appendChild(el);
      var cv=el.querySelector("#coHist"); if(cv) drawDaily(cv, s, 200);
    },60); };
    w._histw=1; window.openCompanyFS=w;
  }
  J("history-core.json").then(function(d){ HC=d||{}; buildChart(); hookCompany(); });
