/* ict.js — ICT Terminal (GTI section): PDH/PDL · Weekly/Monthly H/L · Asia box
   · London/NY kill zones · Order Blocks · FVG · BOS/CHOCH — 100% free, client-side.
   Data: data/candles.json (Yahoo free) — 5m aaj, 15m 5 din, 1h 1 mahina.
   Asia box + NY KZ sirf 24h market (BTC) pe poore dikhte hain — NSE raat ko band.
   London KZ (12:30-15:30 IST) NSE me bhi dikhta hai. Read hai, tip nahi. */
(function () {
  "use strict";

  /* ---------------- helpers ---------------- */
  function esc(s) { if (s == null) { s = ""; } return String(s)
    .replace(/[&<>"']/g, function (c) { return "&#" + c.charCodeAt(0) + ";"; }); }
  function n2(x) { return Number(x).toLocaleString("en-IN",
    { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 }); }
  function pct(x) { return (x >= 0 ? "+" : "\u2212") + Math.abs(x).toFixed(2) + "%"; }

  /* IST wall-clock (data Yahoo epoch sec; +5:30 offset se UTC getters = IST) */
  function istDate(t) { return new Date((t + 19800) * 1000); }
  function istKey(t) { var d = istDate(t);
    return d.getUTCFullYear() * 10000 + (d.getUTCMonth() + 1) * 100 + d.getUTCDate(); }
  function istMin(t) { var d = istDate(t); return d.getUTCHours() * 60 + d.getUTCMinutes(); }
  function weekKeyOfKey(k) { /* k = yyyymmdd -> us Monday ka key */
    var y = Math.floor(k / 10000), m = Math.floor(k / 100) % 100, d = k % 100;
    var ms = Date.UTC(y, m - 1, d), dow = new Date(ms).getUTCDay();
    var mon = new Date(ms - ((dow + 6) % 7) * 86400000);
    return mon.getUTCFullYear() * 10000 + (mon.getUTCMonth() + 1) * 100 + mon.getUTCDate();
  }
  function istStr(t) { var d = istDate(t); var M = ["Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun",
    "Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec"];
    return d.getUTCDate() + " " + M[d.getUTCMonth()] + " " +
      ("0" + d.getUTCHours()).slice(-2) + ":" + ("0" + d.getUTCMinutes()).slice(-2); }

  /* ---------------- HTF levels (1h bars se: prev day / prev week / month H-L) ---------------- */
  function htfLevels(d, now) {
    if (!d || !d.t || d.t.length < 2) return null;
    var todayK = istKey(now == null ? Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) : now);
    var days = [], cur = null;
    for (var i = 0; i < d.t.length; i++) {
      var k = istKey(d.t[i]);
      if (cur && cur.k === k) { if (d.h[i] > cur.h) cur.h = d.h[i]; if (d.l[i] < cur.l) cur.l = d.l[i]; }
      else { cur = { k: k, h: d.h[i], l: d.l[i] }; days.push(cur); }
    }
    /* PDH/PDL = aakhri COMPLETE session (weekend/baad-e-close me wahi prev hai;
       live session chal rahi ho to usse pehle wala) */
    var lastD = days[days.length - 1];
    var lastComplete = lastD.k !== todayK || istMin(d.t[d.t.length - 1]) >= 15 * 60 + 25;
    var pd = lastComplete ? lastD : (days.length >= 2 ? days[days.length - 2] : null);
    var weeks = [], cw = null;
    for (var j = 0; j < days.length; j++) {
      var wk = weekKeyOfKey(days[j].k);
      if (cw && cw.k === wk) { if (days[j].h > cw.h) cw.h = days[j].h; if (days[j].l < cw.l) cw.l = days[j].l; }
      else { cw = { k: wk, h: days[j].h, l: days[j].l }; weeks.push(cw); }
    }
    var pw = weeks.length >= 2 ? weeks[weeks.length - 2] : null;
    var cw2 = weeks[weeks.length - 1];
    var months = [], cm = null;
    for (var q = 0; q < days.length; q++) {
      var mk = Math.floor(days[q].k / 100);
      if (cm && cm.k === mk) { if (days[q].h > cm.h) cm.h = days[q].h; if (days[q].l < cm.l) cm.l = days[q].l; }
      else { cm = { k: mk, h: days[q].h, l: days[q].l }; months.push(cm); }
    }
    var cmo = months[months.length - 1];
    return { pdh: pd && pd.h, pdl: pd && pd.l, pwh: pw && pw.h, pwl: pw && pw.l,
      wh: cw2 && cw2.h, wl: cw2 && cw2.l, mh: cmo && cmo.h, ml: cmo && cmo.l };
  }

  /* ---------------- sessions (displayed bars se) ---------------- */
  /* Asia: 21:15-06:30 IST (evening part aagle din ki session me count) */
  function asiaSessions(d) {
    var out = [], cur = null;
    for (var i = 0; i < d.t.length; i++) {
      var m = istMin(d.t[i]);
      var ok = m >= 1275 || m < 390;
      if (!ok) { cur = null; continue; }
      var k = istKey(d.t[i] + (m >= 1275 ? 86400 : 0));
      if (cur && cur.k === k) {
        if (d.h[i] > cur.h) cur.h = d.h[i];
        if (d.l[i] < cur.l) cur.l = d.l[i];
        cur.i1 = i;
      } else { cur = { k: k, i0: i, i1: i, h: d.h[i], l: d.l[i] }; out.push(cur); }
    }
    return out.filter(function (s) { return s.i1 > s.i0; });
  }
  /* Kill zones: LDN 12:30-15:30, NY 17:30-20:30 IST */
  function kzBands(d) {
    var out = [], cur = null;
    for (var i = 0; i < d.t.length; i++) {
      var m = istMin(d.t[i]), ty = 0;
      if (m >= 750 && m < 930) ty = 1;
      else if (m >= 1050 && m < 1230) ty = 2;
      if (!ty) { cur = null; continue; }
      var k = ty * 100000000 + istKey(d.t[i]);
      if (cur && cur.k === k) { cur.i1 = i; }
      else { cur = { k: k, ty: ty, i0: i, i1: i }; out.push(cur); }
    }
    return out;
  }

  /* ---------------- market structure (BOS / CHOCH) ---------------- */
  function detectStructure(d) {
    var n = d.t.length, k = 3, swings = [];
    for (var i = k; i < n - k; i++) {
      var isH = true, isL = true;
      for (var j = 1; j <= k; j++) {
        if (d.h[i] < d.h[i - j] || d.h[i] < d.h[i + j]) isH = false;
        if (d.l[i] > d.l[i - j] || d.l[i] > d.l[i + j]) isL = false;
      }
      if (isH) swings.push({ i: i, price: d.h[i], type: 1, ci: i + k });
      if (isL) swings.push({ i: i, price: d.l[i], type: -1, ci: i + k });
    }
    swings.sort(function (a, b) { return a.ci - b.ci; });
    var events = [], trend = 0, sh = null, sl = null, p = 0;
    for (var b = 0; b < n; b++) {
      while (p < swings.length && swings[p].ci <= b) {
        var s = swings[p++];
        if (s.type === 1) { if (!sh || s.i > sh.i) sh = s; }
        else { if (!sl || s.i > sl.i) sl = s; }
      }
      if (sh && d.c[b] > sh.price) {
        events.push({ i: b, t: d.t[b], type: trend === -1 ? "CHOCH" : "BOS", dir: 1, level: sh.price, si: sh.i });
        trend = 1; sh = null;
      }
      if (sl && d.c[b] < sl.price) {
        events.push({ i: b, t: d.t[b], type: trend === 1 ? "CHOCH" : "BOS", dir: -1, level: sl.price, si: sl.i });
        trend = -1; sl = null;
      }
    }
    return { events: events, trend: trend, sh: sh, sl: sl };
  }

  /* ---------------- fair value gaps ---------------- */
  function findFVG(d) {
    var out = [], n = d.t.length;
    for (var i = 2; i < n; i++) {
      var g = null;
      if (d.l[i] > d.h[i - 2]) g = { dir: 1, bot: d.h[i - 2], top: d.l[i] };
      else if (d.h[i] < d.l[i - 2]) g = { dir: -1, bot: d.h[i], top: d.l[i - 2] };
      if (!g) continue;
      g.i0 = i - 1; g.i1 = n - 1; g.open = true; g.touched = false;
      for (var j = i + 1; j < n; j++) {
        if (g.dir === 1) {
          if (d.l[j] <= g.bot) { g.open = false; g.i1 = j; break; }
          if (d.l[j] < g.top) g.touched = true;
        } else {
          if (d.h[j] >= g.top) { g.open = false; g.i1 = j; break; }
          if (d.h[j] > g.bot) g.touched = true;
        }
      }
      if (g.top > g.bot) out.push(g);
    }
    return out;
  }

  /* ---------------- order blocks (structure break ki leg se) ---------------- */
  function findOB(d, st) {
    var out = [], evs = st.events, n = d.t.length;
    for (var e = evs.length - 1; e >= 0 && out.length < 8; e--) {
      var ev = evs[e], m = -1;
      for (var i = ev.si; i <= ev.i; i++) {
        if (ev.dir === 1) { if (m < 0 || d.l[i] < d.l[m] || (d.l[i] === d.l[m] && d.c[i] < d.o[i])) m = i; }
        else { if (m < 0 || d.h[i] > d.h[m] || (d.h[i] === d.h[m] && d.c[i] > d.o[i])) m = i; }
      }
      if (m < 0) continue;
      var lo, hi;
      if (ev.dir === 1) { lo = d.l[m]; hi = Math.max(d.o[m], d.c[m]); }
      else { hi = d.h[m]; lo = Math.min(d.o[m], d.c[m]); }
      if (hi <= lo) continue;
      var ob = { dir: ev.dir, i0: m, i1: n - 1, lo: lo, hi: hi, active: true };
      for (var j = ev.i + 1; j < n; j++) {
        if (ev.dir === 1 && d.c[j] < lo) { ob.active = false; ob.i1 = j; break; }
        if (ev.dir === -1 && d.c[j] > hi) { ob.active = false; ob.i1 = j; break; }
      }
      out.push(ob);
    }
    return out;
  }

  /* node tests ke liye (browser me module undefined) */
  if (typeof module !== "undefined" && module.exports) {
    module.exports = { istMin: istMin, istKey: istKey, htfLevels: htfLevels,
      asiaSessions: asiaSessions, kzBands: kzBands, detectStructure: detectStructure,
      findFVG: findFVG, findOB: findOB, istStr: istStr };
    return;
  }

  /* ================= browser UI ================= */
  var DATA = null, cur = { sym: "NIFTY", iv: "15m" };
  var chart = null, ser = null, ov = null, octx = null, built = false, libOk = false, libTried = false;
  var curBars = null, curSt = null, curFvg = null, curOb = null, curAsia = null, curKz = null, curHtf = null;
  var TOG = { lvl: 1, wk: 1, mo: 1, ses: 1, ob: 1, fvg: 1, st: 1 };
  var IVS = ["5m", "15m", "1h"];
  var UP = "#34d399", DN = "#ff8b8b";

  try {
    var stt = JSON.parse(window.localStorage.getItem("ictog") || "");
    for (var q in stt) if (stt.hasOwnProperty(q) && q in TOG) TOG[q] = stt[q] ? 1 : 0;
  } catch (e) {}
  function saveTog() { try { window.localStorage.setItem("ictog", JSON.stringify(TOG)); } catch (e) {} }

  function loadLib(cb) {
    if (libOk || typeof window.LightweightCharts !== "undefined") { libOk = true; return cb(true); }
    if (libTried) return cb(false);
    libTried = true;
    var urls = [
      "https://unpkg.com/lightweight-charts@4.2.3/dist/lightweight-charts.standalone.production.js",
      "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/lightweight-charts@4.2.3/dist/lightweight-charts.standalone.production.js"
    ];
    (function tryUrl(k) {
      if (k >= urls.length) return cb(false);
      var s = document.createElement("script");
      s.src = urls[k];
      s.onload = function () { libOk = true; cb(true); };
      s.onerror = function () { tryUrl(k + 1); };
      document.head.appendChild(s);
    })(0);
  }

  function lineBox(l, r, cls) {
    return '<div class="note" style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between">' +
      '<span>' + l + '</span><b style="' + (cls ? "color:" + cls : "") + '">' + r + '</b></div>';
  }

  function panel() {
    var el = document.getElementById("ictRead");
    if (!el) return;
    var d = curBars, n = d.t.length, last = d.c[n - 1];
    var h = "";
    /* structure */
    var evs = curSt.events, lastEv = evs.length ? evs[evs.length - 1] : null;
    var tr = curSt.trend === 1 ? ["Bullish", UP] : curSt.trend === -1 ? ["Bearish", DN] : ["Range", "#d4af37"];
    h += lineBox("Structure (" + esc(cur.iv) + ")",
      esc(tr[0]) + (lastEv ? " \u2014 last " + esc(lastEv.type) +
        (lastEv.dir === 1 ? "\u2191" : "\u2193") + " " + n2(lastEv.level) +
        " (" + esc(istStr(lastEv.t)) + ")" : ""), tr[1]);
    /* HTF levels */
    var hf = curHtf;
    if (hf) {
      function dst(v) { return v ? pct((last - v) / v * 100) : "\u2014"; }
      if (hf.pdh) h += lineBox('<b style="color:#f87171">PDH</b> (pichla din H)', n2(hf.pdh) + " \u00b7 " + dst(hf.pdh), "#f87171");
      if (hf.pdl) h += lineBox('<b style="color:#60a5fa">PDL</b> (pichla din L)', n2(hf.pdl) + " \u00b7 " + dst(hf.pdl), "#60a5fa");
      if (hf.pwh) h += lineBox('<b style="color:#fbbf24">PWH / PWL</b>', n2(hf.pwh) + " / " + n2(hf.pwl), "#fbbf24");
      if (hf.wh) h += lineBox('<b style="color:#b8860b">WH / WL</b> (chalu hafta)', n2(hf.wh) + " / " + n2(hf.wl), "#b8860b");
      if (hf.mh) h += lineBox('<b style="color:#c084fc">MH / ML</b> (chalu mahina)', n2(hf.mh) + " / " + n2(hf.ml), "#c084fc");
    }
    /* FVG */
    var open = curFvg.filter(function (g) { return g.open; });
    var above = open.filter(function (g) { return g.bot > last; });
    var below = open.filter(function (g) { return g.top < last; });
    h += lineBox("Open FVGs", open.length + " (upar " + above.length + " \u00b7 neeche " + below.length + ")",
      open.length ? "#34d399" : null);
    var minA = null, maxB = null, iA = 0, iB = 0;
    for (var g2 = 0; g2 < open.length; g2++) {
      if (open[g2].bot > last && (minA == null || open[g2].bot < minA)) { minA = open[g2].bot; iA = g2; }
      if (open[g2].top < last && (maxB == null || open[g2].top > maxB)) { maxB = open[g2].top; iB = g2; }
    }
    if (minA != null) h += lineBox("\u00b7 nearest FVG upar", n2(open[iA].bot) + " \u2013 " + n2(open[iA].top), UP);
    if (maxB != null) h += lineBox("\u00b7 nearest FVG neeche", n2(open[iB].bot) + " \u2013 " + n2(open[iB].top), DN);
    /* OB */
    var act = curOb.filter(function (o) { return o.active; });

    h += lineBox("Active Order Blocks", act.length + (act.length ? " (bull " +

    var moA = null, moB = null, jA = 0, jB = 0;
    for (var o2 = 0; o2 < act.length; o2++) {

    /* asia */
    if (curAsia.length) {

  /* ---------------- chart + overlay ---------------- */
  function sizeCanvas() {
    var DPR = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
    var w = ov.clientWidth, hh = ov.clientHeight;
    ov.width = Math.round(w * DPR); ov.height = Math.round(hh * DPR);
    octx.setTransform(DPR, 0, 0, DPR, 0, 0);
  }
  function draw() {
    if (!chart || !ser || !octx || !curBars) return;
    var w = ov.clientWidth, hh = ov.clientHeight, n = curBars.t.length;
    octx.clearRect(0, 0, w, hh);
    function X(i) {
      try {
        var vr = chart.timeScale().getVisibleLogicalRange();
        if (!vr) return null;
        var li = Math.max(Math.floor(vr.from), Math.min(Math.ceil(vr.to), i));
        return chart.timeScale().logicalToCoordinate(li);
      } catch (e) { return null; }
    }
    function Y(p) { try { return ser.priceToCoordinate(p); } catch (e) { return null; } }
    function rect(x1, y1, x2, y2, fill, stroke, label, lcol) {
      if (x1 == null || x2 == null || y1 == null || y2 == null) return;
      if (x2 < x1) { var t = x1; x1 = x2; x2 = t; }
      if (y2 < y1) { var t2 = y1; y1 = y2; y2 = t2; }
      if (x2 - x1 < 2) x2 = x1 + 2;
      octx.fillStyle = fill; octx.fillRect(x1, y1, x2 - x1, y2 - y1);
      octx.strokeStyle = stroke; octx.lineWidth = 1;
      octx.strokeRect(x1 + .5, y1 + .5, x2 - x1 - 1, y2 - y1 - 1);
      if (label) { octx.fillStyle = lcol || stroke;
        octx.font = "10px ui-monospace,Menlo,monospace"; octx.fillText(label, x1 + 4, y1 + 11); }
    }
    function dashLine(x1, y, x2, col) {
      if (y == null || x1 == null || x2 == null || x2 <= x1) return;
      octx.strokeStyle = col; octx.lineWidth = 1; octx.setLineDash([4, 3]);
      octx.beginPath(); octx.moveTo(x1, y + .5); octx.lineTo(x2, y + .5); octx.stroke();
      octx.setLineDash([]);
    }
    /* kill zone bands (poore height pe) */
    if (TOG.ses && curKz) {
      for (var i = 0; i < curKz.length; i++) {
        var b = curKz[i], x1 = X(b.i0), x2 = X(b.i1);
        if (x1 == null && x2 == null) continue;
        if (x1 == null) x1 = 0; if (x2 == null) x2 = w;
        if (x2 <= x1) continue;
        var kc = b.ty === 1 ? "rgba(52,211,153,.07)" : "rgba(255,184,77,.07)";
        var kl = b.ty === 1 ? "#34d399" : "#ffb84d";
        octx.fillStyle = kc; octx.fillRect(x1, 0, x2 - x1, hh);
        octx.fillStyle = kl; octx.font = "10px ui-monospace,Menlo,monospace";
        octx.fillText(b.ty === 1 ? "LDN KZ" : "NY KZ", x1 + 4, 12);
      }
    }
    /* asia boxes */
    if (TOG.ses && curAsia) {
      for (var a2 = Math.max(0, curAsia.length - 3); a2 < curAsia.length; a2++) {
        var s2 = curAsia[a2], ax1 = X(s2.i0), ax2 = X(s2.i1);
        var ay1 = Y(s2.h), ay2 = Y(s2.l);
        if (ay1 != null && ay2 != null) {
          if (ax1 == null) ax1 = 0;
          rect(ax1, ay1, ax2 == null ? w : ax2, ay2, "rgba(96,165,250,.10)", "rgba(96,165,250,.55)", "ASIA", "#60a5fa");
          /* session ke baad H/L project karo */
          var xr = X(n - 1);
          if (ax2 != null && xr != null && xr > ax2) {
            dashLine(ax2, ay1, xr, "rgba(96,165,250,.5)");
            dashLine(ax2, ay2, xr, "rgba(96,165,250,.5)");
          }
        }
      }
    }
    /* FVG */
    if (TOG.fvg && curFvg) {
      var shown = 0;
      for (var f = curFvg.length - 1; f >= 0 && shown < 8; f--) {
        var g = curFvg[f];
        if (!g.open) continue;
        shown++;
        var fy1 = Y(g.top), fy2 = Y(g.bot);
        rect(X(g.i0), fy1, X(Math.min(g.i1, n - 1)), fy2,
          g.dir === 1 ? "rgba(52,211,153,.13)" : "rgba(255,107,107,.13)",
          g.dir === 1 ? "rgba(52,211,153,.45)" : "rgba(255,107,107,.45)",
          g.dir === 1 ? "FVG\u2191" : "FVG\u2193",
          g.dir === 1 ? "#34d399" : "#ff6b6b");
      }
    }
    /* order blocks */
    if (TOG.ob && curOb) {
      for (var o = 0; o < curOb.length; o++) {
        var ob = curOb[o];
        var oy1 = Y(ob.hi), oy2 = Y(ob.lo);
        var fill = ob.dir === 1 ? (ob.active ? "rgba(77,163,255,.15)" : "rgba(77,163,255,.05)")
          : (ob.active ? "rgba(255,159,64,.15)" : "rgba(255,159,64,.05)");
        var stroke = ob.dir === 1 ? (ob.active ? "rgba(77,163,255,.6)" : "rgba(77,163,255,.2)")
          : (ob.active ? "rgba(255,159,64,.6)" : "rgba(255,159,64,.2)");
        rect(X(ob.i0), oy1, X(Math.min(ob.i1, n - 1)), oy2, fill, stroke,
          ob.dir === 1 ? "OB\u2191" : "OB\u2193", ob.dir === 1 ? "#4da3ff" : "#ff9f40");
      }
    }
  }

  function build() {
    var host = document.getElementById("ictChart");
    if (!host || !DATA || !DATA.syms) return;
    var av = DATA.syms[cur.sym];
    if (!av) { cur.sym = "NIFTY"; av = DATA.syms[cur.sym]; }
    if (!av) { host.innerHTML = '<div class="note">data nahi mila.</div>'; return; }
    var d = av[cur.iv] || av["15m"] || av["1h"] || av["5m"];
    if (!d || !d.t || !d.t.length) { host.innerHTML = '<div class="note">is symbol/interval ka data nahi.</div>'; return; }
    curBars = d;
    curSt = detectStructure(d);
    curFvg = findFVG(d);
    curOb = findOB(d, curSt);
    curAsia = asiaSessions(d);
    curKz = kzBands(d);
    curHtf = htfLevels(av["1h"] || d);

    loadLib(function (ok) {
      if (chart) { try { chart.remove(); } catch (e) {} chart = null; }
      host.innerHTML = "";
      if (!ok) { host.innerHTML = '<div class="note">chart lib load nahi hui \u2014 internet check karke dobara try karo.</div>'; return; }
      var light = document.documentElement.getAttribute("data-theme") === "light";
      var grid = light ? "rgba(0,0,0,.06)" : "rgba(255,255,255,.06)";
      var txt = light ? "#41506b" : "#8fa3c8";
      try {
        chart = LightweightCharts.createChart(host, {
          height: 420, layout: { background: { type: "solid", color: "transparent" },
            textColor: txt, fontSize: 10 },
          grid: { vertLines: { color: grid }, horzLines: { color: grid } },
          rightPriceScale: { borderVisible: false },
          timeScale: { borderVisible: false, timeVisible: true, secondsVisible: false },
          localization: { locale: "en-IN" }
        });
        ser = chart.addCandlestickSeries({
          upColor: UP, downColor: DN, borderUpColor: UP, borderDownColor: DN,
          wickUpColor: UP, wickDownColor: DN, priceLineVisible: true
        });
        var bars = [];
        for (var i = 0; i < d.t.length; i++)
          bars.push({ time: d.t[i], open: d.o[i], high: d.h[i], low: d.l[i], close: d.c[i] });
        if (bars.length > 1 && bars[bars.length - 1].time <= bars[bars.length - 2].time) bars.pop();
        ser.setData(bars);
        /* BOS / CHOCH markers */
        if (TOG.st && curSt.events.length) {
          var mk = [], evs = curSt.events.slice(-20);
          for (var e2 = 0; e2 < evs.length; e2++) {
            var ev = evs[e2];
            mk.push({ time: ev.t, position: ev.dir === 1 ? "aboveBar" : "belowBar",
              color: ev.type === "CHOCH" ? "#ffd54d" : (ev.dir === 1 ? "#34d399" : "#ff8b8b"),
              shape: ev.dir === 1 ? "arrowUp" : "arrowDown",
              text: ev.type + (ev.dir === 1 ? "\u2191" : "\u2193"), size: 1 });
          }
          try { ser.setMarkers(mk); } catch (e3) {}
        }
        /* HTF price lines */
        var LINES = [
          { on: "lvl", p: curHtf && curHtf.pdh, t: "PDH", c: "#f87171", s: 0 },
          { on: "lvl", p: curHtf && curHtf.pdl, t: "PDL", c: "#60a5fa", s: 0 },
          { on: "wk", p: curHtf && curHtf.pwh, t: "PWH", c: "#fbbf24", s: 2 },
          { on: "wk", p: curHtf && curHtf.pwl, t: "PWL", c: "#fbbf24", s: 2 },
          { on: "wk", p: curHtf && curHtf.wh, t: "WH", c: "#b8860b", s: 4 },
          { on: "wk", p: curHtf && curHtf.wl, t: "WL", c: "#b8860b", s: 4 },
          { on: "mo", p: curHtf && curHtf.mh, t: "MH", c: "#c084fc", s: 1 },
          { on: "mo", p: curHtf && curHtf.ml, t: "ML", c: "#c084fc", s: 1 }
        ];
        for (var L = 0; L < LINES.length; L++) {
          var ln = LINES[L];
          if (!TOG[ln.on] || !ln.p) continue;
          try {
            ser.createPriceLine({ price: ln.p, color: ln.c, lineWidth: 1,
              lineStyle: ln.s, axisLabelVisible: true, title: ln.t });
          } catch (e4) {}
        }
        chart.timeScale().fitContent();
        try { chart.applyOptions({ width: host.clientWidth }); } catch (e5) {}
        /* overlay canvas */
        ov = document.createElement("canvas");
        ov.style.cssText = "position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;width:100%;height:100%";
        host.appendChild(ov);
        octx = ov.getContext("2d");
        sizeCanvas(); draw();
        try {
          chart.timeScale().subscribeVisibleLogicalRangeChange(function () { draw(); });
        } catch (e6) {}
        if (!build._rs) {
          build._rs = 1;
          window.addEventListener("resize", function () {
            if (chart && host) { try { chart.applyOptions({ width: host.clientWidth }); } catch (e) {} }
            if (ov) { sizeCanvas(); draw(); }
          });
        }
      } catch (e) { host.innerHTML = '<div class="note">chart render fail: ' + esc(e.message) + "</div>"; }
      panel();
    });
  }

  /* ---------------- chips ---------------- */
  function renderChips() {
    var sy = document.getElementById("ictSyms"), iv = document.getElementById("ictIvs"),
        tg = document.getElementById("ictTogs");
    if (!sy || !DATA || !DATA.syms) return;
    var keys = Object.keys(DATA.syms).sort();
    var h = "";
    for (var i = 0; i < keys.length; i++)
      h += '<button class="chip' + (keys[i] === cur.sym ? " on" : "") + '" data-ict-sym="' + esc(keys[i]) + '">' + esc(keys[i]) + "</button>";
    sy.innerHTML = h;
    var av = DATA.syms[cur.sym] || {};
    var h2 = "";
    for (var j = 0; j < IVS.length; j++)
      if (av[IVS[j]] && av[IVS[j]].t && av[IVS[j]].t.length)
        h2 += '<button class="chip' + (IVS[j] === cur.iv ? " on" : "") + '" data-ict-iv="' + IVS[j] + '">' + IVS[j] + "</button>";
    iv.innerHTML = h2 || '<span class="note" style="font-size:12px">data nahi</span>';
    var TOGD = [["lvl", "PDH/PDL"], ["wk", "W H/L"], ["mo", "M H/L"], ["ses", "Sessions/KZ"],
      ["ob", "Order Blocks"], ["fvg", "FVG"], ["st", "BOS/CHOCH"]];
    var h3 = "";
    for (var q = 0; q < TOGD.length; q++)
      h3 += '<button class="chip' + (TOG[TOGD[q][0]] ? " on" : "") + '" data-ict-tog="' + TOGD[q][0] + '">' + TOGD[q][1] + "</button>";
    tg.innerHTML = h3;
  }

  function onClick(e) {
    var t = e.target || e.srcElement;
    while (t && t !== document.body && !t.getAttribute) t = t.parentNode;
    if (!t || !t.getAttribute) return;
    var s = t.getAttribute("data-ict-sym"), iv = t.getAttribute("data-ict-iv"), tog = t.getAttribute("data-ict-tog");
    if (s && s !== cur.sym) { cur.sym = s; cur.iv = "15m"; renderChips(); build(); }
    else if (iv && iv !== cur.iv) { cur.iv = iv; renderChips(); build(); }
    else if (tog) { TOG[tog] = TOG[tog] ? 0 : 1; saveTog(); renderChips(); build(); }
  }

  function waitVisible() {
    if (built) return;
    var card = document.getElementById("ictCard");
    if (card && card.offsetParent !== null && DATA) { built = true; build(); return; }
    setTimeout(waitVisible, 700);
  }

  function mount() {
    var sec = document.querySelector("#gtiMount") || document.querySelector("section#gti");
    if (!sec || document.getElementById("ictCard")) return;
    var card = document.createElement("div");
    card.className = "card"; card.id = "ictCard";
    card.innerHTML =
      '<div class="subhead">ICT Terminal \u2014 PDH/PDL \u00b7 Weekly/Monthly H/L \u00b7 Asia box \u00b7 Kill zones \u00b7 Order Blocks \u00b7 FVG \u00b7 BOS/CHOCH</div>' +
      '<div class="note" style="margin:6px 0 4px">symbol chuno \u2014 15m = 5 din ka structure, 1h = 1 mahina:</div>' +
      '<div class="controls" id="ictSyms"></div>' +
      '<div class="controls" id="ictIvs"></div>' +
      '<div class="controls" id="ictTogs"></div>' +
      '<div id="ictChart" style="margin-top:10px;height:420px;position:relative"></div>' +
      '<div id="ictRead" style="margin-top:10px"></div>' +
      '<div class="note" style="font-size:12px;line-height:1.8;margin-top:10px">' +
      '<b style="color:#f87171">PDH</b>/<b style="color:#60a5fa">PDL</b> pichla din \u00b7 <b style="color:#fbbf24">PWH/PWL</b> pichla hafta \u00b7 <b style="color:#b8860b">WH/WL</b> chalu hafta \u00b7 <b style="color:#c084fc">MH/ML</b> chalu mahina \u00b7 ' +
      '<b style="color:#60a5fa">ASIA</b> 21:15\u201306:30 IST \u00b7 <b style="color:#34d399">LDN KZ</b> 12:30\u201315:30 \u00b7 <b style="color:#ffb84d">NY KZ</b> 17:30\u201320:30 \u00b7 ' +
      '<b style="color:#4da3ff">OB\u2191</b>/<b style="color:#ff9f40">OB\u2193</b> order block \u00b7 <b style="color:#34d399">FVG\u2191</b>/<b style="color:#ff6b6b">FVG\u2193</b> fair value gap \u00b7 ' +
      '<b style="color:#34d399">BOS</b> (Break of Structure) trend continue \u00b7 <b style="color:#ffd54d">CHOCH</b> (Change of Character) reversal</div>' +
      '<div class="footer-note">data: Yahoo free (5m aaj \u00b7 15m 5 din \u00b7 1h 1 mahina) \u00b7 Asia box + NY KZ sirf 24h market (BTC) pe poore \u2014 NSE raat ko band \u00b7 structure fractal-3 swings se \u00b7 read hai, tip nahi</div>';
    sec.insertBefore(card, sec.firstChild);
    fetch("data/candles.json?t=" + Date.now()).then(function (r) { return r.json(); }).then(function (dd) {
      DATA = dd;
      if (!DATA.syms[cur.sym]) cur.sym = Object.keys(DATA.syms)[0] || "NIFTY";
      renderChips();
      waitVisible();
    }).catch(function () {
      var el = document.getElementById("ictSyms");
      if (el) el.innerHTML = '<span class="note" style="font-size:12px">candles data nahi mila \u2014 thodi der baad try karo.</span>';
    });
    if (document.addEventListener) document.addEventListener("click", onClick, false);
    window.addEventListener("hashchange", waitVisible);
  }

  if (document.readyState === "loading") document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", mount);
  else mount();
})();

<script>
/* ArthaSaar — live-data wiring for the new UI. Fills the hardcoded placeholders with the repo's EOD data. */
(function () {
  "use strict";
  var BASE = "data/";
  function nf(x, d) { return (x == null || isNaN(x)) ? "—" : Number(x).toLocaleString("en-IN", { maximumFractionDigits: d == null ? 2 : d }); }
  function sign(x, d) { return (x == null || isNaN(x)) ? "—" : (x > 0 ? "+" : "") + nf(x, d == null ? 2 : d) + "%"; }
  function J(n) { return fetch(BASE + n, { cache: "no-store" }).then(function (r) { if (!r.ok) throw new Error(n); return r.json(); }); }
  function kpi(lbl) {
    var out = null;
    document.querySelectorAll(".card.kpi").forEach(function (c) {
      var l = c.querySelector(".lbl");
      if (l && l.textContent.trim().toUpperCase() === lbl) out = c;
    });
    return out;
  }
  function setKpi(lbl, price, chg) {
    var c = kpi(lbl); if (!c) return;
    var num = c.querySelector(".num"), ch = c.querySelector(".chg");
    if (num) num.textContent = nf(price, 2);
    if (ch) { ch.textContent = (chg > 0 ? "▲ " : "▼ ") + sign(chg); ch.className = "chg " + (chg > 0 ? "up" : chg < 0 ? "dn" : ""); }
  }
  function probe() {
    return fetch("data/fii-dii.json", { cache: "no-store" }).then(function (r) {
      if (!r.ok) throw 0; return true;
    }).catch(function () {
      return fetch("../data/fii-dii.json", { cache: "no-store" }).then(function (r) { if (r.ok) { BASE = "../data/"; return true; } return false; }).catch(function () { return false; });
    });
  }
  probe().then(function () {
    // --- indices: hero KPIs + indices table ---
    J("indices-all.json").then(function (ia) {
      var idx = ia.indices || [];
      function find(n) { return idx.filter(function (i) { return i.index.toUpperCase() === n; })[0] || idx.filter(function (i) { return i.index.toUpperCase().indexOf(n) > -1; })[0]; }
      var n = find("NIFTY 50"), b = find("NIFTY BANK"), v = find("INDIA VIX");
      if (n) setKpi("NIFTY 50", n.price, n.change_pct);
      if (b) setKpi("BANK NIFTY", b.price, b.change_pct);
      if (v) setKpi("INDIA VIX", v.price, v.change_pct);
      var tb = document.getElementById("idxBody");
      if (tb) tb.innerHTML = idx.slice(0, 80).map(function (i) {
        var u = i.change_pct >= 0;
        return "<tr><td>" + i.index + "</td><td>" + nf(i.price, 2) + "</td><td><span class='" + (u ? "up" : "dn") + "'>" + sign(i.change_pct) + "</span></td><td>—</td><td>" + (i.pe || "—") + "</td><td>" + (i.pb || "—") + "</td></tr>";
      }).join("");
    }).catch(function () {});
    // --- global + SENSEX ---
    J("global.json").then(function (g) {
      var items = g.items || [];
      var s = items.filter(function (i) { return i.name === "SENSEX"; })[0];
      if (s) setKpi("SENSEX", s.price, s.chg_pct);
      var t = document.querySelector("#v-global tbody");
      if (t) t.innerHTML = items.map(function (i) { var u = i.chg_pct >= 0; return "<tr><td>" + i.name + "</td><td>" + nf(i.price, 2) + "</td><td><span class='" + (u ? "up" : "dn") + "'>" + sign(i.chg_pct) + "</span></td></tr>"; }).join("");
    }).catch(function () {});
    // --- crypto ---
    J("crypto.json").then(function (c) {
      var t = document.querySelector("#v-crypto tbody");
      if (t) t.innerHTML = (c.top || []).slice(0, 30).map(function (x) {
        var u = x.chg_24h_pct >= 0, u7 = x.chg_7d_pct >= 0;
        return "<tr><td>" + x.symbol + "</td><td>$" + nf(x.price_usd, x.price_usd < 1 ? 4 : 2) + "</td><td><span class='" + (u ? "up" : "dn") + "'>" + sign(x.chg_24h_pct) + "</span></td><td><span class='" + (u7 ? "up" : "dn") + "'>" + sign(x.chg_7d_pct) + "</span></td><td>$" + nf(x.market_cap / 1e9, 1) + "B</td></tr>";
      }).join("");
    }).catch(function () {});
    // --- mutual funds ---
    J("mf-top.json").then(function (m) {
      var t = document.querySelector("#v-mf tbody");
      if (t) t.innerHTML = (m.funds || []).slice(0, 24).map(function (f) {
        return "<tr><td>" + f.n.split("·")[0].trim() + "</td><td>—</td><td><span class='up'>" + sign(f.r1, 1) + "</span></td><td><span class='up'>" + sign(f.r3, 1) + "</span></td><td>—</td></tr>";
      }).join("");
    }).catch(function () {});
    // --- FII / DII 5-day rows on home ---
    J("fii-history.json").then(function (fh) {
      var card = [].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll("#v-home .card")).filter(function (c) { return /FII \/ DII/.test(c.textContent); })[0];
      if (!card || !fh.length) return;
      var rows = fh.slice(-6).reverse().map(function (d) {
        return '<div class="zrow"><span>' + d.date.slice(0, 6) + '</span><span><b class="' + (d.fii >= 0 ? "up" : "dn") + '">' + nf(d.fii, 0) + '</b> <small class="mono">FII</small> · <b class="' + (d.dii >= 0 ? "up" : "dn") + '">' + nf(d.dii, 0) + '</b> <small class="mono">DII</small></span></div>';
      }).join("");
      var box = card.querySelector("div[style]");
      if (box) box.innerHTML = rows;
    }).catch(function () {});
    // --- news (fill the home News cards' first card) ---
    J("news.json").then(function (nw) {
      var card = document.querySelector("#v-news .grid3 .card .ni");
      if (!card) return;
      var host = card.parentNode;
      host.innerHTML = '<div class="sh2">Market News</div>' + (nw.items || []).slice(0, 4).map(function (i) {
        return '<div class="ni"><b>' + String(i.title).replace(/[<>]/g, "") + '</b><small>' + (i.publisher || i.topic || "") + '</small></div>';
      }).join("");
    }).catch(function () {});
  });
})();
</script>

<script>
/* ArthaSaar — second live-data pass: screener, futures, internals, GTI zones, home modules. */
(function () {
  "use strict";
  var BASE = "data/";
  function nf(x, d) { return (x == null || isNaN(x)) ? "—" : Number(x).toLocaleString("en-IN", { maximumFractionDigits: d == null ? 2 : d }); }
  function sign(x, d) { return (x == null || isNaN(x)) ? "—" : (x > 0 ? "+" : "") + nf(x, d == null ? 2 : d) + "%"; }
  function J(n) { return fetch(BASE + n, { cache: "no-store" }).then(function (r) { if (!r.ok) throw new Error(n); return r.json(); }); }
  function kpi(lbl) { var o = null; document.querySelectorAll(".card.kpi").forEach(function (c) { var l = c.querySelector(".lbl"); if (l && l.textContent.trim().toUpperCase() === lbl) o = c; }); return o; }
  function setKpi(lbl, val, chg, cls) { var c = kpi(lbl); if (!c) return; var n = c.querySelector(".num"), ch = c.querySelector(".chg"); if (n) n.textContent = val; if (ch) { ch.textContent = chg || ""; ch.className = "chg " + (cls || ""); } }
  fetch("data/fii-dii.json", { cache: "no-store" }).catch(function () { BASE = "../data/"; }).then(run);

  function run() {
    // ---- brain-screener: home modules + screener table + internals ----
    J("brain-screener.json").then(function (b) {
      var st = (b.stocks || []).slice();
      if (!st.length) return;
      var byChg = st.slice().sort(function (a, c) { return (c.change_pct || 0) - (a.change_pct || 0); });
      var g = byChg[0], l = byChg[byChg.length - 1];
      var vol = st.slice().sort(function (a, c) { return (c.vol_vs_avg20 || 0) - (a.vol_vs_avg20 || 0); })[0];
      var nearHi = st.filter(function (s) { return (s.from_52w_high_pct || -100) > -3; }).length;
      setKpi("TOP GAINER", g.symbol, sign(g.change_pct, 1), "up");
      setKpi("TOP LOSER", l.symbol, sign(l.change_pct, 1), "dn");
      setKpi("VOLUME SHOCKER", nf(vol.vol_vs_avg20, 1) + "×", "above normal", "");
      setKpi("52W MOVERS", nf(nearHi, 0), "near high", "");
      // screener table
      var tb = document.getElementById("scrBody");
      if (tb) tb.innerHTML = byChg.slice(0, 40).map(function (s) {
        var u = (s.change_pct || 0) >= 0, sig = s.above_ema200 && u ? "BUY" : (s.rsi14 < 30 ? "WATCH" : "HOLD"), sigc = sig === "BUY" ? "buy" : sig === "WATCH" ? "hold" : "hold";
        return "<tr><td>" + s.symbol + "</td><td>" + nf(s.price, 2) + "</td><td><span class='" + (u ? "up" : "dn") + "'>" + sign(s.change_pct, 1) + "</span></td><td>—</td><td>—</td><td>" + (s.rsi14 != null ? nf(s.rsi14, 0) : "—") + "</td><td><span class='b " + sigc + "'>" + sig + "</span></td></tr>";
      }).join("");
      // internals: advances / declines
      var adv = st.filter(function (s) { return (s.change_pct || 0) > 0; }).length;
      var dec = st.filter(function (s) { return (s.change_pct || 0) < 0; }).length;
      setKpi("ADVANCES", nf(adv, 0), "aaj ke winner", "up");
      setKpi("DECLINES", nf(dec, 0), "aaj ke loser", "dn");
      var trin = dec ? (adv / dec) : 0;
      setKpi("TRIN (ARMS)", nf(trin, 2), trin > 1 ? "bullish breadth" : "weak breadth", trin > 1 ? "up" : "dn");
    }).catch(function () {});

    // ---- breadth: 52w highs/lows ----
    J("breadth.json").then(function (br) {
      var c = document.querySelector("#v-internals");
      if (!c) return;
      // New highs / lows row inside "52w Highs vs Lows" card
      var cards = c.querySelectorAll(".card");
      cards.forEach(function (cd) {
        if (/52w Highs vs Lows/.test(cd.textContent)) {
          var rows = cd.querySelectorAll(".zrow");
          if (rows[0]) rows[0].innerHTML = "<span>New highs</span><b class='up'>" + nf(br.near_52w_high, 0) + "</b>";
          if (rows[1]) rows[1].innerHTML = "<span>New lows</span><b class='dn'>" + nf(br.rsi_below_40, 0) + "</b>";
        }
      });
    }).catch(function () {});

    // ---- futures table ----
    J("futures.json").then(function (f) {
      var t = document.querySelector("#v-futures tbody");
      if (!t) return;
      var rows = [];
      (f.indices || []).forEach(function (i) { var c0 = (i.contracts || [])[0] || {}; rows.push({ n: i.symbol + " FUT", ltp: c0.close, chg: i.underlying ? (c0.close - i.underlying) / i.underlying * 100 : null, oi: c0.oi, oich: c0.oi_chg, basis: i.underlying ? (c0.close - i.underlying) : null }); });
      (f.stocks || []).slice(0, 6).forEach(function (s) { rows.push({ n: s.symbol + " FUT", ltp: s.close, chg: s.basis_pct, oi: s.oi, oich: s.oi_chg, basis: (s.close - s.underlying) }); });
      t.innerHTML = rows.map(function (r) {
        return "<tr><td>" + r.n + "</td><td>" + nf(r.ltp, 2) + "</td><td><span class='" + ((r.chg || 0) >= 0 ? "up" : "dn") + "'>" + sign(r.chg, 2) + "</span></td><td>" + nf(r.oi, 0) + "</td><td><span class='" + ((r.oich || 0) >= 0 ? "up" : "dn") + "'>" + nf(r.oich, 0) + "</span></td><td>" + nf(r.basis, 2) + "</td></tr>";
      }).join("");
    }).catch(function () {});

    // ---- GTI zones ----
    J("gti.json").then(function (g) {
      var s = (g.symbols || {})["NIFTY 50"]; if (!s) return;
      var host = document.querySelector("#v-gtizones");
      if (!host) return;
      var dz = s.day_zones || {}, wz = s.week_zones || {};
      var cards = host.querySelectorAll(".card");
      if (cards[0]) cards[0].innerHTML = "<div class='sh2'>NIFTY 50 — Zones</div><div style='padding:6px 14px 10px'><div class='zrow'><span>Day demand</span><b class='up'>" + nf((dz.SD || [])[0], 0) + " – " + nf((dz.SD || [])[1], 0) + "</b></div><div class='zrow'><span>Day supply</span><b class='dn'>" + nf((dz.SS || [])[0], 0) + " – " + nf((dz.SS || [])[1], 0) + "</b></div><div class='zrow'><span>POC day</span><b>" + nf(s.day_poc, 0) + "</b></div></div>";
    }).catch(function () {});
  }
})();
</script>

<script>
/* ArthaSaar — round 2: lockscreen, live charts, learn modules, forex/commodities/bonds, events, mood. */
(function () {
  "use strict";
  var BASE = "data/";
  function nf(x, d) { return (x == null || isNaN(x)) ? "—" : Number(x).toLocaleString("en-IN", { maximumFractionDigits: d == null ? 2 : d }); }
  function sign(x, d) { return (x == null || isNaN(x)) ? "—" : (x > 0 ? "+" : "") + nf(x, d == null ? 2 : d) + "%"; }
  function J(n) { return fetch(BASE + n, { cache: "no-store" }).then(function (r) { if (!r.ok) throw new Error(n); return r.json(); }); }

  /* ---------- 1. LOCKSCREEN ---------- */
  /* Password is stored ONLY as a SHA-256 hash - the plaintext is not in this file. */
  var PASS_HASH = "c09f57e0b728dc5b1638e5022da243db3d8e0e7cefeab62bc8f1d40b99677880";
  function pwOk(v){ return crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", new TextEncoder().encode(v)).then(function(b){ return Array.from(new Uint8Array(b)).map(function(x){ return x.toString(16).padStart(2,"0"); }).join("") === PASS_HASH; }).catch(function(){ return false; }); }
  var lock = document.getElementById("lock"), pw = document.getElementById("pw"), err = document.getElementById("lockErr");
  function unlocked() { try { return localStorage.getItem("as-unlock") === "1"; } catch (e) { return false; } }
  function hideLock() { if (lock) lock.classList.add("hide"); }
  if (unlocked()) hideLock();
  var lf = document.getElementById("lockForm");
  if (lf) lf.addEventListener("submit", function (e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    pwOk(pw.value).then(function (ok) {
      if (ok) { try { localStorage.setItem("as-unlock", "1"); } catch (x) {} hideLock(); }
      else { err.textContent = "✕ Incorrect password. Try again."; pw.value = ""; pw.focus(); }
    });
  });
  if (pw) pw.addEventListener("input", function () { err.textContent = ""; });

  /* ---------- 2. CANDLE / LINE renderer (from candles.json) ---------- */
  function ema(v, p) { var k = 2 / (p + 1), e = v[0], o = []; for (var i = 0; i < v.length; i++) { e = i ? v[i] * k + e * (1 - k) : v[i]; o.push(e); } return o; }
  function candleSVG(d) {
    var O = d.o, H = d.h, L = d.l, C = d.c, V = d.v || [], n = C.length; if (n < 4) return "<div class='mut'>no data</div>";
    var w = 760, ph = 210, vh = 42, pad = 6, cw = (w - pad * 2) / n;
    var hi = Math.max.apply(null, H), lo = Math.min.apply(null, L), rg = (hi - lo) || 1;
    var X = function (i) { return pad + i * cw + cw / 2; }, Y = function (v) { return 6 + (hi - v) / rg * (ph - 12); };
    var s = "<svg viewBox='0 0 " + w + " " + (ph + vh + 8) + "' preserveAspectRatio='none' style='width:100%;height:230px'>";
    for (var gy = 0; gy <= 4; gy++) { var yy = 6 + gy * (ph - 12) / 4; s += "<line x1='0' y1='" + yy + "' x2='" + w + "' y2='" + yy + "' stroke='rgba(140,180,230,.14)'/>"; }
    for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) { var up = C[i] >= O[i], col = up ? "#2bd477" : "#ef5b61";
      s += "<line x1='" + X(i) + "' y1='" + Y(H[i]) + "' x2='" + X(i) + "' y2='" + Y(L[i]) + "' stroke='" + col + "'/>";
      var y1 = Y(Math.max(O[i], C[i])), y2 = Y(Math.min(O[i], C[i]));
      s += "<rect x='" + (X(i) - cw * .3) + "' y='" + y1 + "' width='" + (cw * .6) + "' height='" + Math.max(1, y2 - y1) + "' fill='" + col + "' rx='1'/>"; }
    var e20 = ema(C, 20), e50 = ema(C, 50);
    s += "<polyline points='" + e20.map(function (v, i) { return X(i) + "," + Y(v); }).join(" ") + "' fill='none' stroke='#4aa8ff' stroke-width='1.6'/>";
    s += "<polyline points='" + e50.map(function (v, i) { return X(i) + "," + Y(v); }).join(" ") + "' fill='none' stroke='#ffb457' stroke-width='1.6'/>";
    if (V.length) { var vmax = Math.max.apply(null, V) || 1, vy = ph + 6; for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) { var up = C[i] >= O[i], bh = V[i] / vmax * (vh - 6); s += "<rect x='" + (X(i) - cw * .3) + "' y='" + (vy + vh - bh) + "' width='" + (cw * .6) + "' height='" + bh + "' fill='" + (up ? "rgba(43,212,119,.5)" : "rgba(239,91,97,.5)") + "' rx='1'/>"; } }
    return s + "</svg><div class='mut' style='font-size:11px'>candles · EMA20 (blue) · EMA50 (orange) · volume</div>";
  }
  function lineSVG(C) {
    var n = C.length; if (n < 2) return "<div class='mut'>no data</div>";
    var w = 760, h = 230, pad = 8, hi = Math.max.apply(null, C), lo = Math.min.apply(null, C), rg = (hi - lo) || 1;
    var pts = C.map(function (v, i) { return (pad + i * (w - pad * 2) / (n - 1)).toFixed(1) + "," + (h - 20 - (v - lo) / rg * (h - 40)).toFixed(1); }).join(" ");
    var id = "g" + (n % 97) + Math.floor(Math.random() * 1e4);
    return "<svg viewBox='0 0 " + w + " " + h + "' preserveAspectRatio='none' style='width:100%;height:230px'><defs><linearGradient id='" + id + "' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'><stop offset='0' stop-color='#4aa8ff' stop-opacity='.35'/><stop offset='1' stop-color='#4aa8ff' stop-opacity='0'/></linearGradient></defs><polygon points='" + pad + "," + (h - 20) + " " + pts + " " + (w - pad) + "," + (h - 20) + "' fill='url(#" + id + ")'/><polyline points='" + pts + "' fill='none' stroke='#4aa8ff' stroke-width='2.2'/></svg><div class='mut' style='font-size:11px'>line · close</div>";
  }

    J("candles.json").then(function (c) {

      if (!s) { el.innerHTML = "<div class='mut'>no data</div>"; return; }

      el.innerHTML = tf.mode === "line" ? lineSVG(d.c) : candleSVG(d);

    }).catch(function () {});
  }
  document.querySelectorAll("#v-home [data-tf]").forEach(function (b) {
    b.onclick = function () { tf.sym = b.getAttribute("data-tf"); document.querySelectorAll("#v-home [data-tf]").forEach(function (x) { x.classList.remove("on"); }); b.classList.add("on"); renderTF(); };
  });
  document.querySelectorAll("#v-home [data-mode]").forEach(function (b) {
    b.onclick = function () { tf.mode = b.getAttribute("data-mode"); document.querySelectorAll("#v-home [data-mode]").forEach(function (x) { x.classList.remove("on"); }); b.classList.add("on"); renderTF(); };
  });

  var cs = "NIFTY";
  function renderCS() {

    }).catch(function () {});
  }

  });

  /* ---------- 5. LEARN modules -> full-screen content ---------- */
  function panel(title, html) {
    var ov = document.createElement("div");
    ov.className = "lock"; ov.style.zIndex = 200;
    ov.innerHTML = "<div class='box' style='width:min(720px,100%);text-align:left;max-height:88vh;overflow:auto'><div style='display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin-bottom:8px'><h1 style='font-size:18px;margin:0'>" + title + "</h1><button class='xbtn' id='pclose'>✕ CLOSE</button></div>" + html + "</div>";
    document.body.appendChild(ov);
    ov.querySelector("#pclose").onclick = function () { ov.remove(); };
    ov.addEventListener("click", function (e) { if (e.target === ov) ov.remove(); });
  }
  document.querySelectorAll(".lmod").forEach(function (b) {
    b.onclick = function () {
      var k = b.getAttribute("data-lm");
      J("learn-content.json").then(function (l) {
        var rows = function (arr) { return (arr || []).map(function (x) { return "<div class='zrow'><span>" + (x.rule || x.term || x.topic || x) + "</span><b class='mut'>" + (x.why || x.meaning || x.point || "") + "</b></div>"; }).join(""); };

    t.innerHTML = b.slice(0, 12).map(function (i) { var u = (i.change_pct || 0) >= 0; return "<tr><td>" + i.index + "</td><td>" + nf(i.price, 2) + "</td><td><span class='" + (u ?     var mood = r[0], f = r[1];
    var cards = document.querySelectorAll("#v-aibrain .card");
    if (cards[0]) { var n = cards[0].querySelector(".num"); if (n) { n.textContent = (mood.tag || "").toUpperCase() + " LEAN"; n.className = "num " + (mood.overall >= 55 ? "up" : mood.overall <= 45 ? "dn" : ""); } }
    var mini = document.querySelectorAll("#v-aibrain .card.kpi .num");
    if (mini[0]) mini[0].textContent = nf(f.vix, 1);
    if (mini[1]) mini[1].textContent = nf(f.pcr, 2);
  }).catch(function () {});

  

  /* ---------- boot ---------- */
  fetch("data/fii-dii.json", { cache: "no-store" }).catch(function () { BASE = "../data/"; }).then(function () { renderTF(); renderCS(); });
})();

  function sign(x, d) { return (x == null || isNaN(x)) ? "—" : (x > 0 ? "+" : "") + nf(x, d == null ? 2 : d) + "%"; }

  function rc(l, v, cls) { return "<div class='rc'><b class='" + (cls || "") + "'>" + v + "</b><span>" + l + "</span></div>"; }
  function rgrid(items) { return "<div class='rgrid'>" + items.join("") + "</div>"; }

    var S = [
      ["NSE PRE-OPEN", "09:00", "09:15", "bidding window"],

<script>
/* ArthaSaar — round 5: radar -> small round toggle button; sector map -> clickable sector cards with per-sector stock lists (% + ₹ move). */
(function () {
  "use strict";
  var BASE = "data/", C = {};
  function nf(x, d) { return (x == null || isNaN(x)) ? "—" : Number(x).toLocaleString("en-IN", { maximumFractionDigits: d == null ? 2 : d }); }
  function sign(x, d) { return (x == null || isNaN(x)) ? "—" : (x > 0 ? "+" : "") + nf(x, d == null ? 2 : d) + "%"; }
  function J(n) { return fetch(BASE + n, { cache: "no-store" }).then(function (r) { if (!r.ok) throw new Error(n); return r.json(); }); }
  function D(n) { return C[n] ? Promise.resolve(C[n]) : J(n).then(function (d) { C[n] = d; return d; }); }
  function esc(s) { return String(s == null ? "" : s).replace(/[&<>"]/g, function (c) { return { "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;" }[c]; }); }
  function up(x) { return (x || 0) >= 0; }

  /* ---------- 1. every radar card -> small round button in the header line + toggle card ---------- */
  function convertRadars() {
    document.querySelectorAll(".view > .radar").forEach(function (r) {
      if (r._conv) return; r._conv = 1;
      var v = r.closest(".view"); if (!v) return;
      var fh = v.querySelector(".fshead"); if (!fh) return;
      var html = r.outerHTML; r.remove();
      var btn = document.createElement("button"); btn.className = "rbtn"; btn.type = "button"; btn.innerHTML = "◉ RADAR";
      var x = fh.querySelector(".xbtn"); fh.insertBefore(btn, x);
      var holder = document.createElement("div"); holder.style.display = "none"; holder.innerHTML = html;
      fh.parentNode.insertBefore(holder, fh.nextSibling);
      btn.addEventListener("click", function () {
        var open = holder.style.display !== "none";
        holder.style.display = open ? "none" : "block";
        btn.classList.toggle("on", !open);
      });
    });
  }
  convertRadars();
  try { new MutationObserver(function () { convertRadars(); }).observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true }); } catch (e) {}
  var _n = 0, _iv = setInterval(function () { convertRadars(); if (++_n > 20) clearInterval(_iv); }, 700);

  /* ---------- 2. SECTOR MAP: sector cards -> per-sector stock list ---------- */
  function openSector(name, secs, map) {
    var list = secs[name] || [];
    var rows = list.map(function (x) { var s = map[x.symbol] || {}; return { sym: x.symbol, co: x.company, chg: s.change_pct, price: s.price }; })
      .sort(function (a, b) { return (b.chg || 0) - (a.chg || 0); });
    var html = "<div class='radar'><div class='rt'>" + esc(name) + " SECTOR</div><div class='rs'>" + rows.length + " stocks · % and ₹ move</div><div style='max-height:52vh;overflow:auto'>" +
      rows.map(function (r) { var rs = (r.price != null && r.chg != null) ? (r.price * r.chg / 100) : null; return "<div class='zrow'><span><b>" + r.sym + "</b> <small class='mono'>" + esc((r.co || "").slice(0, 24)) + "</small></span><b class='" + (up(r.chg) ? "up" : "dn") + "'>" + sign(r.chg, 1) + " · ₹" + (rs == null ? "—" : nf(rs, 2)) + "</b></div>"; }).join("") +
      "</div></div>";
    var host = document.querySelector("#v-heatmap"); if (!host) return;

<script>
/* ArthaSaar — round 6: remove old static sector blocks, robust radar toggle, closable sector card. */
(function () {
  "use strict";

  /* ---------- 1. remove the OLD static sector blocks in the heat map ---------- */
  function rmHeat() {
    document.querySelectorAll("#v-heatmap .heat").forEach(function (h) {
      var w = h.parentNode;
      h.remove();
      if (w && w.parentNode && w.classList && !w.classList.contains("view") && w.children.length === 0) w.remove();
    });
  }
  rmHeat();

  /* ---------- 2. robust radar -> small round toggle button ---------- */
  function convertRadars() {
    document.querySelectorAll(".view > .radar").forEach(function (r) {
      if (r._conv) return; r._conv = 1;
      var v = r.closest(".view"); if (!v) return;
      var fh = v.querySelector(".fshead"); if (!fh) return;
      var html = r.outerHTML; r.remove();
      var btn = document.createElement("button"); btn.className = "rbtn"; btn.type = "button"; btn.innerHTML = "◉ RADAR";
      var x = fh.querySelector(".xbtn"); fh.insertBefore(btn, x);
      var holder = document.createElement("div"); holder.style.display = "none"; holder.innerHTML = html;
      fh.parentNode.insertBefore(holder, fh.nextSibling);
      btn.addEventListener("click", function () {
        var open = holder.style.display !== "none";
        holder.style.display = open ? "none" : "block";
        btn.classList.toggle("on", !open);
      });
    });
  }
  convertRadars();
  var n = 0, iv = setInterval(function () { rmHeat(); convertRadars(); if (++n > 30) clearInterval(iv); }, 600);
  window.addEventListener("hashchange", function () { setTimeout(function () { rmHeat(); convertRadars(); }, 250); });
  document.addEventListener("click", function () { setTimeout(function () { rmHeat(); convertRadars(); }, 150); }, true);

  /* ---------- 3. give the opened sector card a close button ---------- */
  function addClose() {
    var sc = document.querySelector("#v-heatmap .secopen");
    if (!sc || sc.querySelector(".scx")) return;
    var b = document.createElement("button"); b.className = "xbtn scx"; b.type = "button"; b.innerHTML = "✕ CLOSE";
    b.style.cssText = "float:right;margin:-4px 0 8px 8px";
    b.addEventListener("click", function () { sc.remove(); });
    sc.insertBefore(b, sc.firstChild);
  }
  var iv2 = setInterval(function () { addClose(); }, 600);
  setTimeout(function () { clearInterval(iv2); }, 20000);
})();
</script>

<script>
/* ArthaSaar — round 9: Sector Map = ALL SECTORS of the Indian market (sector-grouped heat map) */
(function(){ "use strict";
  function probeBase(){ return location.pathname.indexOf("/app/")>=0 ? "../data/" : "data/"; }
  function J(f){ return fetch(probeBase()+f,{cache:"no-store"}).then(function(r){ if(!r.ok) throw 0; return r.json(); }); }
  function esc(s){ return String(s==null?"":s).replace(/[&<>"]/g,function(c){return {"&":"&amp;","<":"&lt;",">":"&gt;",'"':"&quot;"}[c];}); }
  function col(c){ if(c==null||isNaN(c)) return {bg:"#e6e6ea",fg:"#3a3a3a"}; if(c>0) return {bg:"#bfe9c8",fg:"#0a5c1e"}; if(c<0) return {bg:"#f6c3c3",fg:"#7a1010"}; return {bg:"#e6e6ea",fg:"#3a3a3a"}; }
  var C=null,SF=null,B=null;
  function build(){
    if(!C||!SF||!B) return;
    var host=document.getElementById("v-heatmap"); if(!host) return;
    /* drop the old flat (large-cap-only) treemap card */
    [].slice.call(host.querySelectorAll(".card")).forEach(function(el){
      if(el.id!=="sectreemap-card" && /BLOOMBERG STYLE|MCAP TREEMAP/.test(el.textContent||"")) el.remove();
    });
    if(document.getElementById("sectreemap-card")) return;
    var bmap={}; (B.stocks||[]).forEach(function(s){ bmap[s.symbol]=s; });
    var src=C.sectors||{}, secs=[];
    Object.keys(src).forEach(function(name){
      var list=src[name].map(function(it){
        var st=SF[it.symbol]||{}, mc=+st["Market Cap"]||0, bb=bmap[it.symbol]||{};
        return {sym:it.symbol,name:it.company,mcap:mc,chg:(bb.change_pct!=null?+bb.change_pct:null)};
      }).filter(function(x){ return x.mcap>0; });
      if(!list.length) return;
      var tot=list.reduce(function(a,x){return a+x.mcap;},0);
      var wavg=list.reduce(function(a,x){return a+(x.chg||0)*x.mcap;},0)/tot;
      secs.push({name:name,list:list,tot:tot,avg:wavg});
    });
    secs.sort(function(a,b){ return b.tot-a.tot; });
    var nstk=secs.reduce(function(a,s){return a+s.list.length;},0);
    var card=document.createElement("div"); card.id="sectreemap-card"; card.className="card";
    var html='<div class="trow" style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center"><b>SECTOR MAP</b><span class="muted" style="font-size:10.5px">ALL SECTORS · INDIA · SIZE = MCAP</span></div>';
    html+='<div style="font-size:11px;color:#777;margin:2px 0 9px">'+secs.length+' sectors · '+nstk+' stocks · tap a stock for its chart</div>';
    secs.forEach(function(s){
      var cc=col(s.avg);
      html+='<div class="secpanel"><div class="sechead"><span>'+esc(s.name)+'</span><span style="color:'+cc.fg+'">'+(s.avg>=0?"+":"")+s.avg.toFixed(1)+'%</span></div><div class="secblocks">';
      s.list.sort(function(a,b){return b.mcap-a.mcap;}).forEach(function(x){
        var c=col(x.chg);
        html+='<div class="blk" data-sym="'+esc(x.sym)+'" title="'+esc(x.name)+'" style="flex-grow:'+Math.max(x.mcap,1)+';background:'+c.bg+';color:'+c.fg+'"><b>'+esc(x.sym)+'</b><span>'+(x.chg==null?"":((x.chg>=0?"+":"")+x.chg.toFixed(1)+"%"))+'</span></div>';
      });
      html+='</div></div>';
    });
    card.innerHTML=html;
    card.addEventListener("click",function(e){
      var b=e.target.closest(".blk"); if(!b) return;
      var sym=b.getAttribute("data-sym"); if(!sym) return;
      if(window.openCompanyFS){ window.openCompanyFS(sym); return; }
      location.hash="#company";
    });
    var fh=host.querySelector(".fshead");
    if(fh) host.insertBefore(card, fh.nextSibling); else host.insertBefore(card, host.firstChild);
  }
  Promise.all([J("constituents.json"),J("screener-fundamentals.json"),J("brain-screener.json")]).then(function(r){ C=r[0]; SF=(r[1]&&r[1].stocks)||r[1]; B=r[2]; build(); }).catch(function(){});
  window.addEventListener("hashchange",function(){ setTimeout(build,300); });
  var n=0,iv=setInterval(function(){ build(); if(++n>20) clearInterval(iv); },700);
})();

<script>
/* ArthaSaar — round 10: RADAR button opens/closes its data card right under the header; smaller text */
(function(){ "use strict";
  function findHolder(fh){
    var s=fh.nextElementSibling, i=0;
    while(s && i<6){
      if(s.classList && (s.classList.contains("radar") || (s.querySelector && s.querySelector(".radar")))) return s;
      s=s.nextElementSibling; i++;
    }
    return null;
  }
  function fix(){
    document.querySelectorAll(".view").forEach(function(v){
      var fh=v.querySelector(".fshead"); if(!fh) return;
      var btn=fh.querySelector(".rbtn"); if(!btn) return;
      var holder=findHolder(fh);
      if(holder){
        if(holder.previousElementSibling!==fh){ fh.parentNode.insertBefore(holder, fh.nextSibling); }
        holder.classList.add("as-holder");
        if(!holder._init){ holder._init=1; holder.style.display="none"; }
        if(!holder.querySelector(".rclose")){
          var c=document.createElement("button"); c.className="xbtn rclose"; c.type="button"; c.textContent="✕ CLOSE";
          c.addEventListener("click",function(e){ e.stopPropagation(); holder.style.display="none"; var bb=fh.querySelector(".rbtn"); if(bb) bb.classList.remove("on"); });
          holder.insertBefore(c, holder.firstChild);
        }
      }
      if(!btn._bound){
        var nb=btn.cloneNode(true); nb._bound=1; btn.parentNode.replaceChild(nb, btn);
        nb.addEventListener("click", function(e){
          e.stopPropagation();
          var h=findHolder(fh); if(!h) return;
          var open=h.style.display!=="none";
          h.style.display=open?"none":"block";
          nb.classList.toggle("on", !open);
          if(!open){ try{ h.scrollIntoView({behavior:"smooth",block:"nearest"}); }catch(_){} }
        });
      }
    });
  }
  fix();
  var n=0,iv=setInterval(function(){ fix(); if(++n>30) clearInterval(iv); },600);
  window.addEventListener("hashchange",function(){ setTimeout(fix,300); });
  document.addEventListener("click",function(){ setTimeout(fix,250); },true);
})();
</script>

<script>
/* ArthaSaar — round 18: full-screen company card (summary + fundamental + technical + S/R + chart + stage + holding + news) */
(function(){ "use strict";
  function base(){ return location.pathname.indexOf("/app/")>=0 ? "../data/" : "data/"; }

  function nf(x,d){ return (x==null||isNaN(x))?"—":Number(x).toLocaleString("en-IN",{maximumFractionDigits:d==null?2:d}); }
  function pc(x,d){ return (x==null||isNaN(x))?"—":(x>=0?"+":"")+Number(x).toFixed(d==null?1:d)+"%"; }
  var FUND={},SF={},BM={},CI={},CAND={},GTI={},RES=[],NEWS=[];
  function stage(sc){
    if(!sc||sc.price==null) return {t:"—",bg:"#e8e8ea",fg:"#555"};
    var a=sc.above_ema200, e20=sc.ema20, e200=sc.ema200;
    if(a && e20!=null && e200!=null && e20>e200) return {t:"STAGE 2 \u00b7 UPTREND",bg:"#cdeccd",fg:"#0a5c1e"};
    if(a) return {t:"STAGE 3 \u00b7 TOPPING",bg:"#fae6c0",fg:"#8a5a10"};
    if(e20!=null && e200!=null && e20<e200) return {t:"STAGE 4 \u00b7 DOWNTREND",bg:"#f6c3c3",fg:"#7a1010"};
    return {t:"STAGE 1 \u00b7 BASE",bg:"#e6e6ea",fg:"#555"};
  }
  function drawChart(cv, closes, prev){
    var dpr=window.devicePixelRatio||1, w=cv.clientWidth||340, h=150;
    cv.width=w*dpr; cv.height=h*dpr; cv.style.height=h+"px";
    var ctx=cv.getContext("2d"); ctx.scale(dpr,dpr); ctx.clearRect(0,0,w,h);
    if(!closes||closes.length<2) return;
    var mn=Math.min.apply(null,closes), mx=Math.max.apply(null,closes);
    if(prev!=null){ mn=Math.min(mn,prev); mx=Math.max(mx,prev); }
    var pad=8, rng=(mx-mn)||1;
    function X(i){ return pad+(w-2*pad)*i/(closes.length-1); }
    function Y(v){ return h-pad-(h-2*pad)*(v-mn)/rng; }
    if(prev!=null){ ctx.strokeStyle="#c9c9d0"; ctx.setLineDash([4,4]); ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(pad,Y(prev)); ctx.lineTo(w-pad,Y(prev)); ctx.stroke(); ctx.setLineDash([]); }
    var up=closes[closes.length-1]>=closes[0];
    ctx.strokeStyle=up?"#16a34a":"#dc2626"; ctx.lineWidth=1.8; ctx.beginPath();
    closes.forEach(function(v,i){ if(i===0) ctx.moveTo(X(i),Y(v)); else ctx.lineTo(X(i),Y(v)); });
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.font="9px monospace";
    ctx.fillStyle="rgba(255,255,255,.85)"; ctx.fillRect(pad,2,46,12); ctx.fillRect(pad,h-13,46,12);
    ctx.fillStyle="rgba(120,120,130,.95)";
    ctx.fillText(nf(mx,1),pad+1,11); ctx.fillText(nf(mn,1),pad+1,h-4);
  }
  function open(sym){

    h+='<div class="cocell"><div class="k">mcap \u20b9Cr</div><div class="v">'+nf(((sf["Market Cap"]||0)||((f.marketCap||0)/1e7))/100,0)+'</div></div>';
    h+='<div class="cocell"><div class="k">52w high</div><div class="v">'+nf(sc.high_52w||sf["high_52w"],1)+'</div></div>';

    h+='<div class="cocell"><div class="k">beta</div><div class="v">'+nf(f.beta,2)+'</div></div>';
    h+='</div>';
    /* stage */
    var st=stage(sc);
    h+='<div class="cosec">\uD83D\uDCCD Stage (Wyckoff-style)</div><span class="cobadge" style="background:'+st.bg+';color:'+st.fg+'">'+esc(st.t)+'</span>';
    /* chart */

<script>
/* ArthaSaar — round 21: Deep Fundamentals = computed Q-Score. Ranked quality screener + block inside the company card. */
(function(){ "use strict";
  function base(){ return location.pathname.indexOf("/app/")>=0 ? "../data/" : "data/"; }
  function J(f){ return fetch(base()+f,{cache:"no-store"}).then(function(r){ return r.ok?r.json():null; }).catch(function(){ return null; }); }
  function esc(s){ return String(s==null?"":s).replace(/[&<>"]/g,function(c){return {"&":"&amp;","<":"&lt;",">":"&gt;",'"':"&quot;"}[c];}); }
  function nf(x,d){ return (x==null||isNaN(x))?"—":Number(x).toLocaleString("en-IN",{maximumFractionDigits:d==null?2:d}); }
  var SF={},FUND={},CI={},ROWS=[];
  function qscore(sym){
    var sf=SF[sym]||{}, f=FUND[sym]||{};
    var roe=(sf["ROE"]!=null?sf["ROE"]:(f.returnOnEquity!=null?f.returnOnEquity*100:null));
    var roce=sf["ROCE"];
    var np=sf["Net Profit"]||[], sales=sf["Sales"]||[], opm=sf["OPM %"];
    if(typeof opm!=="number") opm=null;
    var dte=(f.debtToEquity!=null?f.debtToEquity/100:null);
    var dy=(sf["Dividend Yield"]!=null?sf["Dividend Yield"]:f.dividendYield);
    var pe=(sf["Stock P/E"]!=null?sf["Stock P/E"]:f.trailingPE);
    var sy=sf["Sales_yoy"], ny=sf["Net Profit_yoy"];
    var items=[
      {l:"ROE \u2265 15%", ok: roe!=null && roe>=15, v: roe!=null?nf(roe,1)+"%":null},
      {l:"ROCE \u2265 15%", ok: roce!=null && roce>=15, v: roce!=null?nf(roce,1)+"%":null},
      {l:"Net profit positive", ok: np.length>0 && np[np.length-1]>0, v: np.length?nf(np[np.length-1],0):null},
      {l:"Net profit growing YoY", ok: ny!=null && ny>0, v: ny!=null?nf(ny,1)+"%":null},
      {l:"Sales growing YoY", ok: sy!=null && sy>0, v: sy!=null?nf(sy,1)+"%":null},
      {l:"Operating margin \u2265 15%", ok: opm!=null && opm>=15, v: opm!=null?nf(opm,1)+"%":null},
      {l:"Debt / Equity \u2264 1", ok: dte!=null && dte<=1, v: dte!=null?nf(dte,2):null},
      {l:"Dividend yield \u2265 0.5%", ok: dy!=null && dy>=0.5, v: dy!=null?nf(dy,2)+"%":null},
      {l:"P/E \u2264 40", ok: pe!=null && pe>0 && pe<=40, v: pe!=null?nf(pe,1):null}
    ];
    return {score:items.filter(function(i){return i.ok;}).length, items:items};
  }
  window.__qscore=qscore;
  function badge(s){ var bg=s>=7?"#cdeccd":s>=5?"#fae6c0":"#f6c3c3", fg=s>=7?"#0a5c1e":s>=5?"#8a5a10":"#7a1010"; return '<span class="qbadge" style="background:'+bg+';color:'+fg+'">'+s+'/9</span>'; }
  function deepInto(sym){
    var body=document.querySelector(".cofs .cobody"); if(!body||body.querySelector(".codeep")) return;
    var q=qscore(sym); if(!q) return;
    var h='<div class="codeep"><div class="cosec">\uD83D\uDD2C Deep Fundamentals \u00b7 Q-Score</div>';
    h+='<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;margin-bottom:6px">'+badge(q.score)+'<span style="font-size:9.5px;color:var(--dim)">computed from screener-fundamentals \u2014 ROE, ROCE, growth, margin, debt, dividend, P/E</span></div>';
    q.items.forEach(function(i){ h+='<div class="qrow"><span>'+esc(i.l)+'</span><b class="'+(i.ok?"up":"dn")+'">'+(i.ok?"\u2713":"\u2717")+(i.v?" "+esc(i.v):"")+'</b></div>'; });
    h+='</div>';
    var el=document.createElement("div"); el.innerHTML=h; el=el.firstChild;
    var note=body.lastElementChild;
    if(note && note.className && note.className.indexOf("conote")>-1) body.insertBefore(el, note); else body.appendChild(el);
  }
  /* wrap the company card so the deep block is always added */
  function wrapFS(){
    if(!window.openCompanyFS || window.openCompanyFS._deepw) return;
    var orig=window.openCompanyFS;
    var w=function(sym){ orig(sym); setTimeout(function(){ deepInto(sym); },40); };
    w._deepw=1; window.openCompanyFS=w;
  }
  function buildDeep(){
    var host=document.getElementById("v-deepfund"); if(!host) return;
    [].slice.call(host.querySelectorAll(".kpis, .card")).forEach(function(el){ if(el.id!=="as-deep-card" && !(el.closest&&el.closest(".deepwrap"))) el.remove(); });
    if(document.getElementById("as-deep-card")){ var tbx=document.getElementById("deepBody"); if(tbx && !tbx.querySelector("tr") && ROWS.length){ var qx=document.getElementById("deepQ"); render(qx?qx.value:""); } return; }
    var wrap=document.createElement("div"); wrap.className="deepwrap";
    wrap.innerHTML='<div class="card deepsearch" style="margin-bottom:8px"><div class="dsearch-w"><input class="dsearch" id="deepQ" type="search" placeholder="Search stock name or symbol\u2026"></div></div>'+
      '<div class="deepnote">All '+ROWS.length+' stocks ranked by <b>Q-Score</b> (0\u20139) \u2014 a transparent formula on screener-fundamentals: ROE, ROCE, profit &amp; sales growth, operating margin, debt/equity, dividend yield, P/E. Tap any stock for its full card + deep fundamentals. Not investment advice.</div>'+
      '<div class="card" id="as-deep-card" style="padding:0;overflow:auto;max-height:62vh"><table><thead><tr><th>Stock</th><th>Q</th><th>ROE</th><th>ROCE</th><th>P/E</th><th>D/E</th></tr></thead><tbody id="deepBody"></tbody></table></div>';
    var fh=host.querySelector(".fshead"); if(fh) host.insertBefore(wrap, fh.nextSibling); else host.insertBefore(wrap, host.firstChild);
    var q=document.getElementById("deepQ"); if(q) q.addEventListener("input", function(){ render(q.value); });
    render("");
  }
  function render(q){
    q=(q||"").toLowerCase().trim();
    var list=ROWS.filter(function(r){ return !q || r.sym.toLowerCase().indexOf(q)>-1 || (r.name||"").toLowerCase().indexOf(q)>-1; });
    var tb=document.getElementById("deepBody"); if(!tb) return;
    tb.innerHTML=list.slice(0,500).map(function(r){
      return '<tr data-sym="'+esc(r.sym)+'"><td><b>'+esc(r.sym)+'</b> <small style="color:var(--dim)">'+esc((r.name||"").slice(0,22))+'</small></td><td>'+badge(r.score)+'</td><td>'+nf(r.roe,1)+'%</td><td>'+nf(r.roce,1)+'%</td><td>'+nf(r.pe,1)+'</td><td>'+nf(r.dte,2)+'</td></tr>';
    }).join("");
    tb.querySelectorAll("tr[data-sym]").forEach(function(tr){ tr.addEventListener("click", function(){ var s=tr.getAttribute("data-sym"); if(window.openCompanyFS) window.openCompanyFS(s); }); });
  }
  Promise.all([J("screener-fundamentals.json"),J("fundamentals.json"),J("company-index.json")]).then(function(r){
    SF=(r[0]&&r[0].stocks)||{}; FUND=r[1]||{}; CI=r[2]||{};
    ROWS=Object.keys(SF).map(function(k){ var q=qscore(k), f=FUND[k]||{}; return {sym:k, name:(CI[k]||{}).name||"", score:q.score, roe:SF[k]["ROE"], roce:SF[k]["ROCE"], pe:(SF[k]["Stock P/E"]!=null?SF[k]["Stock P/E"]:f.trailingPE), dte:(f.debtToEquity!=null?f.debtToEquity/100:null)}; });
    ROWS.sort(function(a,b){ return b.score-a.score || ((SF[b.sym]["Market Cap"]||0)-(SF[a.sym]["Market Cap"]||0)); });
    buildDeep(); render(""); wrapFS();
  });
  var n=0,iv=setInterval(function(){ buildDeep(); wrapFS(); if(++n>25) clearInterval(iv); },600);
  window.addEventListener("hashchange",function(){ setTimeout(function(){ buildDeep(); wrapFS(); },300); });
})();
</script>

<script>
/* ArthaSaar — round 23: Crypto -> full-screen coin card (price, 24h/7d/30d, mcap, volume, ATH, market context, chart) */
(function(){ "use strict";
  function base(){ return location.pathname.indexOf("/app/")>=0 ? "../data/" : "data/"; }
  function J(f){ return fetch(base()+f,{cache:"no-store"}).then(function(r){ return r.ok?r.json():null; }).catch(function(){ return null; }); }
  function esc(s){ return String(s==null?"":s).replace(/[&<>"]/g,function(c){return {"&":"&amp;","<":"&lt;",">":"&gt;",'"':"&quot;"}[c];}); }
  function nf(x,d){ return (x==null||isNaN(x))?"—":Number(x).toLocaleString("en-IN",{maximumFractionDigits:d==null?2:d}); }
  function pc(x,d){ return (x==null||isNaN(x))?"—":(x>=0?"+":"")+Number(x).toFixed(d==null?1:d)+"%"; }
  function usd(x){ if(x==null||isNaN(x)) return "—"; if(Math.abs(x)>=1e12) return "$"+nf(x/1e12,2)+"T"; if(Math.abs(x)>=1e9) return "$"+nf(x/1e9,2)+"B"; if(Math.abs(x)>=1e6) return "$"+nf(x/1e6,2)+"M"; return "$"+nf(x,2); }
  var C=null, CAND={};
  function drawChart(cv, closes, prev){
    var dpr=window.devicePixelRatio||1, w=cv.clientWidth||340, h=140;
    cv.width=w*dpr; cv.height=h*dpr; cv.style.height=h+"px";
    var ctx=cv.getContext("2d"); ctx.scale(dpr,dpr); ctx.clearRect(0,0,w,h);
    if(!closes||closes.length<2) return;
    var mn=Math.min.apply(null,closes), mx=Math.max.apply(null,closes);
    if(prev!=null){ mn=Math.min(mn,prev); mx=Math.max(mx,prev); }
    var pad=8, rng=(mx-mn)||1;
    function X(i){ return pad+(w-2*pad)*i/(closes.length-1); }
    function Y(v){ return h-pad-(h-2*pad)*(v-mn)/rng; }
    if(prev!=null){ ctx.strokeStyle="#c9c9d0"; ctx.setLineDash([4,4]); ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(pad,Y(prev)); ctx.lineTo(w-pad,Y(prev)); ctx.stroke(); ctx.setLineDash([]); }
    var up=closes[closes.length-1]>=closes[0];
    ctx.strokeStyle=up?"#16a34a":"#dc2626"; ctx.lineWidth=1.8; ctx.beginPath();
    closes.forEach(function(v,i){ if(i===0) ctx.moveTo(X(i),Y(v)); else ctx.lineTo(X(i),Y(v)); });
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.font="9px monospace"; ctx.fillStyle="rgba(255,255,255,.85)"; ctx.fillRect(pad,2,58,12); ctx.fillRect(pad,h-13,58,12);
    ctx.fillStyle="rgba(120,120,130,.95)"; ctx.fillText(nf(mx,0),pad+1,11); ctx.fillText(nf(mn,0),pad+1,h-4);
  }
  function open(sym){
    if(!sym) return; sym=String(sym).toUpperCase();
    var c=(C.top||[]).filter(function(x){ return String(x.symbol).toUpperCase()===sym; })[0]; if(!c) return;
    var old=document.querySelector(".crfs"); if(old) old.remove();
    var g=C.global||{}, fg=C.fear_greed||{};
    var box=document.createElement("div"); box.className="crfs";
    var h='<div class="crhead"><div><b>'+esc(c.name||sym)+'</b><small>'+esc(sym)+' \u00b7 rank #'+esc(c.rank||"—")+' \u00b7 crypto</small></div><button class="xbtn crx" type="button">\u2715 CLOSE</button></div>';
    h+='<div class="crbody">';
    h+='<div class="crgrid">';
    h+='<div class="crcell"><div class="k">price</div><div class="v">'+usd(c.price_usd)+'</div></div>';
    h+='<div class="crcell"><div class="k">24h</div><div class="v '+(c.chg_24h_pct>=0?"up":"dn")+'">'+pc(c.chg_24h_pct)+'</div></div>';
    h+='<div class="crcell"><div class="k">7d</div><div class="v '+(c.chg_7d_pct>=0?"up":"dn")+'">'+pc(c.chg_7d_pct)+'</div></div>';
    h+='<div class="crcell"><div class="k">30d</div><div class="v '+(c.chg_30d_pct>=0?"up":"dn")+'">'+pc(c.chg_30d_pct)+'</div></div>';
    h+='<div class="crcell"><div class="k">market cap</div><div class="v">'+usd(c.market_cap)+'</div></div>';
    h+='<div class="crcell"><div class="k">24h volume</div><div class="v">'+usd(c.volume_usd)+'</div></div>';
    h+='</div>';
    /* performance bars */
    h+='<div class="crsec">\uD83D\uDCC8 Performance</div>';
    var per=[["24h",c.chg_24h_pct],["7d",c.chg_7d_pct],["30d",c.chg_30d_pct]];
    var mx=0; per.forEach(function(p){ if(p[1]!=null) mx=Math.max(mx,Math.abs(p[1])); }); mx=mx||1;
    h+='<div class="crbars">'+per.map(function(p){ var hh=(p[1]!=null)?Math.max(3,Math.abs(p[1])/mx*95):0; return '<div style="flex:1"><div class="crbgrp"><i style="height:'+hh+'px;background:'+((p[1]||0)>=0?"#16a34a":"#dc2626")+'"></i></div><div class="crlab">'+p[0]+' '+pc(p[1])+'</div></div>'; }).join("")+'</div>';
    /* chart */
    h+='<div class="crsec">\uD83D\uDD6F\uFE0F Intraday Chart</div>';
    var cd=CAND[sym];
    if(cd && cd["1h"] && cd["1h"].c && cd["1h"].c.length){ h+='<div class="card" style="padding:8px;margin:0 0 4px"><canvas id="crChart" style="width:100%;display:block"></canvas><div style="font-size:9.5px;color:var(--dim);margin-top:3px">intraday 1h \u00b7 '+cd["1h"].c.length+' bars \u00b7 prev close dashed</div></div>'; }
    else h+='<div class="crnote">Intraday candle feed covers BTC only \u2014 other coins have no free intraday series here.</div>';
    /* ATH */
    h+='<div class="crsec">\uD83C\uDFAF Distance from All-Time High</div>';
    h+='<div class="crrow"><span>From ATH</span><b class="dn">'+pc(c.from_ath_pct)+'</b></div>';
    /* market context */
    h+='<div class="crsec">\uD83C\uDF10 Market Context</div>';
    h+='<div class="crrow"><span>Fear &amp; Greed</span><b>'+esc(fg.value==null?"—":fg.value)+'/100 \u00b7 '+esc(fg.label||"")+'</b></div>';
    h+='<div class="crgauge"><i style="left:'+Math.max(0,Math.min(100,fg.value||0))+'%"></i></div>';
    h+='<div class="crrow"><span>Total market cap</span><b>'+usd(g.total_market_cap_usd)+' \u00b7 '+pc(g.mcap_chg_24h_pct)+'</b></div>';
    h+='<div class="crrow"><span>BTC / ETH dominance</span><b>'+nf(g.btc_dominance,1)+'% / '+nf(g.eth_dominance,1)+'%</b></div>';
    h+='<div class="crrow"><span>24h total volume</span><b>'+usd(g.total_volume_usd)+'</b></div>';
    h+='<div class="crnote">Crypto has no P/E, promoter holding or dividends \u2014 so none of those stock sections apply. On-chain data (active addresses, TVL, supply schedule) is not in this free feed. Source: CoinGecko public API via the repo pipeline.</div>';
    h+='</div>';
    box.innerHTML=h;
    document.body.appendChild(box);
    box.querySelector(".crx").addEventListener("click", function(){ box.remove(); });
    var cv=box.querySelector("#crChart"); if(cv){ var cl=(CAND[sym]&&CAND[sym]["1h"]&&CAND[sym]["1h"].c)||[]; if(cl.length) drawChart(cv, cl, CAND[sym].pc); }
  }
  window.openCryptoFS=open;
  function wire(){
    var sc=document.getElementById("v-crypto"); if(!sc||sc._crfsw) return; sc._crfsw=1;
    sc.addEventListener("click", function(e){
      var tr=e.target.closest("tbody tr"); if(!tr) return;
      var b=tr.querySelector("td b"); if(!b) return;
      var sym=b.textContent.trim();
      if(sym && window.openCryptoFS) window.openCryptoFS(sym);
    }, true);
  }
  Promise.all([J("crypto.json"),J("candles.json")]).then(function(r){ C=r[0]||{}; CAND=(r[1]&&r[1].syms)||{}; wire(); });
  var n=0,iv=setInterval(function(){ wire(); if(++n>30) clearInterval(iv); },600);
  window.addEventListener("hashchange",function(){ setTimeout(wire,300); });
})();
