    if(String(r.above_ema200)==="true")reasons.push("above 200D EMA");
    if(numv(r.rsi14)!=null&&numv(r.rsi14)>=60)reasons.push("RSI >= 60");
    if(del!=null&&numv(del)>=60)reasons.push("delivery >= 60%");
    if(fo&&fo.oi_chg>0&&numv(r.change_pct)>0)reasons.push("long-build style F&O snapshot");
    if(fo&&fo.oi_chg>0&&numv(r.change_pct)<0)reasons.push("short-build style F&O snapshot");
    if(!reasons.length)reasons.push("no special trigger in the stored snapshot; profile is descriptive");
    var body='<div class="rr-metric-grid">'+
      '<div class="rr-metric"><small>PRICE</small><b>'+n(r.price||last&&last.close)+'</b></div>'+

      '<div class="rr-metric"><small>5D</small><b class="'+(ret5>=0?"up":"dn")+'">'+p(ret5)+'</b></div>'+
      '<div class="rr-metric"><small>20D</small><b class="'+(ret20>=0?"up":"dn")+'">'+p(ret20)+'</b></div>'+
      '<div class="rr-metric"><small>52W HIGH</small><b>'+n(r.high_52w)+'</b></div>'+
      '<div class="rr-metric"><small>RSI14</small><b>'+n(r.rsi14)+'</b></div>'+
      '<div class="rr-metric"><small>EMA200</small><b>'+n(r.ema200)+'</b></div>'+
      '<div class="rr-metric"><small>DELIVERY</small><b>'+pct0(del)+'</b></div>'+
      '</div>';
    body+='<div class="rr-detail-section"><div class="sh2">WHY THIS STOCK IS IN RESEARCH CONTEXT</div>'+reasons.map(function(x){return'<div class="ni"><b>'+esc(x)+'</b></div>';}).join("")+'</div>';
    body+='<div class="rr-detail-section"><div class="sh2">TREND / MOMENTUM</div>'+
      row("20D return",p(ret20))+row("60D return",p(r.return_60d))+row("Relative strength vs NIFTY",p(rel20))+row("MACD histogram",n(r.macd_hist))+row("20D volume ratio",n(r.vol_vs_avg20))+'</div>';

      row("Expiry",fo?fo.expiry:"Not available")+row("OI",fo?n(fo.oi):"—")+row("OI change",fo?n(fo.oi_chg):"—")+row("Basis",fo?p(fo.basis_pct):"—")+'</div>';
    body+='<div class="rr-detail-section"><div class="sh2">CORPORATE / RESULTS</div>'+eventBody(filings)+
      (next?'<div class="ni"><b>Next result / event: '+esc(next.date||"—")+'</b><small>'+esc(next.company||"")+'</small></div>':"")+'</div>';
    var ff=STATE.fundamentals[symbol]||STATE.fundamentals[symbol+".NS"]||{};    var fMcap=fundamentalValue(ff,["Market Cap","MCap","MarketCap","market_cap"]);

      row("Sales growth",fundamentalCell(fSales))+row("Profit growth",fundamentalCell(fProfit))+'</div></div>';

function localGet(key, fallback){
  try{var v=localStorage.getItem(key);return v?JSON.parse(v):fallback;}catch(e){return fallback;}
}
function localSet(key,val){try{localStorage.setItem(key,JSON.stringify(val));}catch(e){}}

function candleDayRows(sym){
  var x=(STATE.candles||{})[sym]||{}, z=x["5m"]||{}, t=z.t||[],o=z.o||[],h=z.h||[],l=z.l||[],cl=z.c||[];
  var map={};
  for(var i=0;i<t.length;i++){
    var dt=new Date(Number(t[i])*1000),day=dt.getUTCFullYear()+"-"+String(dt.getUTCMonth()+1).padStart(2,"0")+"-"+String(dt.getUTCDate()).padStart(2,"0");
    if(!map[day])map[day]=[];
    map[day].push({t:Number(t[i]),o:numv(o[i]),h:numv(h[i]),l:numv(l[i]),c:numv(cl[i])});
  }
  var days=Object.keys(map).sort();
  return {days:days,map:map};
}
function candleGapRows(){
  var out=[];
  Object.keys(STATE.candles||{}).forEach(function(sym){
    var x=candleDayRows(sym),days=x.days;if(days.length<2)return;
    var lastDay=days[days.length-1],prevDay=days[days.length-2],a=x.map[lastDay]||[],p0=x.map[prevDay]||[];
    var open=a.length?a[0].o:null,prevClose=p0.length?p0[p0.length-1].c:null;
    if(open!=null&&prevClose){out.push({symbol:sym,gap_pct:(open/prevClose-1)*100,open:open,previous_close:prevClose,date:lastDay});}
  });
  out.sort(function(a,b){return Math.abs(b.gap_pct)-Math.abs(a.gap_pct);});
  return out;
}
function candleRangeRows(){
  var out=[];
  Object.keys(STATE.candles||{}).forEach(function(sym){
    var x=candleDayRows(sym),days=x.days;if(!days.length)return;
    var a=x.map[days[days.length-1]]||[];if(!a.length)return;
    var hi=Math.max.apply(null,a.map(function(z){return z.h==null?-Infinity:z.h;})),lo=Math.min.apply(null,a.map(function(z){return z.l==null?Infinity:z.l;})),op=a[0].o;
    if(isFinite(hi)&&isFinite(lo)&&op){out.push({symbol:sym,session_range_pct:(hi-lo)/op*100,date:days[days.length-1]});}
  });
  out.sort(function(a,b){return b.session_range_pct-a.session_range_pct;});
  return out;
}


function exportCSV(rows, filename){
  rows=rows||[];
  if(!rows.length){alert("No rows to export.");return;}
  var keys=[],seen={};
  rows.forEach(function(r){Object.keys(r||{}).forEach(function(k){if(!seen[k]){seen[k]=1;keys.push(k);}});});
  function cell(v){var s=v==null?"":String(v);return '"'+s.replace(/"/g,'""')+'"';}
  var csv=keys.map(cell).join(",")+"\n"+rows.map(function(r){return keys.map(function(k){return cell(r[k]);}).join(",");}).join("\n");
  var blob=new Blob([csv],{type:"text/csv;charset=utf-8"});
  var a=document.createElement("a");a.href=URL.createObjectURL(blob);a.download=filename||"arthasaar-export.csv";document.body.appendChild(a);a.click();setTimeout(function(){URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href);a.remove();},0);
}

function compareProfile(sym){
  var p=STATE.stocks[String(sym||"").toUpperCase()]||{};
  return {symbol:String(sym||"").toUpperCase(),company:p.company||"",price:numv(p.price),change_pct:numv(p.change_pct),return_20d:numv(p.return_20d),return_60d:numv(p.return_60d),rsi14:numv(p.rsi14),ema200:numv(p.ema200),vol_vs_avg20:numv(p.vol_vs_avg20),above_ema200:String(p.above_ema200)==="true",industry:p.industry||""};
}
function renderCompare(a,b){
  var x=compareProfile(a),y=compareProfile(b);
  function diff(v1,v2){if(v1==null||v2==null)return "—";var d=v1-v2;return (d>=0?"+":"")+d.toFixed(2);}
  return '<div class="rr-mini-table-wrap"><table class="rr-mini-table"><thead><tr><th>Metric</th><th>'+esc(x.symbol)+'</th><th>'+esc(y.symbol)+'</th><th>Δ A-B</th></tr></thead><tbody>'+
    [["Price",x.price,y.price,n],["1D %",x.change_pct,y.change_pct,p],["20D %",x.return_20d,y.return_20d,p],["60D %",x.return_60d,y.return_60d,p],["RSI",x.rsi14,y.rsi14,n],["EMA200",x.ema200,y.ema200,n],["Volume / 20D",x.vol_vs_avg20,y.vol_vs_avg20,n],["Above EMA200",x.above_ema200?"YES":"NO",y.above_ema200?"YES":"NO",function(){return"—";}],["Sector",x.industry||"—",y.industry||"—",function(){return x.industry===y.industry?"same":"different";}]]
    .map(function(r){var fmt=r[3];return'<tr><td>'+esc(r[0])+'</td><td class="numr">'+esc(typeof fmt==="function"&&r[1]!==null&&r[1]!==undefined?fmt(r[1]):r[1])+'</td><td class="numr">'+esc(typeof fmt==="function"&&r[2]!==null&&r[2]!==undefined?fmt(r[2]):r[2])+'</td><td class="numr">'+esc(diff(r[1],r[2]))+'</td></tr>';}).join("")+
    '</tbody></table></div>';
}
function sectorRows(sector){
  var arr=Object.keys(STATE.stocks).map(function(k){return STATE.stocks[k];}).filter(function(x){return String(x.industry||"Other")===sector;});
  arr.sort(function(a,b){return numv(b.return_20d||b.change_pct)-numv(a.return_20d||a.change_pct);});
  return arr.slice(0,12);
}

function notebook(){
  var obj=localGet("artha_research_notebook_v1",{watch:[],notes:{}});
  return obj&&obj.watch?obj:{watch:[],notes:{}};
}
function toggleWatch(sym){
  var nb=notebook(),s=String(sym||"").toUpperCase();
  nb.watch=nb.watch||[];var i=nb.watch.indexOf(s);
  if(i>=0)nb.watch.splice(i,1);else nb.watch.unshift(s);
  localSet("artha_research_notebook_v1",nb);
  return nb;
}

function maybeNotifyAlerts(payload){
  if(!payload||!("Notification" in window)||Notification.permission!=="granted")return;
  var last=localGet("artha_research_last_alert_update","");
  if(last===payload.updated)return;
  var top=(payload.alerts||[]).slice(0,3);
  if(top.length){try{new Notification("ArthaSaar Research Alerts",{body:top.map(function(x){return (x.symbol?x.symbol+" · ":"")+x.title;}).join("\n")});}catch(e){}}
  localSet("artha_research_last_alert_update",payload.updated||"");
}
function enableBrowserAlerts(){
  if(!("Notification" in window)){alert("Browser notifications are not supported here.");return;}
  Notification.requestPermission().then(function(p){alert(p==="granted"?"Browser alerts enabled for this session/browser.":"Notification permission was not granted.");});
}

function wireLab(){
  var activeTab=localGet("artha_research_active_tab","overview");
  function setTab(tab){
    document.querySelectorAll("[data-rr-tab]").forEach(function(b){b.classList.toggle("on",b.getAttribute("data-rr-tab")===tab);});
    document.querySelectorAll("[data-rr-panel]").forEach(function(p){p.classList.toggle("on",p.getAttribute("data-rr-panel")===tab);});
    localSet("artha_research_active_tab",tab);
    if(tab==="lab"){setTimeout(function(){var rs=document.getElementById("rr-replay-select");if(rs)renderReplay(rs.value);},0);}
  }
  document.querySelectorAll("[data-rr-tab]").forEach(function(b){b.addEventListener("click",function(){setTab(b.getAttribute("data-rr-tab"));});});
  if(document.querySelector('[data-rr-tab="'+activeTab+'"]'))setTab(activeTab);else setTab("overview");

  var input=document.getElementById("rr-stock-search"),res=document.getElementById("rr-search-results");
  function paint(q){
    if(!res)return;
    var arr=stockUniverseSearch(q);
    if(!q){res.innerHTML="";return;}
    res.innerHTML='<div class="rr-results">'+(arr.length?arr.map(function(x){return'<button class="rr-result" data-symbol="'+esc(String(x.symbol).toUpperCase())+'"><b>'+esc(x.symbol)+'</b><small>'+esc(x.company||"")+'</small></button>';}).join(""):'<div class="mut">No matching stock.</div>')+'</div>';
  }
  if(input)input.addEventListener("input",function(){paint(input.value);});
  var exs=document.getElementById("rr-export-search");if(exs)exs.addEventListener("click",function(){exportCSV(stockUniverseSearch(input&&input.value),"arthasaar-stock-search.csv");});
  var clear=document.getElementById("rr-clear-search");
  if(clear)clear.addEventListener("click",function(){if(input)input.value="";paint("");if(input)input.focus();});

  var replay=document.getElementById("rr-replay-select");
  if(replay){renderReplay(replay.value);replay.addEventListener("change",function(){renderReplay(replay.value);});}
  var ca=document.getElementById("rr-compare-a"),cb=document.getElementById("rr-compare-b"),cg=document.getElementById("rr-compare-go"),cp=document.getElementById("rr-compare-body");
  function doCompare(){
    if(!cp)return;
    var a=String(ca&&ca.value||"").toUpperCase(),b=String(cb&&cb.value||"").toUpperCase();
    cp.innerHTML='<div class="mut">Loading comparison history…</div>';
    Promise.all([
      fetch("data/history/"+encodeURIComponent(a)+".json?v="+Date.now(),{cache:"no-store"}).then(function(r){return r.ok?r.json():[];}).catch(function(){return[];}),
      fetch("data/history/"+encodeURIComponent(b)+".json?v="+Date.now(),{cache:"no-store"}).then(function(r){return r.ok?r.json():[];}).catch(function(){return[];})
    ]).then(function(v){
      [a,b].forEach(function(sym,i){
        var arr=v[i]||[];
        if(arr.length){
          var last=arr[arr.length-1],p20=arr.length>20?numv(arr[arr.length-21].close):null,q=STATE.stocks[sym]||{};
          q.return_20d=p20&&numv(last.close)?((numv(last.close)/p20-1)*100):null;STATE.stocks[sym]=q;
        }
      });
      cp.innerHTML=renderCompare(a,b);
    });
  }
  if(cg)cg.addEventListener("click",doCompare);doCompare();

  var ss=document.getElementById("rr-sector-select");if(ss){renderSectorPick(ss.value);ss.addEventListener("change",function(){renderSectorPick(ss.value);});}

  var nb=notebook(),ns=document.getElementById("rr-note-symbol"),nt=document.getElementById("rr-note-text"),nw=document.getElementById("rr-note-watch"),nsv=document.getElementById("rr-note-save");
  if(nw)nw.addEventListener("click",function(){toggleWatch(ns.value);render(STATE.radar);});
  if(nsv)nsv.addEventListener("click",function(){saveNote(ns.value,nt.value);alert("Saved in this browser.");});
  if(ns)ns.addEventListener("change",function(){var x=notebook();if(nt)nt.value=(x.notes||{})[String(ns.value).toUpperCase()]||"";});

  var ex=document.getElementById("rr-export-backtest");if(ex)ex.addEventListener("click",function(){var bt=(STATE.radar.research_lab||{}).backtests||{};var rows=Object.keys(bt.signals||{}).map(function(k){return Object.assign({signal:k},bt.signals[k]);});exportCSV(rows,"arthasaar-backtest.csv");});
  var ea=document.getElementById("rr-export-alerts");if(ea)ea.addEventListener("click",function(){exportCSV((STATE.alerts||{}).alerts||[],"arthasaar-alerts.csv");});
  var en=document.getElementById("rr-browser-alerts");if(en)en.addEventListener("click",enableBrowserAlerts);

  document.querySelectorAll("[data-unwatch]").forEach(function(el){el.addEventListener("click",function(){var x=notebook();x.watch=(x.watch||[]).filter(function(v){return v!==el.getAttribute("data-unwatch");});localSet("artha_research_notebook_v1",x);render(STATE.radar);});});
}

function optionalJSON(path,def){
  return fetch(path+"?v="+Date.now(),{cache:"no-store"}).then(function(r){if(!r.ok)throw Error(path+" "+r.status);return r.json();}).catch(function(){return def;});
}
function loadSupport(){
  var csvP=fetch("data/brain-screener.csv?v="+Date.now(),{cache:"no-store"}).then(function(r){if(!r.ok)throw Error("csv "+r.status);return r.text();}).catch(function(){return"";});
  return Promise.all([
    csvP,
    optionalJSON("data/delivery.json",{}),
    optionalJSON("data/futures.json",{}),
    optionalJSON("data/filings.json",{}),
    optionalJSON("data/results.json",{}),
    optionalJSON("data/research-alerts.json",{}),
    optionalJSON("data/data-health.json",{}),
    optionalJSON("data/research-market-history.json",{}),
    optionalJSON("data/research-signal-history.json",{}),
    optionalJSON("data/candles.json",{}),
    optionalJSON("data/screener-fundamentals.json",{})
  ]).then(function(vals){
    parseCSV(vals[0]).forEach(function(x){var sym=String(x.symbol||"").trim().toUpperCase();if(sym){x.return_20d=numv(x.return_20d);STATE.stocks[sym]=x;}});
    var d=vals[1]||{};STATE.delivery=d.d||{};
    STATE.futures=vals[2]||{};
    STATE.filings=(vals[3]||{}).filings||[];
    var rr=vals[4]||{};STATE.results={};(rr.results||[]).forEach(function(x){if(x.sym)STATE.results[String(x.sym).toUpperCase()]=x;});
    STATE.alerts=vals[5]||{};STATE.health=vals[6]||{};STATE.marketHistory=vals[7]||{};STATE.signalHistory=vals[8]||{};STATE.candles=(vals[9]||{}).syms||{};STATE.candlesUpdated=(vals[9]||{}).updated||null;STATE.fundamentals=(vals[10]||{}).stocks||{};maybeNotifyAlerts(STATE.alerts);
  });
}

    h.innerHTML='<div class="card" style="margin-top:10px;padding:18px"><b>Research Radar data could not load.</b><div class="mut" style="padding-left:0">Check Pages deployment / published data files. '+esc(e.message)+'</div></div>';
  });

document.addEventListener("click",function(e){
  var el=e.target.closest?e.target.closest("[data-symbol]"):null;
  if(el&&!el.hasAttribute("data-close-rr")){
    var sym=el.getAttribute("data-symbol");if(sym){e.preventDefault();openDetail(sym);}
  }
  var tw=e.target.closest?e.target.closest("[data-toggle-watch]"):null;
  if(tw){var sw=tw.getAttribute("data-toggle-watch");toggleWatch(sw);openDetail(sw);return;}
  var sn=e.target.closest?e.target.closest("[data-save-modal-note]"):null;
  if(sn){var snsym=sn.getAttribute("data-save-modal-note"),ta=document.getElementById("rr-modal-note");saveNote(snsym,ta?ta.value:"");alert("Saved in this browser.");return;}
  if(e.target.closest&&e.target.closest("[data-close-rr]")){
    var ov=document.getElementById("rr-overlay");if(ov)ov.classList.remove("open");
  }
});
document.addEventListener("keydown",function(e){if(e.key==="Escape"){var ov=document.getElementById("rr-overlay");if(ov)ov.classList.remove("open");}});
window.addEventListener("hashchange",function(){setTimeout(boot,100);});
if(document.readyState==="loading")document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded",function(){boot();});else boot();

})();

/* results.js — Q2 results calendar card (Events section me, Event Radar ke baad).
   Data: data/results.json — exchange filings se confirmed dates. */
(function () {
  "use strict";
  var R = null;
  var MOUNTED = false;
  function esc(s) {
    if (s == null) { s = ""; }
    return String(s).replace(/[&<>"']/g, function (c) {
      return "&#" + c.charCodeAt(0) + ";";
    });
  }
  var MON = ["Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun", "Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec"];
  var DAY = ["Sun", "Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat"];
  function fmt(d) {
    var p = d.split("-");
    var dt = new Date(+p[0], +p[1] - 1, +p[2]);
    return DAY[dt.getDay()] + " " + dt.getDate() + " " + MON[dt.getMonth()];
  }
  function panel() {
    if (!R || !R.results) return '<div class="note">results data nahi mila.</div>';
    var res = R.results.slice().sort(function (a, b) {
      var ka = a.date || "9999"; var kb = b.date || "9999";
      return ka < kb ? -1 : (ka > kb ? 1 : 0);
    });
    var today = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
    var byDate = {};
    for (var i = 0; i < res.length; i++) {
      var r = res[i];
      if (r.date && r.date < today) continue;
      var k = r.date || "expected";
      if (!byDate[k]) byDate[k] = [];
      byDate[k].push(r);
    }
    var keys = Object.keys(byDate);
    if (!keys.length) return '<div class="note">is season ke saare dates nikal gaye — naya season aane par update karunga.</div>';
    var h = "";
    for (var j = 0; j < keys.length; j++) {
      var kk = keys[j];
      if (kk === "expected") {
        for (var m = 0; m < byDate[kk].length; m++) {
          var e = byDate[kk][m];
          h += '<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;padding:4px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #333">' +
            '<span>' + esc(e.company) + ' <span class="note">(' + esc(e.sym || "") + ')</span></span>' +
            '<span class="note">' + esc(e.expected || "date aane wali hai") + "</span></div>";
        }
        continue;
      }
      var parts = [];
      for (var q = 0; q < byDate[kk].length; q++) {
        var it = byDate[kk][q];
        var t = esc(it.company);
        if (it.div) t += ' <span class="note">· ' + esc(it.div) + "</span>";
        if (it.call) t += ' <span class="note">· call ' + esc(it.call) + "</span>";
        if (it.conf === false) t += ' <span class="note">(tentative)</span>';
        parts.push(t);
      }
      h += '<div style="padding:5px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #333">' +
        '<b style="font-family:var(--mono,monospace)">' + fmt(kk) + "</b>" +
        '<div style="margin-top:2px">' + parts.join(" · ") + "</div></div>";
    }
    return h + '<div class="note" style="margin-top:6px">exchange filings se · naye dates aate hi update hongi</div>';
  }
  function draw() {
    var host = document.getElementById("resCard");
    if (!host) return false;
    host.innerHTML = panel();
    return true;
  }
  function mount() {
    if (MOUNTED || document.getElementById("resCard")) { return; }
    var ev = document.getElementById("events");
    if (!ev) return;
    var card = document.createElement("div");
    card.className = "card";
    card.innerHTML = '<div class="subhead">Results Calendar — ' + (R && R.quarter ? esc(R.quarter) : "Q2 FY27") + '</div><div id="resCard"></div>';
    ev.appendChild(card);
    MOUNTED = true;
    draw();
  }
  function boot() {
    fetch("data/results.json?t=" + Date.now())
      .then(function (r) { return r.json(); })
      .then(function (d) { R = d; mount(); draw(); })
      .catch(function () {});
  }
  var iv = setInterval(function () {
    if (MOUNTED) { clearInterval(iv); return; }
    mount();
  }, 3000);
  if (document.readyState === "loading") document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", boot);
  else boot();
})();

/* ArthaSaar v9 — clean, data-driven market workspace.
   Reads EOD JSON from ./data (falls back to ../data). No API keys, no build step. */
"use strict";

/* Surface any runtime error on the gate, so "nothing happens" becomes a visible message. */
window.addEventListener("error", function (e) {
  try {
    var g = document.getElementById("gateErr"), gate = document.getElementById("gate");
    if (g && gate && gate.style.display !== "none") g.textContent = "Error: " + (e.message || "script error");
  } catch (_) {}
});
window.addEventListener("unhandledrejection", function (e) {
  try {
    var g = document.getElementById("gateErr"), gate = document.getElementById("gate");
    if (g && gate && gate.style.display !== "none") g.textContent = "Error: " + ((e.reason && e.reason.message) || e.reason || "promise error");
  } catch (_) {}
});

/* ------------------------------ utils ------------------------------ */
const $ = (s, r = document) => r.querySelector(s);
const $$ = (s, r = document) => Array.from(r.querySelectorAll(s));
let BASE = "data/";
const CACHE = {};
let UID = 0;

async function probeBase() {
  const cands = ["data/", "../data/", "./", "../../data/"];
  for (const b of cands) {
    try {
      const r = await fetch(b + "fii-dii.json", { cache: "no-store" });
      if (r.ok) { BASE = b; return true; }
    } catch (e) { /* try next */ }
  }
  return false;
}
async function J(name) {
  if (CACHE[name] !== undefined) return CACHE[name];
  const r = await fetch(BASE + name, { cache: "no-store" });
  if (!r.ok) throw new Error(name + " HTTP " + r.status);
  const d = await r.json();
  CACHE[name] = d;
  return d;
}
const esc = (s) => String(s ?? "").replace(/[&<>"]/g, (c) => ({ "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;" }[c]));
function nf(x, d = 2) {
  if (x === null || x === undefined || x === "" || isNaN(x)) return "—";
  return Number(x).toLocaleString("en-IN", { maximumFractionDigits: d });
}
const money = (x, d = 0) => (x == null || isNaN(x)) ? "—" : "₹" + nf(x, d);
const cr = (x) => (x == null || isNaN(x)) ? "—" : "₹" + nf(x, 0) + " Cr";
const sign = (x, d = 2) => (x == null || isNaN(x)) ? "—" : (x > 0 ? "+" : "") + nf(x, d) + "%";
const updown = (x) => x > 0 ? "up" : x < 0 ? "down" : "mut";
const cls = (x) => x > 0 ? "up" : x < 0 ? "down" : "";
const cap = (s) => String(s || "").replace(/\b\w/g, (m) => m.toUpperCase());
function bytesAgo(iso) {
  if (!iso) return "";
  const t = new Date(iso).getTime();
  if (isNaN(t)) return iso;
  const s = (Date.now() - t) / 1000;
  if (s < 3600) return Math.max(1, Math.round(s / 60)) + "m ago";
  if (s < 86400) return Math.round(s / 3600) + "h ago";
  return Math.round(s / 86400) + "d ago";
}
function toast(msg) {
  const t = $("#toast"); t.textContent = msg; t.hidden = false;
  clearTimeout(t._h); t._h = setTimeout(() => { t.hidden = true; }, 2200);
}

/* ------------------------------ charts ------------------------------ */
function spark(vals, w = 120, h = 34, color = "#5b9dff") {
  if (!vals || vals.length < 2) return "";
  const mn = Math.min(...vals), mx = Math.max(...vals), rg = (mx - mn) || 1;
  const pts = vals.map((v, i) => [i / (vals.length - 1) * w, h - 3 - (v - mn) / rg * (h - 6)]);
  const d = pts.map((p, i) => (i ? "L" : "M") + p[0].toFixed(1) + " " + p[1].toFixed(1)).join(" ");
  return `<svg class="spark" viewBox="0 0 ${w} ${h}" preserveAspectRatio="none"><path d="${d}" fill="none" stroke="${color}" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>`;
}
function lineChart(vals, opt = {}) {
  if (!vals || vals.length < 2) return '<div class="mut mini">no data</div>';
  const w = opt.w || 680, h = opt.h || 170, pad = 30;
  const mn = Math.min(...vals), mx = Math.max(...vals), rg = (mx - mn) || 1;
  const X = (i) => pad + i * (w - pad * 2) / (vals.length - 1);
  const Y = (v) => h - pad - (v - mn) / rg * (h - pad * 2);
  const pts = vals.map((v, i) => X(i).toFixed(1) + "," + Y(v).toFixed(1)).join(" ");
  const id = "gr" + (UID++);
  const zero = (mn < 0 && mx > 0) ? Y(0) : null;
  return `<svg class="chart" viewBox="0 0 ${w} ${h}">
   <defs><linearGradient id="${id}" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="${opt.color || "#5b9dff"}55"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="${opt.color || "#5b9dff"}00"/></linearGradient></defs>
   <polygon points="${pad},${h - pad} ${pts} ${w - pad},${h - pad}" fill="url(#${id})"/>
   ${zero != null ? `<line x1="${pad}" y1="${zero.toFixed(1)}" x2="${w - pad}" y2="${zero.toFixed(1)}" stroke="#ffffff22" stroke-dasharray="4 4"/>` : ""}
   <polyline points="${pts}" fill="none" stroke="${opt.color || "#5b9dff"}" stroke-width="2"/>
   <text x="${pad}" y="13" fill="#63758e" font-size="11">${nf(mx, 1)}</text>
   <text x="${pad}" y="${h - 8}" fill="#63758e" font-size="11">${nf(mn, 1)}</text>
   ${opt.labels ? `<text x="${w - pad}" y="${h - 8}" text-anchor="end" fill="#63758e" font-size="11">${esc(opt.labels)}</text>` : ""}
  </svg>`;
}
function barsChart(items, opt = {}) {
  if (!items || !items.length) return "";
  const w = opt.w || 680, h = opt.h || 160, pad = 26;
  const mx = Math.max(1, ...items.map((i) => Math.abs(i.value)));
  const bw = (w - pad * 2) / items.length;
  const y0 = h / 2, sc = (h - pad * 2) / 2 / mx;
  const bars = items.map((it, i) => {
    const bh = Math.abs(it.value) * sc;
    const y = it.value >= 0 ? y0 - bh : y0;
    const x = pad + i * bw + bw * 0.15;
    const c = it.color || (it.value >= 0 ? "#26c281" : "#ff5c6c");
    return `<rect x="${x.toFixed(1)}" y="${y.toFixed(1)}" width="${(bw * 0.7).toFixed(1)}" height="${Math.max(1, bh).toFixed(1)}" rx="2" fill="${c}"/>`;
  }).join("");
  return `<svg class="chart" viewBox="0 0 ${w} ${h}"><line x1="${pad}" y1="${y0}" x2="${w - pad}" y2="${y0}" stroke="#ffffff22"/>${bars}
   <text x="${pad}" y="13" fill="#63758e" font-size="11">${esc(opt.tl || "")}</text>
   <text x="${w - pad}" y="${h - 6}" text-anchor="end" fill="#63758e" font-size="11">${esc(opt.bl || "")}</text></svg>`;
}
function gauge(pct, label) {
  const p = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, pct));
  return `<div class="gauge"><span class="mini">${esc(label || "")}</span><div class="g"><i style="left:${p}%"></i></div><b>${nf(pct, 0)}</b></div>`;
}

/* ------------------------------ tables ------------------------------ */
function tableHTML(rows, cols) {
  const th = cols.map((c, i) => `<th data-i="${i}">${esc(c.label)}</th>`).join("");
  const body = rows.map((r) => "<tr>" + cols.map((c) => `<td>${c.render ? c.render(r) : esc(r[c.k])}</td>`).join("") + "</tr>").join("");
  return `<div class="tbl-wrap"><table><thead><tr>${th}</tr></thead><tbody>${body}</tbody></table></div>`;
}
function mountTable(el, rows, cols) {
  const dir = {};
  function draw() {
    el.innerHTML = tableHTML(rows, cols);
    $$("th", el).forEach((th, i) => {
      th.onclick = () => {
        const c = cols[i], key = c.sort || c.k;
        dir[key] = !dir[key];
        const s = dir[key] ? 1 : -1;
        rows.sort((a, b) => {
          let x = c.val ? c.val(a) : a[key], y = c.val ? c.val(b) : b[key];
          if (typeof x === "string" || typeof y === "string") return String(x).localeCompare(String(y)) * s;
          return ((x ?? -1e18) - (y ?? -1e18)) * s;
        });
        draw();
      };
    });
  }
  draw();
}

/* ------------------------------ router ------------------------------ */
const RENDERED = {};
async function show(view) {
  $$("#nav .nv").forEach((b) => b.classList.toggle("active", b.dataset.view === view));
  $$(".view").forEach((v) => v.classList.remove("active"));
  const el = $("#v-" + view);
  el.classList.add("active");
  if (!RENDERED[view]) {
    el.innerHTML = '<div class="loader">loading ' + view + "…</div>";
    try { await VIEWS[view](el); RENDERED[view] = true; }
    catch (e) { el.innerHTML = '<div class="card"><h4>Could not load</h4><p class="mut">' + esc(e.message) + "</p><p class='note'>Make sure this file sits next to the repo's <b>data/</b> folder (or one level inside it).</p></div>"; }
  }
  window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: "smooth" });
}

function findIdx(indices, name) {
  const n = name.toUpperCase();
  return indices.find((i) => i.index.toUpperCase() === n) || indices.find((i) => i.index.toUpperCase().includes(n));
}

   <div class="mini">52w ${nf(it.low_52w, 0)}–${nf(it.high_52w, 0)} · ${esc(it.as_of || "")}</div></div>`;
}

}

VIEWS.dash = async function (el) {
  const [idx, fii, fhist, br, mood, stress, sm, brain, g, cryp] = await Promise.all([
    J("indices-all.json"), J("fii-dii.json"), J("fii-history.json"), J("breadth.json"),
    J("mood.json"), J("stress.json"), J("smart-brain.json"), J("brain-screener.json"),
    J("global.json"), J("crypto.json"),
  ]);
  const nifty = findIdx(idx.indices, "NIFTY 50"), bnf = findIdx(idx.indices, "NIFTY BANK");
  const sen = (g.items || []).find((i) => i.name === "SENSEX");
  const cats = fii.categories || {};
  const fiiNet = cats["FII/FPI"] ? cats["FII/FPI"].net_cr : null;
  const diiNet = cats["DII"] ? cats["DII"].net_cr : null;
  const btc = (cryp.top || []).find((c) => c.symbol === "BTC") || {};
  const spx = (g.items || []).find((i) => i.name === "S&P 500") || {};

  const movers = (brain.stocks || []).slice().sort((a, b) => (b.change_pct || 0) - (a.change_pct || 0));
  const gainers = movers.slice(0, 6), losers = movers.slice(-6).reverse();
  const guess = sm.guess || {};

  el.innerHTML = `
  ${HERO}
  <h2 class="sec">Market at a glance</h2>

      <div class="kpi sm ${cls(fiiNet)}">${sign(fiiNet, 0)}</div>

    ${card("Stress meter", `<div class="kpi ${stress.band === "DANGER" ? "down" : stress.band === "SAFE" ? "up" : ""}">${nf(stress.score, 0)} <span class="mini">${esc(stress.band || "")}</span></div>
       ${gauge(stress.score, "calm←→stress")}<div class="note">Nifty vs 50-DMA: ${sign(stress.nifty ? ((stress.nifty.c / stress.nifty.dma - 1) * 100) : null, 1)}</div>`)}
    ${card("Model read", `<div class="kpi sm">${esc(guess.verdict || "—")} <span class="mini">(${nf(guess.score, 0)})</span></div>
       ${(guess.points || []).slice(0, 4).map((p) => `<div class="sig"><span class="mut">•</span><span>${esc(p)}</span></div>`).join("")}`)}
  </div>

  <div class="grid g2" style="margin-top:12px">
    ${card("FII vs DII — last sessions (₹ Cr)", barsChart((fhist || []).map((d) => ({ value: d.fii })), { tl: "FII net", bl: "green=buy, red=sell" }))}
    ${card("Breadth of the market", `
       <div class="sig"><span class="mut">Above 200-DMA</span><b class="${br.above_ema200_pct >= 50 ? "up" : "down"}">${nf(br.above_ema200_pct, 1)}%</b></div>
       <div class="sig"><span class="mut">RSI &gt; 60 (strong)</span><b>${nf(br.rsi_above_60, 0)}</b></div>
       <div class="sig"><span class="mut">RSI &lt; 40 (weak)</span><b>${nf(br.rsi_below_40, 0)}</b></div>

       <div class="sig"><span class="mut">Bitcoin</span><b class="${cls(btc.chg_24h_pct)}">$${nf(btc.price_usd, 0)} · ${sign(btc.chg_24h_pct)}</b></div>
       <div class="sig"><span class="mut">Crypto Fear/Greed</span><b>${nf(cryp.fear_greed ? cryp.fear_greed.value : null, 0)} ${esc(cryp.fear_greed ? cryp.fear_greed.label : "")}</b></div>
       <div class="note">Global market cap $${nf(cryp.global ? cryp.global.total_market_cap_usd / 1e12 : null, 2)}T</div>`)}
    ${card("Top gainers", listRows(gainers))}

  <div class="tbl-wrap" id="idxTbl"></div>

      const [v, t] = s.split(":"); return `<div class="card" data-view="${v}" style="cursor:pointer"><div class="kpi sm">${esc(t)}</div><div class="mini">open →</div></div>`;
    }).join("")}

  mountTable($("#idxTbl"), idx.indices.slice(), [
    { label: "Index", k: "index", render: (r) => `<span class="sym">${esc(r.index)}</span>` },

function listRows(arr) {
  if (!arr || !arr.length) return '<div class="mut mini">no data</div>';
  return '<ul class="list">' + arr.map((s) => `<li><div><span class="sym">${esc(s.symbol)}</span><span class="co">${esc((s.company || "").slice(0, 34))}</span></div>
    <div style="text-align:right"><b>${nf(s.price, 1)}</b><br><span class="${cls(s.change_pct)}">${sign(s.change_pct)}</span></div></li>`).join("") + "</ul>";
}

/* ============================== MUTUAL FUNDS ============================== */
VIEWS.mf = async function (el) {
  const [mf, top] = await Promise.all([J("mf.json"), J("mf-top.json")]);
  const funds = mf.funds || [];
  const cats = Array.from(new Set(funds.map((f) => f.k).filter(Boolean))).sort();
  let q = "", cat = "", shown = 60;
  const compare = [];
  el.innerHTML = `
  <h2 class="sec">Mutual funds — all of India in one search</h2>
  <p class="sub">${nf(mf.count, 0)} direct-plan schemes from AMFI. Search by name or AMC, filter by category, compare up to 4 side by side, and run a SIP what-if.</p>
  <div class="toolbar">
    <input type="text" id="mfQ" placeholder="Search fund name or AMC (e.g. Parag Parikh, Nippon, index)…">
    <select id="mfCat"><option value="">All categories</option>${cats.map((c) => `<option>${esc(c)}</option>`).join("")}</select>
    <span class="mini" id="mfCount"></span>
  </div>
  <div id="mfCompareBar"></div>
  <div class="tbl-wrap" id="mfTbl"></div>
  <div style="margin-top:10px"><button class="btn ghost sm" id="mfMore">Show more</button></div>

  <div class="grid g2" style="margin-top:20px">
    ${card("Top funds — trailing returns", mfTopTable(top))}
    ${card("Benchmarks: Nifty vs Gold vs Silver", benchBlock(top))}
  </div>

  <h3>SIP calculator — from ₹10 up</h3>
  <div class="grid g2">
    ${card("Monthly SIP → future value", sipForm("sip"))}
    ${card("One-time (lumpsum) → future value", sipForm("lump"))}
  </div>

  <h3>Which fund type suits your age & goal?</h3>
  ${card("A simple, honest rule of thumb", ageTool())}`;

  function renderTable() {
    const ql = q.toLowerCase();
    let rows = funds.filter((f) => (!cat || f.k === cat) && (!ql || f.n.toLowerCase().includes(ql) || (f.h || "").toLowerCase().includes(ql)));
    $("#mfCount").textContent = nf(rows.length, 0) + " funds";
    mountTable($("#mfTbl"), rows.slice(0, shown), [
      { label: "", k: "c", render: (r) => `<button class="btn ghost sm" data-add="${esc(r.c)}">+</button>` },
      { label: "Fund", k: "n", render: (r) => `<span class="sym">${esc(r.n)}</span>` },
      { label: "AMC", k: "h", render: (r) => esc(r.h || "") },
      { label: "Category", k: "k", render: (r) => `<span class="mini">${esc(r.k || "")}</span>` },
      { label: "NAV", k: "v", render: (r) => nf(r.v, 4) },
      { label: "1d%", k: "p", render: (r) => `<span class="${cls(r.p)}">${sign(r.p)}</span>` },
    ]);
    $$("[data-add]", $("#mfTbl")).forEach((b) => b.onclick = () => addCompare(b.dataset.add));
  }
  function findFund(code) { return funds.find((f) => f.c === code); }
  function addCompare(code) {
    if (compare.includes(code)) return;
    if (compare.length >= 4) return toast("Compare up to 4 funds");
    compare.push(code); renderCompareBar(); toast("Added to compare");
  }
  window.addCompare = addCompare;
  function renderCompareBar() {
    $("#mfCompareBar").innerHTML = compare.length ? `<div class="hl"><b>Compare (${compare.length})</b> ${compare.map((c) => { const f = findFund(c); return `<span class="chip">${esc(f ? f.n.split("·")[0].trim() : c)} <a href="#" data-rm="${esc(c)}">✕</a></span>`; }).join(" ")} <button class="btn sm" id="doCompare">Compare →</button></div>` : "";
    $$("[data-rm]").forEach((a) => a.onclick = (e) => { e.preventDefault(); const i = compare.indexOf(a.dataset.rm); if (i > -1) compare.splice(i, 1); renderCompareBar(); });
    const dc = $("#doCompare"); if (dc) dc.onclick = compareDrawer;
  }
  function compareDrawer() {
    const fs = compare.map(findFund).filter(Boolean);
    const fields = [["Full name", (f) => f.n], ["AMC", (f) => f.h], ["Category", (f) => f.k], ["NAV", (f) => nf(f.v, 4)], ["1-day %", (f) => sign(f.p)]];
    drawDrawer("<h3>Mutual fund comparison</h3>" + '<div class="tbl-wrap"><table><thead><tr><th>Metric</th>' + fs.map((f) => `<th>${esc(f.n.split("·")[0].trim())}</th>`).join("") + "</tr></thead><tbody>" +
      fields.map(([lbl, fn]) => `<tr><td>${esc(lbl)}</td>${fs.map((f) => `<td>${esc(fn(f))}</td>`).join("")}</tr>`).join("") + "</tbody></table></div>" +
      '<p class="note">NAV and category come from AMFI. For 1/3/5-year returns, use a fund factsheet or the “Top funds” table — returns depend on your buy date.</p>');
  }
  renderTable(); renderCompareBar();
  $("#mfQ").oninput = (e) => { q = e.target.value; shown = 60; renderTable(); };
  $("#mfCat").onchange = (e) => { cat = e.target.value; shown = 60; renderTable(); };
  $("#mfMore").onclick = () => { shown += 120; renderTable(); };
};
function mfTopTable(top) {
  const funds = top.funds || [];
  if (!funds.length) return '<div class="mut mini">no data</div>';
  return '<div class="tbl-wrap" style="max-height:340px"><table><thead><tr><th>Fund</th><th>1y</th><th>3y</th><th>5y</th></tr></thead><tbody>' +
    funds.map((f) => `<tr><td><span class="sym">${esc(f.n.split("·")[0].trim())}</span><span class="co">${esc(f.k || "")}</span></td>
      <td class="${cls(f.r1)}">${sign(f.r1, 1)}</td><td class="${cls(f.r3)}">${sign(f.r3, 1)}</td><td class="${cls(f.r5)}">${sign(f.r5, 1)}</td></tr>`).join("") + "</tbody></table></div>" +
    '<p class="note">Trailing point-to-point returns (cumulative %). Not a recommendation.</p>';
}
function benchBlock(top) {
  const n = top.nifty || {}, b = top.bench || {};
  const row = (lbl, o) => `<tr><td>${esc(lbl)}</td><td class="${cls(o.r1)}">${sign(o.r1, 1)}</td><td class="${cls(o.r3)}">${sign(o.r3, 1)}</td><td class="${cls(o.r5)}">${sign(o.r5, 1)}</td></tr>`;
  let html = '<div class="tbl-wrap"><table><thead><tr><th>Asset</th><th>1y</th><th>3y</th><th>5y</th></tr></thead><tbody>';
  html += row("Nifty 50 (index)", n);
  if (b.gold) html += row("Gold (fund proxy)", b.gold);
  if (b.silver) html += row("Silver (fund proxy)", b.silver);
  html += "</tbody></table></div>";
  html += '<p class="note">This is how you check the question “did this fund beat Nifty, gold or silver?” — compare the same columns.</p>';
  return html;
}
function sipForm(kind) {
  const id = kind === "sip" ? "sip" : "lump";
  return `<div class="toolbar">
    <input type="number" id="${id}Amt" value="${kind === "sip" ? 5000 : 100000}" min="10" step="10" style="max-width:130px">
    <input type="number" id="${id}Yr" value="15" min="1" max="40" style="max-width:90px"> yrs
    <input type="number" id="${id}Ret" value="12" min="1" max="30" style="max-width:90px"> % p.a.
    <button class="btn sm" id="${id}Go">Calculate</button></div>
    <div id="${id}Out" class="kpi sm">—</div>
    <div class="note">Assumed return is your input, not a promise. Equity ~10–12%, debt ~6–7% historically (varies).</div>`;
}
function ageTool() {
  return `<div class="toolbar">
    <input type="number" id="ageIn" value="30" min="15" max="80" style="max-width:90px"> yrs age
    <input type="number" id="ageAmt" value="10000" min="10" step="500" style="max-width:130px"> ₹ / month
    <input type="number" id="ageYr" value="20" min="1" max="40" style="max-width:90px"> yrs horizon
    <button class="btn sm" id="ageGo">Suggest a mix</button></div>
    <div id="ageOut"></div>
    <div class="note">Rule of thumb only — real allocation depends on income stability, goals and risk tolerance. Talk to a SEBI-registered adviser for personal advice.</div>`;
}
function computeFV(monthly, years, ret) {
  const i = ret / 100 / 12, n = years * 12;
  if (i === 0) return monthly * n;
  return monthly * ((Math.pow(1 + i, n) - 1) / i) * (1 + i);
}
function computeLump(p, years, ret) { return p * Math.pow(1 + ret / 100, years); }

  const types = [

    ["Stock SIP (basket)", "Zerodha Coin/Groww let you SIP into a basket of stocks on a chosen date (weekly/monthly/quarterly) — same idea as a fund but you own shares.", "Monthly basket", 2000, 13],
    ["Digital gold SIP", "Buy 24K gold from ₹10/day or ₹100/month (MMTC-PAMP, Augmont, etc.). Stored vaulted; sell anytime. No making charges on digital.", "Daily / monthly", 300, 9],
    ["Silver SIP", "Same as gold but silver — more volatile, higher highs/lows. Often bought via ETFs or digital silver.", "Monthly", 300, 10],
    ["Crypto SIP", "CoinSwitch/CoinDCX let you SIP BTC/ETH weekly or monthly. Very high risk; small allocation only. Taxed 30% + 1% TDS in India.", "Weekly / monthly", 500, 15],
    ["Government schemes", "PPF (15y, tax-free), EPF/NPS (retirement), SSY (girl child), APY (₹1k–₹5k pension). Low risk, long lock-in, tax benefits.", "Monthly", 500, 7.1],
    ["Bank fixed deposits", "Fixed rate, fixed tenure, capital-safe. Rates differ by bank and tenure — always check the bank's card. Senior citizens get more.", "One-time", 50000, 7],
    ["Bonds & G-Secs", "Government and corporate bonds; buy via RBI Retail Direct or brokers. Coupon income + capital safety if held to maturity.", "One-time", 10000, 7.2],
    ["Real estate / REITs", "Direct property is lumpy and illiquid; REITs & InvITs give rental income from ~₹300/unit with liquidity.", "One-time", 50000, 8],
  ];
  el.innerHTML = `
  <h2 class="sec">Invest — every kind of SIP in one place</h2>
  <p class="sub">From ₹10 digital-gold daily to lump-sum bonds. Each card explains the idea and lets you what-if the numbers. Returns you enter are your assumptions.</p>
  <div class="grid g3" id="invCards"></div>

  <h3>Cross-asset return reality check (past trailing)</h3>
  ${card("How the big assets have done", '<div class="tbl-wrap"><table><thead><tr><th>Asset</th><th>1y</th><th>3y</th><th>5y</th></tr></thead><tbody>' +
    `<tr><td>Nifty 50</td><td class="${cls(top.nifty.r1)}">${sign(top.nifty.r1, 1)}</td><td class="${cls(top.nifty.r3)}">${sign(top.nifty.r3, 1)}</td><td class="${cls(top.nifty.r5)}">${sign(top.nifty.r5, 1)}</td></tr>` +
    (b.gold ? `<tr><td>Gold</td><td class="${cls(b.gold.r1)}">${sign(b.gold.r1, 1)}</td><td class="${cls(b.gold.r3)}">${sign(b.gold.r3, 1)}</td><td class="${cls(b.gold.r5)}">${sign(b.gold.r5, 1)}</td></tr>` : "") +
    (b.silver ? `<tr><td>Silver</td><td class="${cls(b.silver.r1)}">${sign(b.silver.r1, 1)}</td><td class="${cls(b.silver.r3)}">${sign(b.silver.r3, 1)}</td><td>—</td></tr>` : "") +
    '</tbody></table></div><p class="note">Diversify across equity, gold and debt — no single asset wins every year.</p>')}

  <h3>Universal SIP / lumpsum calculator</h3>
  <div class="grid g2">${card("Monthly SIP", sipForm("sip"))}${card("Lumpsum", sipForm("lump"))}</div>`;

  $("#invCards").innerHTML = types.map((t, i) => card(t[0], `
    <div class="mini">${esc(t[1])}</div>
    <div class="chip" style="margin:8px 0">${esc(t[2])}</div>
    <div class="toolbar" style="margin:0">
      <input type="number" id="iv${i}a" value="${t[3]}" step="10" style="max-width:110px">
      <input type="number" id="iv${i}y" value="10" style="max-width:70px">y
      <input type="number" id="iv${i}r" value="${t[4]}" style="max-width:70px">%
      <button class="btn ghost sm" data-iv="${i}">Go</button>
    </div><div id="iv${i}o" class="mini" style="margin-top:6px">—</div>`)).join("");
  $$("[data-iv]").forEach((btn) => btn.onclick = () => {
    const i = btn.dataset.iv, a = +$("#iv" + i + "a").value, y = +$("#iv" + i + "y").value, r = +$("#iv" + i + "r").value;
    const isSip = types[i][2].toLowerCase().includes("month") || types[i][2].toLowerCase().includes("daily") || types[i][2].toLowerCase().includes("weekly");
    const fv = isSip ? computeFV(a, y, r) : computeLump(a, y, r);
    const inv = isSip ? a * 12 * y : a;
    $("#iv" + i + "o").innerHTML = `Invested <b>${money(inv)}</b> → <b class="up">${money(fv)}</b> (gain ${money(fv - inv)})`;
  });
  bindCalc("sip"); bindCalc("lump");
};
function bindCalc(kind) {
  const go = $("#" + kind + "Go"); if (!go) return;
  go.onclick = () => {
    const a = +$("#" + kind + "Amt").value, y = +$("#" + kind + "Yr").value, r = +$("#" + kind + "Ret").value;
    const fv = kind === "sip" ? computeFV(a, y, r) : computeLump(a, y, r);
    const inv = kind === "sip" ? a * 12 * y : a;
    $("#" + kind + "Out").innerHTML = `<span class="mut">Invested</span> ${money(inv)} → <span class="up">${money(fv)}</span> <span class="mini">(gain ${money(fv - inv)})</span>`;
  };
}

/* ============================== STOCKS ============================== */
VIEWS.stocks = async function (el) {
  const [brain, fund, mb, stg, deliv, scr] = await Promise.all([
    J("brain-screener.json"), J("fundamentals.json"), J("mb-score.json"), J("stages.json"),
    J("delivery.json"), J("screener-fundamentals.json"),
  ]);
  const rows = brain.stocks || [];
  const delivEntries = Array.isArray(deliv.d) ? deliv.d : Object.entries(deliv.d || {});
  const delivMap = {}; delivEntries.forEach(([s, p]) => delivMap[s] = p);
  const stageMap = stg.all || {};
  let q = "", preset = "", shown = 100;
  const presets = [
    ["", "All"], ["ema", "Above 200-DMA"], ["rsi-low", "RSI < 30 (oversold)"], ["rsi-high", "RSI > 70 (strong)"],
    ["vol", "Volume spike ≥ 2×"], ["near", "Near 52w high"], ["up3", "Up 3+ days"],
  ];
  el.innerHTML = `
  <h2 class="sec">Stocks — fundamentals + technicals screener</h2>
  <p class="sub">${nf(rows.length, 0)} NSE/BSE stocks with price, RSI, EMA200, MACD and volume. Sort any column, filter with presets, click a row for the full picture.</p>
  <div class="toolbar">
    <input type="text" id="stQ" placeholder="Search symbol or company…">
    <div class="chips" id="stPre">${presets.map(([v, l]) => `<span class="chip ${v === "" ? "acc" : ""}" data-pre="${v}" style="cursor:pointer">${esc(l)}</span>`).join("")}</div>
    <span class="mini" id="stCount"></span>
  </div>
  <div class="tbl-wrap" id="stTbl"></div>
  <div style="margin-top:10px"><button class="btn ghost sm" id="stMore">Show more</button></div>

  <div class="grid g3" style="margin-top:20px">
    ${card("Stage analysis (Weinstein)", stageBlock(stg))}
    ${card("Top delivery % (conviction buying)", '<ul class="list">' + delivEntries.slice().sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]).slice(0, 10).map(([s, p]) => `<li><span class="sym">${esc(s)}</span><b>${nf(p, 1)}%</b></li>`).join("") + "</ul>")}
    ${card("Model book score — leaders", '<ul class="list">' + (mb.top || []).slice(0, 12).map((s) => { const o = mb.stocks[s] || {}; return `<li><div><span class="sym">${esc(s)}</span><span class="co">${esc((o.n || "").slice(0, 30))}</span></div><b>${nf(o.s, 0)}</b></li>`; }).join("") + "</ul>")}
  </div>`;

  function passes(r) {
    if (!preset) return true;
    if (preset === "ema") return r.above_ema200;
    if (preset === "rsi-low") return (r.rsi14 ?? 100) < 30;
    if (preset === "rsi-high") return (r.rsi14 ?? 0) > 70;
    if (preset === "vol") return (r.vol_vs_avg20 ?? 0) >= 2;
    if (preset === "near") return (r.from_52w_high_pct ?? -100) > -3;
    if (preset === "up3") return (r.consec_days ?? 0) >= 3;
    return true;
  }
  function render() {
    const ql = q.toLowerCase();
    const list = rows.filter((r) => passes(r) && (!ql || r.symbol.toLowerCase().includes(ql) || (r.company || "").toLowerCase().includes(ql)));
    $("#stCount").textContent = nf(list.length, 0) + " stocks";
    mountTable($("#stTbl"), list.slice(0, shown), [
      { label: "Symbol", k: "symbol", render: (r) => `<span class="sym">${esc(r.symbol)}</span><span class="co">${esc((r.company || "").slice(0, 30))}</span>` },
      { label: "Price", k: "price", render: (r) => nf(r.price, 2) },
      { label: "Chg%", k: "change_pct", render: (r) => `<span class="${cls(r.change_pct)}">${sign(r.change_pct)}</span>` },
      { label: "RSI", k: "rsi14", render: (r) => `<span class="${r.rsi14 > 70 ? "up" : r.rsi14 < 30 ? "down" : ""}">${nf(r.rsi14, 0)}</span>` },
      { label: "200-DMA", k: "above_ema200", render: (r) => r.above_ema200 ? '<span class="pill up">above</span>' : '<span class="pill dn">below</span>' },
      { label: "MACD hist", k: "macd_hist", render: (r) => `<span class="${cls(r.macd_hist)}">${nf(r.macd_hist, 2)}</span>` },
      { label: "Vol ×avg", k: "vol_vs_avg20", render: (r) => nf(r.vol_vs_avg20, 1) + "×" },
      { label: "From 52w hi", k: "from_52w_high_pct", render: (r) => `<span class="${cls(r.from_52w_high_pct)}">${sign(r.from_52w_high_pct, 1)}</span>` },
    ]);
    $$("#stTbl tbody tr").forEach((tr) => tr.onclick = () => openStock(tr.querySelector(".sym").textContent));
  }
  function openStock(sym) {
    const b = rows.find((r) => r.symbol === sym) || {};
    const f = fund[sym] || {}, sc = mb.stocks[sym] || {}, st = stageMap[sym], dv = delivMap[sym];
    const sq = scr.stocks ? scr.stocks[sym] : null;
    const sNames = { "1": "Stage 1 — basing", "2": "Stage 2 — advancing (buy zone)", "3": "Stage 3 — topping", "4": "Stage 4 — declining", "0": "Unclassified" };
    const stKey = st ? String(st[0]) : "";
    let hist = "";
    if (sq && sq.Sales && sq.NetProfit) {
      hist = `<h3 style="font-size:13px">Sales vs Net profit (₹ Cr)</h3>${lineChart(sq.Sales.slice(-8), { color: "#5b9dff", labels: "sales" })}
        ${lineChart(sq.NetProfit.slice(-8), { color: "#26c281", labels: "profit" })}`;
    }
    drawDrawer(`<h3>${esc(sym)} <span class="mini">${esc(b.company || (f.industry || ""))}</span></h3>
      <div class="grid g3">
        ${card("Price", `<div class="kpi sm">${nf(b.price, 2)}</div><div class="${cls(b.change_pct)}">${sign(b.change_pct)}</div>`)}
        ${card("RSI-14", `<div class="kpi sm">${nf(b.rsi14, 0)}</div><div class="mini">${b.rsi14 > 70 ? "overbought" : b.rsi14 < 30 ? "oversold" : "neutral"}</div>`)}
        ${card("Stage", `<div class="kpi sm">${stKey || "—"}</div><div class="mini">${esc(sNames[stKey] || "")}</div>`)}
      </div>
      <div class="grid g2" style="margin-top:10px">
        ${card("Technicals", `<div class="sig"><span class="mut">EMA20 / EMA200</span><b>${nf(b.ema20, 1)} / ${nf(b.ema200, 1)}</b></div>
          <div class="sig"><span class="mut">Above 200-DMA</span><b>${b.above_ema200 ? "Yes" : "No"}</b></div>
          <div class="sig"><span class="mut">MACD / signal</span><b>${nf(b.macd, 2)} / ${nf(b.macd_signal, 2)}</b></div>
          <div class="sig"><span class="mut">Volume vs 20-day avg</span><b>${nf(b.vol_vs_avg20, 1)}×</b></div>
          <div class="sig"><span class="mut">Delivery %</span><b>${nf(dv, 1)}%</b></div>
          <div class="sig"><span class="mut">52w range</span><b>${nf(b.low_52w, 0)}–${nf(b.high_52w, 0)}</b></div>`)}
        ${card("Fundamentals", `<div class="sig"><span class="mut">P/E</span><b>${nf(f.trailingPE, 1)}</b></div>
          <div class="sig"><span class="mut">P/B</span><b>${nf(f.priceToBook, 2)}</b></div>
          <div class="sig"><span class="mut">ROE</span><b>${f.returnOnEquity != null ? nf(f.returnOnEquity * 100, 1) + "%" : "—"}</b></div>
          <div class="sig"><span class="mut">Dividend yield</span><b>${f.dividendYield != null ? nf(f.dividendYield, 2) + "%" : "—"}</b></div>
          <div class="sig"><span class="mut">Revenue growth</span><b class="${cls(f.revenueGrowth)}">${f.revenueGrowth != null ? sign(f.revenueGrowth * 100, 1) : "—"}</b></div>
          <div class="sig"><span class="mut">Sector</span><b>${esc(f.sector || "—")}</b></div>`)}
      </div>
      ${card("Model book score", `<div class="sig"><span class="mut">Composite</span><b>${nf(sc.s, 0)}</b></div>
        <div class="sig"><span class="mut">Fundamental / Technical</span><b>${nf(sc.f, 0)} / ${nf(sc.t, 0)}</b></div>
        ${sc.fl ? `<div class="mini">${esc(sc.fl)}</div>` : ""}`)}
      ${hist}
      <p class="note">Educational snapshot from EOD data — not a buy/sell call. Always do your own check.</p>`);
  }
  window.openStock = openStock;
  render();
  $("#stQ").oninput = (e) => { q = e.target.value; shown = 100; render(); };
  $("#stMore").onclick = () => { shown += 200; render(); };
  $$("#stPre .chip").forEach((c) => c.onclick = () => { preset = c.dataset.pre; $$("#stPre .chip").forEach((x) => x.classList.remove("acc")); c.classList.add("acc"); shown = 100; render(); });
};
function stageBlock(stg) {
  const c = stg.counts || {};
  const names = { "1": "Stage 1 · Basing", "2": "Stage 2 · Advancing", "3": "Stage 3 · Topping", "4": "Stage 4 · Declining", "0": "Unclassified" };
  return Object.keys(names).map((k) => `<div class="sig"><span class="mut">${names[k]}</span><b>${nf(c[k], 0)}</b></div>`).join("") +
    '<div class="note">Weinstein stages: buy strength in Stage 2, avoid Stage 4. Counts across the universe.</div>';
}

  </div>

  </div>

  <h3>Market profile (value zones) — ${esc(gti.updated || "")}</h3>
  <div id="gtiBox" class="grid g2"></div>

  <h3>Intraday charts (free, captured after close)</h3>
  <div class="tabs" id="tfTabs">
    ${["5m", "15m", "1h"].map((t, i) => `<button class="tab ${i === 0 ? "active" : ""}" data-tf="${t}">${t}</button>`).join("")}
    <select id="symSel">${Object.keys(candles.syms || {}).map((s) => `<option>${esc(s)}</option>`).join("")}</select>
  </div>
  <div id="intraday" class="card"></div>

  <div class="grid g2" style="margin-top:12px">
    ${card("Top model scores (tech+fund)", '<ul class="list">' + (scores.top || []).slice(0, 10).map((x) => `<li><div><span class="sym">${esc(x.sym)}</span><span class="co">${esc((x.r || []).slice(0, 3).join(", "))}</span></div><b>${nf(x.total, 1)}</b></li>`).join("") + "</ul>")}
    ${card("Model forecast — biggest expected moves", '<ul class="list">' + (tf.movers || []).slice(0, 10).map((x) => `<li><div><span class="sym">${esc(x.name)}</span><span class="co">${esc(x.cat)}</span></div><b class="${cls(x.median)}">${sign(x.median, 1)} <span class="mini">±${nf(x.band, 0)}%</span></b></li>`).join("") + "</ul>")}

  const sym = chainKeys[0] || "NIFTY 50";
  function walls(s) {

      <div class="sig"><span class="mut">Put wall (support)</span><b class="up">${nf(o.put_wall, 0)}</b></div>
      <div class="sig"><span class="mut">Call wall (resistance)</span><b class="down">${nf(o.call_wall, 0)}</b></div>
      <div class="sig"><span class="mut">PCR</span><b>${nf(o.pcr, 2)}</b></div>
      <div class="sig"><span class="mut">Max pain</span><b>${nf(o.max_pain, 0)}</b></div>
      <div class="mini">Expiry ${esc(o.expiry || "—")} · total OI ${nf(o.total_oi, 0)}</div>`;
  }
  $("#oiWalls").innerHTML = chainKeys.slice(0, 3).map((s) => `<div class="hl"><b>${esc(s)}</b>${walls(s)}</div>`).join("");
  $("#futIdx").innerHTML = (fut.indices || []).map((i) => {
    const c0 = (i.contracts || [])[0] || {};
    return `<div class="hl"><b>${esc(i.symbol)}</b><div class="sig"><span class="mut">Underlying</span><b>${nf(i.underlying, 1)}</b></div>
      <div class="sig"><span class="mut">Fut close</span><b>${nf(c0.close, 1)}</b></div>
      <div class="sig"><span class="mut">OI change</span><b class="${cls(c0.oi_chg)}">${nf(c0.oi_chg, 0)}</b></div></div>`;
  }).join("");
  $("#futBu").innerHTML = '<div class="mini">Long build-up: price ↑ + OI ↑</div>' +
    (fut.stocks || []).slice().sort((a, b) => (b.oi_chg || 0) - (a.oi_chg || 0)).slice(0, 5).map((x) => `<div class="sig"><span class="sym">${esc(x.symbol)}</span><b class="up">OI ${nf(x.oi_chg, 0)}</b></div>`).join("") +
    '<div class="mini" style="margin-top:8px">Short build-up: price ↓ + OI ↑</div>' +
    (fut.stocks || []).slice().sort((a, b) => (a.oi_chg || 0) - (b.oi_chg || 0)).slice(0, 5).map((x) => `<div class="sig"><span class="sym">${esc(x.symbol)}</span><b class="down">OI ${nf(x.oi_chg, 0)}</b></div>`).join("");

  function renderChain(s) {
    const o = oi.symbols[s] || {}, chain = o.chain || [];
    mountTable($("#ocTbl"), chain.slice(), [
      { label: "Call OI", k: "ce", render: (r) => `<span class="down">${nf(r.ce, 0)}</span>` },
      { label: "Δ Call", k: "ce_chg", render: (r) => nf(r.ce_chg, 0) },
      { label: "Strike", k: "strike", render: (r) => `<b>${nf(r.strike, 0)}</b>` },
      { label: "Put OI", k: "pe", render: (r) => `<span class="up">${nf(r.pe, 0)}</span>` },
      { label: "Δ Put", k: "pe_chg", render: (r) => nf(r.pe_chg, 0) },
    ]);
  }
  renderChain(sym);
  $("#ocSel").onchange = (e) => renderChain(e.target.value);

  $("#gtiBox").innerHTML = Object.entries(gti.symbols || {}).slice(0, 4).map(([s, o]) => card(s, `
    <div class="sig"><span class="mut">Price</span><b>${nf(o.price, 1)}</b></div>
    <div class="sig"><span class="mut">Day POC</span><b>${nf(o.day_poc, 1)}</b></div>
    <div class="sig"><span class="mut">Week POC</span><b>${nf(o.week_poc, 1)}</b></div>
    <div class="sig"><span class="mut">Nearest zone</span><b>${esc((o.nearest || [])[0] || "—")}</b></div>`)).join("");

  let tfSel = "5m", symSel = Object.keys(candles.syms || {})[0];
  function renderIntraday() {
    const s = candles.syms[symSel] || {};
    const tfd = s[tfSel] || {};
    const vals = tfd.c || tfd.close || tfd.p || [];
    $("#intraday").innerHTML = `<h4>${esc(symSel)} · ${esc(tfSel)}</h4>${lineChart(vals, { h: 220, labels: "close" })}<div class="note">Intraday candles captured free after close. Prev close ${nf(s.pc, 2)}.</div>`;
  }
  renderIntraday();
  $$("#tfTabs .tab").forEach((b) => b.onclick = () => { $$("#tfTabs .tab").forEach((x) => x.classList.remove("active")); b.classList.add("active"); tfSel = b.dataset.tf; renderIntraday(); });
  $("#symSel").onchange = (e) => { symSel = e.target.value; renderIntraday(); };
};
function flattenCirc(arr) {
  const out = [];
  (arr || []).forEach((b) => (b.top || []).forEach((x) => out.push(x)));
  return out;
}

function indexHistoryBlock(idxh) {
  const list = idxh.indices || [];
  if (!list.length) return "";
  const nifty = list.find((i) => i.key === "nifty") || list[0];
  const years = nifty.years || {};
  const rows = Object.keys(years).sort().slice(-14).map((y) => {
    const months = years[y], sum = Object.values(months).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
    return `<tr><td>${y}</td><td class="${cls(sum)}">${sign(sum, 1)}</td></tr>`;
  }).join("");
  return '<div class="tbl-wrap" style="max-height:300px"><table><thead><tr><th>Year</th><th>Nifty return</th></tr></thead><tbody>' + rows + "</tbody></table></div>" +
    '<div class="note">Sum of monthly moves — shows how many good and bad years a long-term investor must sit through.</div>';
}
function worldBlock(world) {
  const shock = world.shock || {};
  return Object.entries(shock).slice(0, 6).map(([k, v]) => `<div class="sig"><span class="mut">${esc(k)}</span><span class="mini">avg on shock days <b class="${cls(v.avg)}">${sign(v.avg)}</b> · ${nf(v.up, 0)}/${nf(v.n, 0)} up</span></div>`).join("") +
    '<div class="note">How global indices behaved on past “shock” days. Correlation ≠ causation.</div>';
}

/* ============================== INIT · gate · theme ============================== */
const ACCESS_CODE = "artha2026"; // <-- change to your own code
function applyTheme(t) {
  document.documentElement.dataset.theme = t || "midnight";
  try { localStorage.setItem("saar-theme", t); } catch (e) {}
  const s = $("#themeSel"); if (s) s.value = t || "midnight";
}
window.applyTheme = applyTheme;

async function boot() {
  $("#gate").style.display = "none";
  $("#topbar").style.display = "flex";
  $("#app").style.display = "block";
  $("#foot").style.display = "block";
  const ok = await probeBase();
  const st = $("#status");
  try {
    const f = await J("fii-dii.json");
    $("#statusTxt").textContent = "data " + bytesAgo(f.updated);
    st.classList.add("ok");
  } catch (e) {
    st.classList.add("bad");
    $("#statusTxt").textContent = ok ? "partial" : "no data";
  }
  $("#footMeta").textContent = "Loaded from " + BASE + " · " + new Date().toLocaleString("en-IN");
  $$("#nav .nv").forEach((b) => b.onclick = () => show(b.dataset.view));
  $(".brand").onclick = () => show("dash");
  $("#drawer").onclick = (e) => { if (e.target.id === "drawer") closeDrawer(); };
  document.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => { if (e.key === "Escape") closeDrawer(); });
  const ts = $("#themeSel"); if (ts) ts.onchange = () => applyTheme(ts.value);
  const ib = $("#ipoBtn"); if (ib) ib.onclick = openIpo;
  show("dash");
}

(async function init() {
  try { if ("serviceWorker" in navigator) { const rs = await navigator.serviceWorker.getRegistrations(); rs.forEach((r) => r.unregister()); } } catch (e) {}
  let saved = "midnight"; try { saved = localStorage.getItem("saar-theme") || "midnight"; } catch (e) {}
  applyTheme(saved);
  const gi = $("#gateInput"), ge = $("#gateErr");
  const tryGo = () => {
    if (gi.value.trim().toLowerCase() === ACCESS_CODE.toLowerCase()) {
      try { localStorage.setItem("saar-unlocked", "1"); } catch (e) {}
      boot();
    } else { ge.textContent = "Wrong code — try again."; gi.value = ""; gi.focus(); }
  };
  $("#gateGo").onclick = tryGo;
  window.__SAAR_READY = true; // signals the inline watchdog in index.html that the app script loaded
  gi.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => { if (e.key === "Enter") tryGo(); });
  let unlocked = false; try { unlocked = localStorage.getItem("saar-unlocked") === "1"; } catch (e) {}
  if (unlocked) { boot(); } else { gi.focus(); }
})();

/* ArthaSaar v9 — clean, data-driven market workspace.
   Reads EOD JSON from ./data (falls back to ../data). No API keys, no build step. */
"use strict";

/* ------------------------------ utils ------------------------------ */
const $ = (s, r = document) => r.querySelector(s);
const $$ = (s, r = document) => Array.from(r.querySelectorAll(s));
let BASE = "data/";
const CACHE = {};
let UID = 0;

async function probeBase() {
  const cands = ["data/", "../data/", "./", "../../data/"];
  for (const b of cands) {
    try {
      const r = await fetch(b + "fii-dii.json", { cache: "no-store" });
      if (r.ok) { BASE = b; return true; }
    } catch (e) { /* try next */ }
  }
  return false;
}
async function J(name) {
  if (CACHE[name] !== undefined) return CACHE[name];
  const r = await fetch(BASE + name, { cache: "no-store" });
  if (!r.ok) throw new Error(name + " HTTP " + r.status);
  const d = await r.json();
  CACHE[name] = d;
  return d;
}
const esc = (s) => String(s ?? "").replace(/[&<>"]/g, (c) => ({ "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;" }[c]));
function nf(x, d = 2) {
  if (x === null || x === undefined || x === "" || isNaN(x)) return "—";
  return Number(x).toLocaleString("en-IN", { maximumFractionDigits: d });
}
const money = (x, d = 0) => (x == null || isNaN(x)) ? "—" : "₹" + nf(x, d);
const cr = (x) => (x == null || isNaN(x)) ? "—" : "₹" + nf(x, 0) + " Cr";
const sign = (x, d = 2) => (x == null || isNaN(x)) ? "—" : (x > 0 ? "+" : "") + nf(x, d) + "%";
const updown = (x) => x > 0 ? "up" : x < 0 ? "down" : "mut";
const cls = (x) => x > 0 ? "up" : x < 0 ? "down" : "";
const cap = (s) => String(s || "").replace(/\b\w/g, (m) => m.toUpperCase());
function bytesAgo(iso) {
  if (!iso) return "";
  const t = new Date(iso).getTime();
  if (isNaN(t)) return iso;
  const s = (Date.now() - t) / 1000;
  if (s < 3600) return Math.max(1, Math.round(s / 60)) + "m ago";
  if (s < 86400) return Math.round(s / 3600) + "h ago";
  return Math.round(s / 86400) + "d ago";
}
function toast(msg) {
  const t = $("#toast"); t.textContent = msg; t.hidden = false;
  clearTimeout(t._h); t._h = setTimeout(() => { t.hidden = true; }, 2200);
}

/* ------------------------------ charts ------------------------------ */
function spark(vals, w = 120, h = 34, color = "#5b9dff") {
  if (!vals || vals.length < 2) return "";
  const mn = Math.min(...vals), mx = Math.max(...vals), rg = (mx - mn) || 1;
  const pts = vals.map((v, i) => [i / (vals.length - 1) * w, h - 3 - (v - mn) / rg * (h - 6)]);
  const d = pts.map((p, i) => (i ? "L" : "M") + p[0].toFixed(1) + " " + p[1].toFixed(1)).join(" ");
  return `<svg class="spark" viewBox="0 0 ${w} ${h}" preserveAspectRatio="none"><path d="${d}" fill="none" stroke="${color}" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>`;
}
function lineChart(vals, opt = {}) {
  if (!vals || vals.length < 2) return '<div class="mut mini">no data</div>';
  const w = opt.w || 680, h = opt.h || 170, pad = 30;
  const mn = Math.min(...vals), mx = Math.max(...vals), rg = (mx - mn) || 1;
  const X = (i) => pad + i * (w - pad * 2) / (vals.length - 1);
  const Y = (v) => h - pad - (v - mn) / rg * (h - pad * 2);
  const pts = vals.map((v, i) => X(i).toFixed(1) + "," + Y(v).toFixed(1)).join(" ");
  const id = "gr" + (UID++);
  const zero = (mn < 0 && mx > 0) ? Y(0) : null;
  return `<svg class="chart" viewBox="0 0 ${w} ${h}">
   <defs><linearGradient id="${id}" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="${opt.color || "#5b9dff"}55"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="${opt.color || "#5b9dff"}00"/></linearGradient></defs>
   <polygon points="${pad},${h - pad} ${pts} ${w - pad},${h - pad}" fill="url(#${id})"/>
   ${zero != null ? `<line x1="${pad}" y1="${zero.toFixed(1)}" x2="${w - pad}" y2="${zero.toFixed(1)}" stroke="#ffffff22" stroke-dasharray="4 4"/>` : ""}
   <polyline points="${pts}" fill="none" stroke="${opt.color || "#5b9dff"}" stroke-width="2"/>
   <text x="${pad}" y="13" fill="#63758e" font-size="11">${nf(mx, 1)}</text>
   <text x="${pad}" y="${h - 8}" fill="#63758e" font-size="11">${nf(mn, 1)}</text>
   ${opt.labels ? `<text x="${w - pad}" y="${h - 8}" text-anchor="end" fill="#63758e" font-size="11">${esc(opt.labels)}</text>` : ""}
  </svg>`;
}
function barsChart(items, opt = {}) {
  if (!items || !items.length) return "";
  const w = opt.w || 680, h = opt.h || 160, pad = 26;
  const mx = Math.max(1, ...items.map((i) => Math.abs(i.value)));
  const bw = (w - pad * 2) / items.length;
  const y0 = h / 2, sc = (h - pad * 2) / 2 / mx;
  const bars = items.map((it, i) => {
    const bh = Math.abs(it.value) * sc;
    const y = it.value >= 0 ? y0 - bh : y0;
    const x = pad + i * bw + bw * 0.15;
    const c = it.color || (it.value >= 0 ? "#26c281" : "#ff5c6c");
    return `<rect x="${x.toFixed(1)}" y="${y.toFixed(1)}" width="${(bw * 0.7).toFixed(1)}" height="${Math.max(1, bh).toFixed(1)}" rx="2" fill="${c}"/>`;
  }).join("");
  return `<svg class="chart" viewBox="0 0 ${w} ${h}"><line x1="${pad}" y1="${y0}" x2="${w - pad}" y2="${y0}" stroke="#ffffff22"/>${bars}
   <text x="${pad}" y="13" fill="#63758e" font-size="11">${esc(opt.tl || "")}</text>
   <text x="${w - pad}" y="${h - 6}" text-anchor="end" fill="#63758e" font-size="11">${esc(opt.bl || "")}</text></svg>`;
}
function gauge(pct, label) {
  const p = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, pct));
  return `<div class="gauge"><span class="mini">${esc(label || "")}</span><div class="g"><i style="left:${p}%"></i></div><b>${nf(pct, 0)}</b></div>`;
}

/* ------------------------------ tables ------------------------------ */
function tableHTML(rows, cols) {
  const th = cols.map((c, i) => `<th data-i="${i}">${esc(c.label)}</th>`).join("");
  const body = rows.map((r) => "<tr>" + cols.map((c) => `<td>${c.render ? c.render(r) : esc(r[c.k])}</td>`).join("") + "</tr>").join("");
  return `<div class="tbl-wrap"><table><thead><tr>${th}</tr></thead><tbody>${body}</tbody></table></div>`;
}
function mountTable(el, rows, cols) {
  const dir = {};
  function draw() {
    el.innerHTML = tableHTML(rows, cols);
    $$("th", el).forEach((th, i) => {
      th.onclick = () => {
        const c = cols[i], key = c.sort || c.k;
        dir[key] = !dir[key];
        const s = dir[key] ? 1 : -1;
        rows.sort((a, b) => {
          let x = c.val ? c.val(a) : a[key], y = c.val ? c.val(b) : b[key];
          if (typeof x === "string" || typeof y === "string") return String(x).localeCompare(String(y)) * s;
          return ((x ?? -1e18) - (y ?? -1e18)) * s;
        });
        draw();
      };
    });
  }
  draw();
}

/* ------------------------------ router ------------------------------ */
const RENDERED = {};
async function show(view) {
  $$("#nav .nv").forEach((b) => b.classList.toggle("active", b.dataset.view === view));
  $$(".view").forEach((v) => v.classList.remove("active"));
  const el = $("#v-" + view);
  el.classList.add("active");
  if (!RENDERED[view]) {
    el.innerHTML = '<div class="loader">loading ' + view + "…</div>";
    try { await VIEWS[view](el); RENDERED[view] = true; }
    catch (e) { el.innerHTML = '<div class="card"><h4>Could not load</h4><p class="mut">' + esc(e.message) + "</p><p class='note'>Make sure this file sits next to the repo's <b>data/</b> folder (or one level inside it).</p></div>"; }
  }
  window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: "smooth" });
}

function card(title, inner) { return `<div class="card"><h4>${esc(title)}</h4>${inner}</div>`; }
function findIdx(indices, name) {
  const n = name.toUpperCase();
  return indices.find((i) => i.index.toUpperCase() === n) || indices.find((i) => i.index.toUpperCase().includes(n));
}
function idxCardG(it) {
  if (!it) return "";
  return `<div class="card"><div class="row"><h4>${esc(it.name)}</h4><span class="pill ${cls(it.chg_pct)}">${sign(it.chg_pct)}</span></div>
   <div class="kpi sm">${nf(it.price, 2)}</div>
   <div class="mini">52w ${nf(it.low_52w, 0)}–${nf(it.high_52w, 0)} · ${esc(it.as_of || "")}</div></div>`;
}
function idxCard(i) {
  if (!i) return "";
  return `<div class="card"><div class="row"><h4>${esc(i.index)}</h4><span class="pill ${cls(i.change_pct)}">${sign(i.change_pct)}</span></div>
   <div class="kpi sm">${nf(i.price, 2)}</div>
   <div class="mini">PE ${esc(i.pe || "—")} · 52w ${nf(i.year_low, 0)}–${nf(i.year_high, 0)}</div></div>`;
}

      const [v, t] = s.split(":"); return `<div class="card" data-view="${v}" style="cursor:pointer"><div class="kpi sm">${esc(t)}</div><div class="mini">open →</div></div>`;
    }).join("")}

  mountTable($("#idxTbl"), idx.indices.slice(), [

function listRows(arr) {
  if (!arr || !arr.length) return '<div class="mut mini">no data</div>';
  return '<ul class="list">' + arr.map((s) => `<li><div><span class="sym">${esc(s.symbol)}</span><span class="co">${esc((s.company || "").slice(0, 34))}</span></div>
    <div style="text-align:right"><b>${nf(s.price, 1)}</b><br><span class="${cls(s.change_pct)}">${sign(s.change_pct)}</span></div></li>`).join("") + "</ul>";
}

  <div class="grid g2" id="rules"></div>

function resourceList(arr, fn) {
  if (!arr || !arr.length) return '<div class="mut mini">none</div>';

}

/* ============================== MUTUAL FUNDS ============================== */
VIEWS.mf = async function (el) {
  const [mf, top] = await Promise.all([J("mf.json"), J("mf-top.json")]);
  const funds = mf.funds || [];
  const cats = Array.from(new Set(funds.map((f) => f.k).filter(Boolean))).sort();
  let q = "", cat = "", shown = 60;
  const compare = [];
  el.innerHTML = `
  <h2 class="sec">Mutual funds — all of India in one search</h2>
  <p class="sub">${nf(mf.count, 0)} direct-plan schemes from AMFI. Search by name or AMC, filter by category, compare up to 4 side by side, and run a SIP what-if.</p>
  <div class="toolbar">
    <input type="text" id="mfQ" placeholder="Search fund name or AMC (e.g. Parag Parikh, Nippon, index)…">
    <select id="mfCat"><option value="">All categories</option>${cats.map((c) => `<option>${esc(c)}</option>`).join("")}</select>
    <span class="mini" id="mfCount"></span>
  </div>
  <div id="mfCompareBar"></div>
  <div class="tbl-wrap" id="mfTbl"></div>
  <div style="margin-top:10px"><button class="btn ghost sm" id="mfMore">Show more</button></div>

  <div class="grid g2" style="margin-top:20px">
    ${card("Top funds — trailing returns", mfTopTable(top))}
    ${card("Benchmarks: Nifty vs Gold vs Silver", benchBlock(top))}
  </div>

  <h3>SIP calculator — from ₹10 up</h3>
  <div class="grid g2">
    ${card("Monthly SIP → future value", sipForm("sip"))}
    ${card("One-time (lumpsum) → future value", sipForm("lump"))}
  </div>

  <h3>Which fund type suits your age & goal?</h3>
  ${card("A simple, honest rule of thumb", ageTool())}`;

  function renderTable() {
    const ql = q.toLowerCase();
    let rows = funds.filter((f) => (!cat || f.k === cat) && (!ql || f.n.toLowerCase().includes(ql) || (f.h || "").toLowerCase().includes(ql)));
    $("#mfCount").textContent = nf(rows.length, 0) + " funds";
    mountTable($("#mfTbl"), rows.slice(0, shown), [
      { label: "", k: "c", render: (r) => `<button class="btn ghost sm" data-add="${esc(r.c)}">+</button>` },
      { label: "Fund", k: "n", render: (r) => `<span class="sym">${esc(r.n)}</span>` },
      { label: "AMC", k: "h", render: (r) => esc(r.h || "") },
      { label: "Category", k: "k", render: (r) => `<span class="mini">${esc(r.k || "")}</span>` },
      { label: "NAV", k: "v", render: (r) => nf(r.v, 4) },
      { label: "1d%", k: "p", render: (r) => `<span class="${cls(r.p)}">${sign(r.p)}</span>` },
    ]);
    $$("[data-add]", $("#mfTbl")).forEach((b) => b.onclick = () => addCompare(b.dataset.add));
  }
  function findFund(code) { return funds.find((f) => f.c === code); }
  function addCompare(code) {
    if (compare.includes(code)) return;
    if (compare.length >= 4) return toast("Compare up to 4 funds");
    compare.push(code); renderCompareBar(); toast("Added to compare");
  }
  window.addCompare = addCompare;
  function renderCompareBar() {
    $("#mfCompareBar").innerHTML = compare.length ? `<div class="hl"><b>Compare (${compare.length})</b> ${compare.map((c) => { const f = findFund(c); return `<span class="chip">${esc(f ? f.n.split("·")[0].trim() : c)} <a href="#" data-rm="${esc(c)}">✕</a></span>`; }).join(" ")} <button class="btn sm" id="doCompare">Compare →</button></div>` : "";
    $$("[data-rm]").forEach((a) => a.onclick = (e) => { e.preventDefault(); const i = compare.indexOf(a.dataset.rm); if (i > -1) compare.splice(i, 1); renderCompareBar(); });
    const dc = $("#doCompare"); if (dc) dc.onclick = compareDrawer;
  }
  function compareDrawer() {
    const fs = compare.map(findFund).filter(Boolean);
    const fields = [["Full name", (f) => f.n], ["AMC", (f) => f.h], ["Category", (f) => f.k], ["NAV", (f) => nf(f.v, 4)], ["1-day %", (f) => sign(f.p)]];
    drawDrawer("<h3>Mutual fund comparison</h3>" + '<div class="tbl-wrap"><table><thead><tr><th>Metric</th>' + fs.map((f) => `<th>${esc(f.n.split("·")[0].trim())}</th>`).join("") + "</tr></thead><tbody>" +
      fields.map(([lbl, fn]) => `<tr><td>${esc(lbl)}</td>${fs.map((f) => `<td>${esc(fn(f))}</td>`).join("")}</tr>`).join("") + "</tbody></table></div>" +
      '<p class="note">NAV and category come from AMFI. For 1/3/5-year returns, use a fund factsheet or the “Top funds” table — returns depend on your buy date.</p>');
  }
  renderTable(); renderCompareBar();
  $("#mfQ").oninput = (e) => { q = e.target.value; shown = 60; renderTable(); };
  $("#mfCat").onchange = (e) => { cat = e.target.value; shown = 60; renderTable(); };
  $("#mfMore").onclick = () => { shown += 120; renderTable(); };
};
function mfTopTable(top) {
  const funds = top.funds || [];
  if (!funds.length) return '<div class="mut mini">no data</div>';
  return '<div class="tbl-wrap" style="max-height:340px"><table><thead><tr><th>Fund</th><th>1y</th><th>3y</th><th>5y</th></tr></thead><tbody>' +
    funds.map((f) => `<tr><td><span class="sym">${esc(f.n.split("·")[0].trim())}</span><span class="co">${esc(f.k || "")}</span></td>
      <td class="${cls(f.r1)}">${sign(f.r1, 1)}</td><td class="${cls(f.r3)}">${sign(f.r3, 1)}</td><td class="${cls(f.r5)}">${sign(f.r5, 1)}</td></tr>`).join("") + "</tbody></table></div>" +
    '<p class="note">Trailing point-to-point returns (cumulative %). Not a recommendation.</p>';
}
function benchBlock(top) {
  const n = top.nifty || {}, b = top.bench || {};
  const row = (lbl, o) => `<tr><td>${esc(lbl)}</td><td class="${cls(o.r1)}">${sign(o.r1, 1)}</td><td class="${cls(o.r3)}">${sign(o.r3, 1)}</td><td class="${cls(o.r5)}">${sign(o.r5, 1)}</td></tr>`;
  let html = '<div class="tbl-wrap"><table><thead><tr><th>Asset</th><th>1y</th><th>3y</th><th>5y</th></tr></thead><tbody>';
  html += row("Nifty 50 (index)", n);
  if (b.gold) html += row("Gold (fund proxy)", b.gold);
  if (b.silver) html += row("Silver (fund proxy)", b.silver);
  html += "</tbody></table></div>";
  html += '<p class="note">This is how you check the question “did this fund beat Nifty, gold or silver?” — compare the same columns.</p>';
  return html;
}
function sipForm(kind) {
  const id = kind === "sip" ? "sip" : "lump";
  return `<div class="toolbar">
    <input type="number" id="${id}Amt" value="${kind === "sip" ? 5000 : 100000}" min="10" step="10" style="max-width:130px">
    <input type="number" id="${id}Yr" value="15" min="1" max="40" style="max-width:90px"> yrs
    <input type="number" id="${id}Ret" value="12" min="1" max="30" style="max-width:90px"> % p.a.
    <button class="btn sm" id="${id}Go">Calculate</button></div>
    <div id="${id}Out" class="kpi sm">—</div>
    <div class="note">Assumed return is your input, not a promise. Equity ~10–12%, debt ~6–7% historically (varies).</div>`;
}
function ageTool() {
  return `<div class="toolbar">
    <input type="number" id="ageIn" value="30" min="15" max="80" style="max-width:90px"> yrs age
    <input type="number" id="ageAmt" value="10000" min="10" step="500" style="max-width:130px"> ₹ / month
    <input type="number" id="ageYr" value="20" min="1" max="40" style="max-width:90px"> yrs horizon
    <button class="btn sm" id="ageGo">Suggest a mix</button></div>
    <div id="ageOut"></div>
    <div class="note">Rule of thumb only — real allocation depends on income stability, goals and risk tolerance. Talk to a SEBI-registered adviser for personal advice.</div>`;
}
function computeFV(monthly, years, ret) {
  const i = ret / 100 / 12, n = years * 12;
  if (i === 0) return monthly * n;
  return monthly * ((Math.pow(1 + i, n) - 1) / i) * (1 + i);
}
function computeLump(p, years, ret) { return p * Math.pow(1 + ret / 100, years); }
